title: Array-Based Molecular Pulse Encoding for Neuro-Spike Communication in Intra-Body Nano-networks
summary: In this paper, we investigate a neuro-spike communication system designed to bridge severed connections between damaged neurons using auxiliary nano-machines. Natural neuro-spike communication typically relies on instantaneous spike rates and temporal intervals to convey information. However, these temporal encoding schemes require exact time synchronization between the transmitter and receiver, a requirement that poses a significant challenge for resource-constrained nano-machines. To address this issue, it is imperative for future intra-body nano-networks to develop communication schemes that operate under reduced-order synchronization (e.g., symbol-synchronized). In this paper, we propose a novel neuro-spike array-based communication scheme where information is encoded through the specific arrangement of distinct molecular pulses emitted by nano-machines. By distinguishing symbols based on the sequence of these emissions rather than their exact timing, the need for stringent time synchronization is eliminated. We theoretically analyze the performance of the proposed scheme by deriving expressions for the probability of inter-symbol interference (ISI), error probability, and the achievable communication rate. Analytical and numerical results demonstrate that our array-based scheme significantly outperforms previously proposed symbol-synchronized models, providing a 75% - 150% enhancement in the communication rate across various diffusion coefficients.

title: Conformal Prediction for Molecular Properties under Label Shift
comments: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Reliable ML from Unreliable Data
summary: Drug discovery and development underpins healthcare but remains costly and failure-prone. A critical bottleneck lies in predicting molecular properties such as solubility, potency, and toxicity, which directly determine whether a candidate can advance from preclinical to clinical trials. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has accelerated this process, yet its reliability is often undermined by distribution shift, as experimental conditions frequently diverge from training data. In addition, conventional point predictions provide only single-value estimates, offering limited guidance for high-stakes experimental design. We address these challenges with a conformal prediction framework tailored to label shift. By weighting conformal scores using marginal label probability ratios, our method produces statistically rigorous prediction intervals without retraining. This enables robust uncertainty quantification even when property distributions drift, directly tackling one of the most pervasive obstacles to applying AI in real-world drug development. By moving beyond accuracy alone to provide actionable confidence measures, our approach enhances the trustworthiness of AI-driven predictions. This further aligns predictive modeling with regulatory demands for transparency and uncertainty reporting and ultimately supports more reliable decision-making in billion-dollar development pipelines.
comment: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Reliable ML from Unreliable Data

title: Differentiable Voronoi Ray Tracing Beyond Rasterization Speeds
summary: Real-time novel view synthesis is dominated by rasterized explicit primitives. These projection-based pipelines provide high throughput but require specialized extensions for non-pinhole effects such as distortion, rolling shutter, and depth of field. Ray-based rendering expresses these effects naturally but is generally assumed too slow for competitive real-time rendering. We analyze the factors governing throughput in differentiable Voronoi ray tracing and identify traversal length, per-cell work, and memory locality as principal determinants. Guided by this, we introduce VoroTracing, which co-designs the scene representation, optimization, and GPU execution to reduce these costs. Compact octahedral appearance textures reduce memory traffic, while surface-concentrated opacity promotes early termination. The fixed-budget representation is optimized without pruning or densification and rendered with a GPU implementation designed for coherent traversal. On Mip-NeRF 360, VoroTracing renders at 623 FPS on an RTX 5090, providing $3.2\times$ the throughput of the fastest prior ray-based method and $2.8\times$ that of 3D Gaussian Splatting, while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. Our renderer supports fisheye, rolling-shutter, motion-blur, and depth-of-field effects through ray generation and sampling, requiring no specialized rasterization. These results show that real-time throughput can be achieved with the flexibility of ray-based rendering. We release our source code, see https://research.zenseact.com/publications/vorotracing

title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch
summary: Self-evolving agents turn experience into reusable skills, workflows, or memories, but post-evolution accuracy alone does not show whether learned behavior preserves previously correct behavior or security. We audit SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and ReasoningBank in simulated e-banking using matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay. On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raises benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837 while exposure to injected content rises from 0.820 to 0.943. Conditional attack success after exposure falls from 0.605 to 0.562, yet overall attack success rate (ASR) rises from 0.496 to 0.530 and unauthorized financial state changes rise to 0.685. Across three independently evolved lineages, capability, exposure, and unauthorized-state changes increase in all three, whereas ASR increases in only two. ReasoningBank raises utility to 0.859 without increasing aggregate ASR, although unauthorized state changes remain slightly above Static. AWM reveals a separate evaluation hazard: a literal WebArena text-action envelope disrupts tool execution in our native function-calling executor. In a post-hoc sensitivity test, removing only that envelope restores utility from 0.319 to 0.756, while exposure rises from 0.299 to 0.909 and ASR from 0.195 to 0.575. Auditing self-evolving financial agents therefore requires tracking regressions, attack-surface contact, unauthorized financial-state change, and artifact-executor compatibility, not accuracy alone.

title: Mixture-of-Expert Blocks Contain Strong Hallucination Detection Signals
summary: Despite their widespread use, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain limited by a fundamental problem: the generation of plausible but false content, known as hallucinations. Most existing detection methods operate at the answer or sentence level, yet per-token detection is essential for localizing hallucinated spans and enabling fine-grained interventions. In this paper, we explore the use of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address this gap. In MoE architectures, a single forward pass activates a sparse subset of experts (i.e., distinct feedforward networks per layer) via a routing mechanism, producing internal signals (e.g., router entropy, expert disagreement, and expert usage patterns) that are unavailable in dense architectures and have not been previously exploited for hallucination detection. To this end, we introduce InnerExpert, the first method to leverage these MoE-specific signals for per-token hallucination detection. InnerExpert combines routing-level and standard transformer signals into compact per-token feature vectors, classified by a lightweight detector trained on labels produced by an LLM-as-a-judge pipeline, which enables continuous model updates without manual annotation. Our results show that InnerExpert outperforms existing methods across five datasets and two MoE architectures, achieving up to 0.91 answer-level and 0.76 token-level AUROC, while requiring only a single forward pass.

AI.title_translation: 混合专家模块包含强大的幻觉检测信号
AI.tldr: 本研究提出InnerExpert，首次利用MoE模型的路由熵和专家分歧等内部信号，在单次前向传播下实现高效准确的逐标记幻觉检测。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型普遍存在生成看似合理但错误内容的幻觉问题。现有检测方法多集中于答案或句子级别，缺乏定位具体幻觉跨度所需的逐标记（per-token）细粒度检测能力。而MoE架构在单次前向传播中激活稀疏专家子集所产生的丰富内部路由信号，在稠密模型中不存在且此前尚未被用于幻觉检测。
AI.method: 提出了首个利用MoE特有内部信号进行逐标记幻觉检测的方法 InnerExpert。该方法将MoE路由级信号（如路由器熵、专家分歧和专家使用模式）与标准Transformer信号融合成紧凑的逐标记特征向量，并通过由“大模型充当裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）”流程自动标注训练的轻量级分类器进行检测，无需人工标注即可持续更新，且仅需单次前向传播。
AI.result: 在5个数据集和2种MoE架构上的实验结果表明，InnerExpert在仅需单次前向传播的情况下显著优于现有方法，分别实现了最高0.91的答案级AUROC和0.76的标记级AUROC。
AI.conclusion: MoE架构特有的路由和专家激活信号能够作为极具价值的特征，用于在单次前向传播中高效、准确地进行逐标记（token-level）及答案级幻觉检测。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）得到了广泛应用，但仍受制于一个根本性问题：生成看似合理却虚假的内容，即幻觉。现有的多数检测方法仅在答案或句子级别运作，然而逐标记（per-token）检测对于定位幻觉跨度以及实现细粒度干预至关重要。在本文中，我们探索利用混合专家（MoE）范式来填补这一空白。在MoE架构中，单次前向传播通过路由机制激活稀疏的专家子集（即每层不同的前馈网络），产生了稠密架构中不存在且此前未被用于幻觉检测的内部信号（例如路由器熵、专家分歧和专家使用模式）。为此，我们提出了InnerExpert，这是首个利用这些MoE特有信号进行逐标记幻觉检测的方法。InnerExpert将路由级信号与标准Transformer信号结合为紧凑的逐标记特征向量，并由通过“LLM作为裁判”流程生成标签训练的轻量级检测器进行分类，从而无需人工标注即可实现模型的持续更新。实验结果表明，InnerExpert在5个数据集和2种MoE架构上均优于现有方法，仅需单次前向传播即可达到最高0.91的答案级AUROC和0.76的标记级AUROC。
AI.summary: 本文提出了InnerExpert，一种利用混合专家（MoE）架构独有内部路由信号（如路由器熵、专家分歧等）的新型逐标记幻觉检测方法。该方法结合轻量级检测器与无人工标注的自动标签生成流程，在单次前向传播下实现了跨多个数据集和架构的高精度答案级与标记级幻觉检测。
AI.keywords: 混合专家模型 (Mixture-of-Experts), 幻觉检测 (Hallucination Detection), 逐标记检测 (Per-token Detection), 路由机制 (Routing Mechanism), 大语言模型 (LLMs)
AI.comments: 本论文创新性地挖掘了混合专家（MoE）架构独有的内部路由信号（如路由器熵、专家分歧度等）用于细粒度幻觉检测，相比传统稠密模型提供了全新的可解释性与检测特征；结合LLM-as-a-judge实现无人工标注训练，兼具高检测精度与单次前向传播的高效性。局限在于该方法受限于MoE模型架构，无法直接迁移至传统的稠密LLM。

title: Collective Ranking of Environmental Signals through Gaussian Belief Propagation in a Patrolling Robot Swarm
summary: Multi-robot patrolling requires a team to visit all areas of an environment at regular intervals, typically minimising idleness. A practical extension, motivated by security and environmental monitoring, is to additionally form a collective ranking of all patrol locations by some measured signal, a generalisation of the best-of-n problem to the many-option, continuous-valued regime. We observe that the patrol graph admits a natural dual interpretation: it is simultaneously the topology that dictates agent movement and a factor graph over which spatial beliefs can be propagated. Exploiting this equivalence, we apply Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP), a graph-based algorithm, to collective ranking using unary measurement factors at visited nodes and pairwise smoothness factors along patrol edges. We compare GBP against simple and visit-count-weighted averaging across a range of sensor-noise conditions in simulation, and validate the approach on four Leo Rovers tracking a propagating radio signal in an office lobby. GBP outperforms both baselines on ranking accuracy, mean squared error, and time to consensus. We find that as noise increases and the task becomes harder, GBP degrades gracefully in simulation while both averaging methods degrade substantially. Hardware trials reproduce the same performance ordering on a real propagating radio signal, supporting the practical relevance of the simulated results.

AI.title_translation: 巡逻机器人群中通过高斯信念传播对环境信号进行集体排序
AI.tldr: 该论文提出在巡逻机器人群中使用高斯信念传播（GBP）对环境信号进行集体排序。模拟和硬件实验表明，GBP在排序精度和鲁棒性方面优于基线平均方法，尤其是在高噪声条件下。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器人巡逻侧重于最小化空闲时间。本研究的动机是将其扩展到通过测量信号对所有巡逻位置进行集体排序，以满足安全和环境监测的需求，并将“n选一”问题推广到多选项、连续值的场景。
AI.method: 该方法利用巡逻图的双重解释——既是智能体移动的拓扑结构，也是传播空间信念的因子图。论文应用高斯信念传播（GBP）算法进行集体排序，使用访问节点处的一元测量因子和沿巡逻边缘的成对平滑因子。该方法在模拟中与简单平均和访问计数加权平均进行比较，并用四台Leo Rovers机器人跟踪无线电信号进行了硬件验证。
AI.result: GBP在排序精度、均方误差和达成共识的时间方面均优于两种基线平均方法。在噪声增加、任务难度提高时，GBP在模拟中表现出优雅的性能下降，而两种平均方法的性能则显著下降。硬件试验也重现了相同的性能排序。
AI.conclusion: 高斯信念传播（GBP）是一种在巡逻机器人群中对环境信号进行集体排序的鲁棒且有效的方法，特别适用于嘈杂的环境，具有实际应用价值。
AI.translation: 多机器人巡逻要求团队定期访问环境中的所有区域，通常是为了最小化空闲时间。一个由安全和环境监测驱动的实际扩展是，额外地根据某种测量信号对所有巡逻位置进行集体排序，这是将“n选一”问题推广到多选项、连续值领域。我们观察到巡逻图具有自然的双重解释：它既是决定智能体运动的拓扑结构，也是一个可以传播空间信念的因子图。利用这种等效性，我们应用基于图的算法高斯信念传播（GBP）进行集体排序，在访问节点使用一元测量因子，沿巡逻边缘使用成对平滑因子。我们在模拟中比较了GBP与简单平均和访问计数加权平均在各种传感器噪声条件下的性能，并在办公室大厅中用四台Leo Rovers机器人跟踪传播的无线电信号验证了该方法。GBP在排序精度、均方误差和达成共识的时间方面均优于两种基线方法。我们发现，随着噪声增加，任务变得更困难时，GBP在模拟中优雅地降级，而两种平均方法则显著降级。硬件试验在真实的传播无线电信号上重现了相同的性能排序，支持了模拟结果的实际相关性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在巡逻机器人群中对环境信号进行集体排序的方法。它利用巡逻图的双重性质（运动拓扑和因子图）应用高斯信念传播（GBP）。通过模拟和使用Leo Rovers进行硬件实验，结果表明GBP在排序精度和鲁棒性方面显著优于传统平均方法，尤其是在高噪声条件下，使其成为安全和环境监测应用中一个有前景的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 集体排序, 机器人群, 高斯信念传播, 多机器人巡逻, 环境监测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将巡逻图重新解释为因子图，从而能够应用高斯信念传播（GBP）进行集体排序。这为多机器人系统中的实际问题提供了一个鲁棒的解决方案，特别是其在噪声下的优雅降级特性，这对于实际部署至关重要。

title: Force-Based Offset Estimation for Keyed Peg-in-Hole Assembly Using Local Gaussian Process Regression
comments: 6 pages, 11 figures. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM 2026), Genova, Italy. Awaiting publication in IEEE Xplore
summary: Key-keyway assembly tasks impose strict geometric constraints and are highly sensitive to grasp pose deviations in uncertain environments. This work presents a force-based offset estimation method for keyed peg-in-hole assembly, embedded within a perception-validation-insertion pipeline. Residual misalignment is estimated directly from wrist force/torque measurements using a local KNN-Gaussian Process hybrid regressor. The framework distinguishes between two contact regimes, hard collision and guided chamfer insertion, and routes inference to a dedicated model for each. Regime classification is achieved via a contact-window duration threshold. KNN combined with a deterministic search using the results of a post-grasp monocular visual validation contributes to an increased accuracy of the regressor model. This approach achieves accurate radial offset estimation in chamfered peg insertion, during a keypoint detection-based pick and place application. Experiments using the integrated force/torque sensor of a collaborative robot arm showed an increase in insertion success rate from 67% to 87% after the pipeline was applied.
comment: 6 pages, 11 figures. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM 2026), Genova, Italy. Awaiting publication in IEEE Xplore

AI.title_translation: 基于局部高斯过程回归的键槽配合装配力基偏移估计
AI.tldr: 针对键槽配合装配，本文提出一种基于腕部力/扭矩测量的力基偏移估计方法，结合局部KNN-高斯过程混合回归器，通过区分接触模式和视觉验证提高装配成功率。
AI.motivation: 键槽配合装配任务具有严格的几何约束，并且对不确定环境中的抓取姿态偏差高度敏感，这促使研究者寻求更精确的偏移估计方法。
AI.method: 本文提出一种力基偏移估计方法，嵌入在感知-验证-插入流程中。该方法使用局部KNN-高斯过程混合回归器，直接从腕部力/扭矩测量中估计残余未对准。框架区分硬碰撞和导向倒角插入两种接触模式，并为每种模式路由到专用模型，模式分类通过接触窗口持续时间阈值实现。KNN结合后抓取单目视觉验证的确定性搜索，提高了回归器模型的准确性。
AI.result: 该方法在基于关键点检测的抓取放置应用中，实现了倒角销插入的准确径向偏移估计。实验表明，应用该流程后，协作机器人手臂的插入成功率从67%提高到87%。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合力基偏移估计、局部KNN-高斯过程混合回归以及对不同接触模式的区分处理，该方法显著提高了键槽配合装配任务的成功率。
AI.translation: 键槽配合装配任务具有严格的几何约束，并且对不确定环境中的抓取姿态偏差高度敏感。本工作提出了一种用于键槽配合装配的基于力的偏移估计方法，该方法嵌入在感知-验证-插入流程中。使用局部KNN-高斯过程混合回归器，直接从腕部力/扭矩测量中估计残余未对准。该框架区分两种接触模式：硬碰撞和导向倒角插入，并将推理路由到每个模式的专用模型。模式分类通过接触窗口持续时间阈值实现。KNN结合使用抓取后单目视觉验证结果的确定性搜索，有助于提高回归器模型的准确性。这种方法在基于关键点检测的抓取放置应用中，在倒角销插入过程中实现了准确的径向偏移估计。使用协作机器人手臂的集成力/扭矩传感器进行的实验表明，应用该流程后，插入成功率从67%提高到87%。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种用于键槽配合装配的力基偏移估计方法，以应对严格的几何约束和抓取姿态偏差。该方法集成在感知-验证-插入流程中，利用腕部力/扭矩测量和局部KNN-高斯过程混合回归器估计残余未对准。通过区分硬碰撞和导向倒角插入两种接触模式，并结合视觉验证，提高了回归模型的准确性。实验证明，该方法将插入成功率从67%提升至87%。
AI.keywords: 键槽配合装配, 力基偏移估计, 高斯过程回归, KNN, 机器人装配
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合力觉反馈和机器学习（KNN-高斯过程回归），为精密装配任务提供了一种鲁棒的解决方案。其创新点在于对不同接触模式的区分处理，以及将视觉验证与力觉回归相结合，有效提升了复杂装配任务的成功率。对于机器人自动化装配领域具有重要的实践意义。

title: GADR: Gathering Architecture Decision Records from Meeting Transcriptions
summary: Existing LLM-based approaches to Architecture Decision Record (ADR) generation share a critical and largely unexamined assumption: that input is already reasonably structured. In practice, architectural decisions emerge from informal, noisy meetings where choices are implicit, fragmented, and entangled with off-topic dialogue, precisely the conditions under which single-pass prompting degrades. This paper presents GADR, a multi-agent, self-correcting workflow that extracts architectural decisions from raw meeting transcriptions and generates Nygard-formatted ADR drafts. A feasibility study comprising five real project meeting transcripts, expert review by four senior architects, and evaluation by fifteen students provides initial evidence that the agentic workflow captures most expert-identified decisions and produces drafts participants found clear and useful, outperforming zero-shot and few-shot baselines in stability and structural adherence. The study also addresses the underexplored trade-off of RAG-based enrichment improving ADR depth while simultaneously risking transcript-unfaithful content, raising open questions about traceability in automated architectural documentation that we believe is worth the community's attention.

AI.title_translation: GADR：从会议记录中收集架构决策记录
AI.tldr: GADR是一个多智能体、自校正的工作流，可以从原始会议记录中提取架构决策并生成Nygard格式的ADR草稿，在处理非结构化输入方面优于现有LLM方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的架构决策记录（ADR）生成方法假设输入结构合理，但在实践中，架构决策产生于非正式、嘈杂的会议中，决策是隐式、碎片化且与无关对话交织的，这导致单次提示性能下降。
AI.method: 本文提出了GADR，一个多智能体、自校正的工作流，用于从原始会议记录中提取架构决策并生成Nygard格式的ADR草稿。
AI.result: 一项可行性研究表明，GADR工作流捕获了大多数专家识别的决策，并生成了清晰有用的草稿，在稳定性和结构依从性方面优于零样本和少样本基线。研究还探讨了基于RAG的丰富处理在提高ADR深度时可能带来的记录不忠实内容的权衡。
AI.conclusion: GADR工作流在从嘈杂的会议记录中提取架构决策方面有效，并提出了自动化架构文档中可追溯性的开放性问题，值得社区关注。
AI.translation: 现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的架构决策记录（ADR）生成方法普遍存在一个关键且尚未充分研究的假设：输入数据已经具有合理的结构。然而在实践中，架构决策通常产生于非正式、嘈杂的会议中，其中选择是隐式的、碎片化的，并与无关对话纠缠在一起，而这正是单次提示（single-pass prompting）性能下降的条件。本文提出了 GADR，一个多智能体、自校正的工作流，旨在从原始会议记录中提取架构决策并生成 Nygard 格式的 ADR 草稿。一项包括五份真实项目会议记录、四位资深架构师的专家评审以及十五名学生的评估的可行性研究提供了初步证据，表明该智能体工作流捕获了大多数专家识别的决策，并生成了参与者认为清晰有用的草稿，在稳定性和结构依从性方面优于零样本和少样本基线。该研究还探讨了基于检索增强生成（RAG）的丰富处理在提高 ADR 深度时，同时可能带来与原始记录不符内容的未充分探索的权衡，这提出了关于自动化架构文档中可追溯性的开放性问题，我们认为这些问题值得社区关注。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了GADR，一个多智能体、自校正的工作流，旨在解决现有LLM方法在处理非结构化、嘈杂会议记录中提取架构决策时的局限性。GADR能够从原始会议转录中识别并生成Nygard格式的ADR草稿。一项可行性研究表明，GADR能有效捕获专家识别的决策，生成清晰有用的草稿，并优于零样本和少样本基线。研究还提出了RAG增强可能导致内容不忠实于原始记录的权衡问题，并强调了自动化架构文档中可追溯性的重要性。
AI.keywords: 架构决策记录, 会议记录, 大型语言模型, 多智能体系统, 检索增强生成
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个多智能体、自校正的工作流GADR，专门用于处理真实世界中非结构化、嘈杂的会议记录，这比现有LLM方法更具实用性。其重要性在于提升了自动化ADR生成的准确性和可用性。局限性方面，论文提到了RAG增强可能导致内容与原始记录不符的权衡，这指出了未来在可追溯性方面需要进一步研究。

title: Magnitude-Direction Decoupling for Fast Video Generation with Flow Matching Models
summary: Flow matching models for video generation achieve impressive performance but suffer from high computational overhead due to iterative denoising. In fact, the original model is not necessary for all denoising steps, allowing some steps to use lightweight alternatives for faster sampling. However, directly using caching or lightweight models can deviate from the original denoising trajectory, resulting in suboptimal performance. Through empirical analysis, we find that lightweight models can robustly capture the magnitude components of the original model's output, while caching provides reliable directional guidance. Building on this insight, we propose the Magnitude-Direction Decoupling (MDD) method, which adaptively employs a direction-calibrated lightweight model as a substitute for the original model to accelerate inference and effectively correct deviations in the denoising trajectory. Moreover, MDD further reduces inference costs by reusing magnitude information under classifier-free guidance (CFG). As a result, MDD offers a more reliable and lightweight solution to accelerate sampling. Experiments show that MDD outperforms existing acceleration methods, delivering promising speedups (e.g., up to 2.95x on Wan2.1) while preserving high visual fidelity and content richness.

AI.title_translation: 幅度-方向解耦用于基于流匹配模型的快速视频生成
AI.tldr: 流匹配视频生成模型因迭代去噪而缓慢。本文提出幅度-方向解耦（MDD）方法，通过使用轻量级模型处理幅度分量和缓存提供方向指导，实现快速、高质量的视频生成，并在Wan2.1上实现高达2.95倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型在视频生成方面性能出色，但由于迭代去噪导致计算开销高昂。直接使用缓存或轻量级模型进行加速会导致偏离原始去噪轨迹，从而降低性能。
AI.method: 本文提出了幅度-方向解耦（MDD）方法。通过经验分析发现，轻量级模型能稳健捕获原始模型输出的幅度分量，而缓存提供可靠的方向指导。MDD自适应地采用方向校准的轻量级模型替代原始模型，以加速推理并纠正去噪轨迹偏差。此外，MDD通过在无分类器指导（CFG）下重用幅度信息，进一步降低推理成本。
AI.result: MDD优于现有加速方法，在保持高视觉保真度和内容丰富度的同时，实现了显著的加速（例如，在Wan2.1上高达2.95倍）。
AI.conclusion: MDD为基于流匹配模型的视频生成提供了一种更可靠、更轻量级的采样加速解决方案，在显著提升速度的同时保持了高视觉质量和内容丰富度。
AI.translation: 流匹配模型在视频生成方面取得了令人印象深刻的性能，但由于迭代去噪而导致计算开销高昂。事实上，原始模型并非所有去噪步骤都必需，这使得一些步骤可以使用轻量级替代方案以加快采样速度。然而，直接使用缓存或轻量级模型可能会偏离原始的去噪轨迹，导致次优性能。通过经验分析，我们发现轻量级模型可以稳健地捕获原始模型输出的幅度分量，而缓存则提供可靠的方向指导。基于这一见解，我们提出了幅度-方向解耦（Magnitude-Direction Decoupling, MDD）方法，该方法自适应地采用方向校准的轻量级模型替代原始模型，以加速推理并有效纠正去噪轨迹中的偏差。此外，MDD通过在无分类器指导（CFG）下重用幅度信息，进一步降低了推理成本。因此，MDD提供了一种更可靠、更轻量级的采样加速解决方案。实验表明，MDD优于现有的加速方法，在保持高视觉保真度和内容丰富度的同时，提供了可观的加速（例如，在Wan2.1上高达2.95倍）。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决流匹配视频生成模型中因迭代去噪导致的计算开销问题。通过实证分析，研究发现轻量级模型能有效捕获去噪过程中的幅度分量，而缓存则能提供方向指导。基于此，论文提出了幅度-方向解耦（MDD）方法，该方法自适应地利用经过方向校准的轻量级模型替代原始模型，以加速推理并纠正去噪轨迹偏差。MDD还通过在无分类器指导下重用幅度信息来进一步降低成本。实验结果表明，MDD优于现有加速方法，能在保持高视觉保真度和内容丰富度的同时，实现显著的采样加速（例如，在Wan2.1上高达2.95倍）。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 流匹配模型, 加速, 幅度-方向解耦, 去噪
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于经验性地揭示了去噪过程中幅度与方向分量可以解耦，并能由不同类型的模型（轻量级模型处理幅度，缓存提供方向）有效处理。这种自适应方法巧妙地解决了生成模型中速度与质量之间的权衡问题。MDD能够纠正去噪轨迹偏差并重用CFG下的幅度信息，进一步突出了其效率和可靠性。

title: A multi-level preprocessing and modelling framework for spectral imaging of microplastics
summary:
Spectral imaging provides chemically specific and spatially resolved analysis of microplastics, but its routine application is hindered by large data volumes, acquisition artefacts, spectral variability, and misidentification of polymers due to alike spectra. This study proposes a multi-level preprocessing and modelling framework for FT-IR spectral imaging of microplastics that integrates image-level, tile-level, and spectral-level corrections with scalable identification strategies.
  Image-level variation associated with changing acquisition conditions was done with latent variable selection, while a background-based tile correction reduced illumination-related artefacts. Spectral preprocessing combined baseline correction, smoothing, derivative calculation, normalization, and wavelength selection, and only particle spectra were retained for further analysis to improve computational efficiency. For scalable identification, clustering was applied to particle spectra and spectral library matching was performed on cluster centroids instead of individual pixels. Among twelve evaluated matching strategies, a sign-invariant derivative-based cosine similarity method achieved perfect classification accuracy for polystyrene (PS), polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polyethylene (PE), and polypropylene (PP). The clustering-based workflow also produced more spatially coherent particle maps than direct software-based matching while substantially reducing processing time. The framework was evaluated for supervised classification-based MP indentification. These results show that multi-level correction combined with cluster-centroid spectral matching improves the robustness, efficiency, and interpretability of spectral-imaging-based microplastic identification.

AI.title_translation: 用于微塑料光谱成像的多级预处理与建模框架
AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一种多级预处理和建模框架，结合图块校正和聚类中心光谱匹配，显著提升了微塑料光谱成像的识别准确率和处理效率。
AI.motivation: 微塑料的光谱成像常规应用受到数据量大、采集伪影、光谱变异以及相似光谱导致聚合物误识别等问题的阻碍，因此需要一种更稳健、高效的处理和建模框架。
AI.method: 提出一个包含图像级、图块级和光谱级校正的多级预处理框架；通过潜变量选择和基于背景的图块校正处理图像变化和光照伪影；结合基线校正、平滑、微分、归一化和波长选择进行光谱预处理；采用基于聚类的方法，对聚类中心而非单个像素进行光谱库匹配。
AI.result: 在评估的十二种匹配策略中，符号不变的基于导数的余弦相似度方法对PS、PET、PE和PP实现了完美的分类准确率；基于聚类的工作流比直接软件匹配产生了更高空间相干性的微塑料图，并大幅减少了处理时间。
AI.conclusion: 该多级预处理和建模框架显著提升了基于傅里叶变换红外光谱成像技术的微塑料识别的鲁棒性、效率和空间相干性。
AI.translation:
光谱成像可对微塑料进行化学特异性和空间分辨率的分析，但其常规应用受到大数据量、采集伪影、光谱变异以及因相似光谱导致的聚合物误识别的阻碍。本研究针对微塑料的傅里叶变换红外（FT-IR）光谱成像，提出了一种多级预处理和建模框架，该框架将图像级、图块级和光谱级校正与可扩展的识别策略相结合。
通过潜变量选择处理与采集条件变化相关的图像级变异，同时基于背景的图块校正减少了与光照相关的伪影。光谱预处理结合了基线校正、平滑、导数计算、归一化和波长选择，并且仅保留颗粒光谱进行进一步分析以提高计算效率。为了实现可扩展的识别，对颗粒光谱应用了聚类分析，并在聚类中心而不是单个像素上执行光谱库匹配。在评估的十二种匹配策略中，基于符号不变导数的余弦相似度方法对聚苯乙烯（PS）、聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）、聚乙烯（PE）和聚丙烯（PP）实现了完美的分类准确率。与直接的基于软件的匹配相比，基于聚类的工作流产生了更高空间相干性的颗粒图，同时大幅缩短了处理时间。该框架针对基于监督分类的微塑料识别进行了评估。这些结果表明，多级校正与聚类中心光谱匹配相结合，提高了基于光谱成像的微塑料识别的鲁棒性、效率和可解释性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种针对微塑料FT-IR光谱成像的多级预处理和建模框架，通过整合图像、图块和光谱级别的校正以及基于聚类中心的库匹配策略，有效克服了数据体量大、伪影和误识别等问题，大幅提升了微塑料识别的准确率、计算效率和空间相干性。
AI.keywords: 光谱成像, 微塑料, 傅里叶变换红外光谱, 数据预处理, 聚类分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种系统性的多级预处理和建模框架，有效解决了微塑料光谱成像中数据量大、伪影多以及相似光谱易混淆的痛点，通过聚类中心匹配显著提高了计算效率和分类准确性，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Fault detection on manifolds of nonlinear dynamical systems with dual autoencoders
summary: Autoencoders are commonly used for unsupervised data-driven fault detection in nonlinear dynamical systems. Despite their widespread success and often favorable performance compared with traditional approaches, most applications rely on heuristic reconstruction of measured data using features learned from nominal training data, without explicit insight into the underlying nonlinear dynamics. This lack of interpretability limits the extension of autoencoder-based fault detection methods to higher levels of fault diagnosis, e.g., fault localization and quantification, and confines their use largely to application-oriented studies. To address this limitation, we propose a strategy for detecting parametric faults in nonlinear stochastic mechanical systems. A mathematical representation of the output data is developed using Koopman operator theory, which motivates their embedding on a manifold and its subsequent approximation with a two-stage autoencoder. Fault detection is formulated within a hypothesis-testing framework, in which new data are tested for consistency with a neighborhood of the manifold identified from nominal observations. The proposed method is validated through Monte Carlo simulations of a toy mechanical system with two types of nonlinearity and applied to two well-known real benchmarks, where it provides favorable fault-detection performance compared with standard autoencoders.

AI.title_translation: 基于双自编码器的非线性动力系统流形故障检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用双阶段自编码器在流形上检测非线性随机机械系统参数故障的方法，通过将输出数据嵌入流形并进行假设检验，在基准测试中表现优于标准自编码器。
AI.motivation: 传统的自编码器在非线性动力系统故障检测中缺乏对底层非线性动力学的明确洞察，限制了其在故障诊断更高级阶段（如故障定位和量化）的应用，且主要局限于应用导向的研究。
AI.method: 本方法通过Koopman算子理论开发输出数据的数学表示，将其嵌入流形，并使用两阶段自编码器对其进行近似。故障检测被表述为假设检验框架，其中新数据与从标称观测中识别的流形邻域进行一致性测试。
AI.result: 该方法通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了一个具有两种非线性的玩具机械系统，并应用于两个知名的真实基准，与标准自编码器相比，提供了更有利的故障检测性能。
AI.translation: 自编码器通常用于非线性动力系统中无监督的数据驱动故障检测。尽管它们取得了广泛的成功，并且与传统方法相比，通常表现出更优的性能，但大多数应用依赖于使用从标称训练数据中学习到的特征对测量数据进行启发式重建，而没有明确洞察底层非线性动力学。这种缺乏可解释性限制了基于自编码器的故障检测方法扩展到更高层次的故障诊断，例如故障定位和量化，并将其使用范围主要局限于面向应用的研究。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了一种检测非线性随机机械系统参数故障的策略。利用Koopman算子理论开发了输出数据的数学表示，这促使它们在流形上的嵌入及其随后使用两阶段自编码器进行近似。故障检测是在假设检验框架内制定的，其中新数据与从标称观测中识别的流形邻域进行一致性测试。所提出的方法通过对具有两种非线性的玩具机械系统进行蒙特卡洛模拟进行了验证，并应用于两个著名的真实基准，与标准自编码器相比，它提供了更有利的故障检测性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于双阶段自编码器和Koopman算子理论的非线性随机机械系统参数故障检测策略。该方法通过将系统输出数据在流形上进行嵌入和近似，并将故障检测构建为假设检验问题。实验结果表明，与标准自编码器相比，该方法在玩具系统和真实基准测试中均展现出更优的故障检测性能，旨在解决传统自编码器在非线性动力学解释性方面的局限性。
AI.keywords: 故障检测, 自编码器, 非线性动力系统, Koopman算子, 流形
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将Koopman算子理论与两阶段自编码器结合，实现非线性动力系统数据在流形上的嵌入和故障检测，提升了传统自编码器在可解释性方面的不足。通过引入假设检验框架，使得故障检测更加严谨。该方法在理论上具有一定的深度，并通过实际案例验证了其有效性，对于推动自编码器在故障诊断领域的高级应用具有重要意义。

title: Environment-Invariant Subspace Learning for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
summary: Cross-distribution generalization remains a critical bottleneck in deepfake detection. While recent efforts leverage the semantic priors of large-scale visual foundation models (VFMs), a noteworthy yet underexplored challenge remains: the susceptibility of these semantic priors to environmental interference from factors such as lighting and style. Crucially, this interference establishes spurious correlations between forgery cues and environmental patterns that severely limit generalization. To address this fundamental challenge, we propose an innovative Environment-Invariant Subspace Learning (EISL) framework. The core contribution of EISL is that it aims to disentangle features into orthogonal forgery-relevant invariant factors and environment-related residual factors via a learnable low-rank projection. To facilitate robust feature disentanglement, we also design an Environmental Intervention module that generates diverse and challenging intervention pairs, simulating out-of-distribution environmental shifts to guide the model toward discovering truly invariant forgery representations. Experiments across cross-dataset, cross-generator, whole-face synthesis, and corruption settings show consistent gains and competitive or leading performance against strong detectors, demonstrating improved robustness to unseen forgery types and environmental variations. This work provides a new perspective and a valuable exploration for understanding and tackling the generalization barriers of VFMs in deepfake detection.

AI.title_translation: 面向可泛化深度伪造检测的环境不变子空间学习
AI.tldr: 提出环境不变子空间学习（EISL）框架，通过特征解耦和环境干预解决深度伪造检测中的环境干扰与泛化难题。
AI.motivation: 尽管近期研究利用了大尺度视觉基础模型（VFMs）的语义先验，但这些语义先验容易受到光照和风格等环境干扰，从而在伪造线索与环境模式之间建立虚假相关性，严重限制了跨分布泛化的能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种环境不变子空间学习（EISL）框架，通过可学习的低秩投影将特征解耦为正交的伪造相关不变因子和环境相关残差因子；同时设计了一个环境干预模块，生成多样且具有挑战性的干预对，以模拟分布外环境漂移。
AI.result: 在跨数据集、跨生成器、全脸合成以及损坏设置等多种实验中，该方法展现出一致的性能提升，并对强基线检测器取得了竞争或领先的性能，证明了其对未见伪造类型和环境变化的强大鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过环境不变子空间学习（EISL）框架和环境干预模块，有效解决了视觉基础模型在深度伪造检测中受环境干扰导致的泛化瓶颈，实现了对未见伪造类型和环境变化的出色鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 跨分布泛化仍然是深度伪造检测的关键瓶颈。虽然最近的努力利用了大尺度视觉基础模型（VFMs）的语义先验，但一个值得注意但尚未充分探索的挑战依然存在：这些语义先验容易受到光照和风格等环境因素的环境干扰。至关重要的是，这种干扰在伪造线索和环境模式之间建立了虚假的相关性，从而严重限制了泛化能力。为了解决这一根本挑战，我们提出了一种创新的环境不变子空间学习（EISL）框架。EISL的核心贡献在于它旨在通过可学习的低秩投影将特征解耦为正交的伪造相关不变因子和环境相关残差因子。为了促进稳健的特征解耦，我们还设计了一个环境干预模块，生成多样且具有挑战性的干预对，模拟分布外环境 shifts（偏移），以指导模型发现真正不变的伪造表示。跨数据集、跨生成器、全脸合成和损坏设置的实验表明，该方法取得了持续的收益，并对强检测器表现出竞争或领先的性能，证明了其对未见伪造类型和环境变化的鲁棒性有所提高。这项工作为理解和克服视觉基础模型在深度伪造检测中的泛化障碍提供了一个新视角和有价值的探索。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于可泛化深度伪造检测的环境不变子空间学习（EISL）框架。该方法通过可学习的低秩投影将特征解耦为不变的伪造因子和环境残差因子，并结合环境干预模块模拟分布外环境漂移，从而有效消除了环境干扰带来的虚假相关性，显著提升了跨分布泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 深度伪造检测, 跨分布泛化, 环境不变子空间学习, 特征解耦, 视觉基础模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对深度伪造检测中跨分布泛化能力的瓶颈，提出了一种环境不变子空间学习框架（EISL），利用低秩投影和环境干预模块有效剥离了环境因素的干扰，展现出优秀的泛化性能。创新点在于通过可学习的低秩投影和干预模块实现特征解耦，对视觉基础模型在伪造检测中的应用具有重要价值。

title: Dijkstra as an Oracle for Online Stochastic Shortest Path Navigation with Provable Guarantees
summary: Mobile robots that operate in side by side with humans and critical facilities must reach their goals at low cost, despite often unknown true traversal costs of the map apriori and imperfect actuation. Planners that solve the underlying stochastic shortest path problem exactly, such as value iteration, require computation that grows with the diameter of the map, whereas Dijkstra's algorithm is fast but is usually considered inexact once transitions are stochastic. This study shows that Dijkstra's algorithm can remain an exact planning engine under a condition that is much weaker than the causality condition often invoked in the literature, namely nonnegativity of a reduced cost defined on the determinized map. Building on this characterization, an online learner DORA (Dijkstra Oracle Reduced-cost Algorithm) is proposed for robot navigation that calls a shortest path oracle a fixed number of times per episode, never estimates a transition kernel, and adds a logarithmic survival weight when the probability of contact with a dynamic obstacle must stay within a budget. In the numerical experiments involving three other benchmarks that cover grid world navigation, directional drilling, and drone surveillance, the learner matches optimistic value iteration that is given the true transition kernel while performing 4.5 to 19.3 times less planner work, reduces contacts during learning by a factor of seventeen relative to determinize and replan, and keeps the contact rate within budgets that span two orders of magnitude. These results indicate that shortest path search supports safe and efficient online navigation and path planning tasks.

AI.title_translation: Dijkstra 作为具有可证明保证的在线随机最短路径导航的预言家
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为 DORA 的在线学习算法，用于机器人导航，该算法利用 Dijkstra 算法作为预言家，在随机环境中找到最优路径，同时满足安全和效率要求。
AI.motivation: 在移动机器人与人类和关键设施并肩运行时，需要在存在未知遍历成本和不完美驱动的情况下，以低成本到达目标。现有的精确规划方法（如价值迭代）计算成本高昂，而 Dijkstra 算法虽然速度快，但在随机环境中通常被认为不精确。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 DORA（Dijkstra Oracle Reduced-cost Algorithm）的在线学习算法。DORA 利用 Dijkstra 算法作为预言家，在每次迭代中调用固定次数的最短路径预言家，无需估计转移核，并在需要将与动态障碍物接触的概率保持在预算内时增加对数生存权重。该算法基于 Dijkstra 算法在非负约化成本条件下仍可作为精确规划引擎的理论基础。
AI.result: 在网格世界导航、定向钻井和无人机监视等数值实验中，DORA 学习器能够匹配乐观价值迭代的性能，同时规划器工作量减少 4.5 到 19.3 倍，与确定性重规划相比，学习过程中的接触次数减少了 17 倍，并将接触率保持在两个数量级的预算内。
AI.conclusion: 最短路径搜索算法可支持安全高效的在线导航和路径规划任务。
AI.translation: 移动机器人在与人类和关键设施并肩运行时，必须以低成本到达目标，尽管地图的真实遍历成本通常是未知的，并且驱动通常不完美。解决底层随机最短路径问题的精确规划器（如价值迭代）需要随地图直径增长的计算量，而 Dijkstra 算法速度很快，但在转移是随机的时通常被认为是不精确的。本研究表明，在比文献中经常提到的因果关系条件弱得多的条件下，Dijkstra 算法可以仍然是一个精确的规划引擎，即在确定化地图上定义的约化成本的非负性。在此表征的基础上，提出了一种用于机器人导航的在线学习器 DORA（Dijkstra Oracle Reduced-cost Algorithm），该学习器在每次迭代中调用固定次数的最短路径预言家，从不估计转移核，并在必须将与动态障碍物接触的概率保持在预算内时添加对数生存权重。在涉及三种其他基准的数值实验中，这些基准涵盖了网格世界导航、定向钻井和无人机监视，该学习器在规划器工作量减少 4.5 到 19.3 倍的同时，匹配了具有真实转移核的乐观价值迭代，与确定性重规划相比，学习过程中的接触次数减少了十七倍，并将接触率保持在跨越两个数量级的预算内。这些结果表明，最短路径搜索支持安全高效的在线导航和路径规划任务。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为 DORA 的在线学习算法，用于机器人导航。DORA 利用 Dijkstra 算法作为预言家，在随机环境中找到成本最低的路径，同时满足安全和效率要求。研究表明，DORA 在规划器工作量和学习过程中的接触次数方面表现优于现有方法，并能在不同预算下保持较低的接触率。
AI.keywords: 随机最短路径, Dijkstra 算法, 在线导航, 机器人规划, 约化成本
AI.comments: 该研究将 Dijkstra 算法成功应用于在线随机最短路径导航问题，并提供了可证明的保证。提出的 DORA 算法在效率和安全性方面表现出色，尤其是在计算资源有限的情况下。然而，算法在处理高度动态或不可预测的环境时的鲁棒性仍有待进一步研究。

title: Monitoring Pasture Restoration from Satellite Image Time Series: Caveats and Opportunities
comments: Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Computer Vision for Ecology at ECCV 2026
summary: Monitoring nature restoration at scale is an important but difficult ecological problem. Deep learning methods to analyze satellite image time series (SITS) have been widely used for land surface monitoring. In semi-natural grasslands - the habitat type in focus in this work - restoration outcomes develop gradually, yet satellite observations are influenced by weather, acquisition conditions, and processing artefacts, making it difficult to distinguish genuine restoration signals from unrelated temporal variation. In this work, we examine - to the best of our knowledge, for the first time - whether restoration status can be detected directly from satellite image time series by formulating pasture restoration as a binary deep learning classification problem. We evaluate two common SITS deep learning architectures on different Sentinel-2 image combinations, across 1,397 restored Swedish pastures and find that explicitly modeling intra-year variability and per-pasture normalization increases separability, reaching 0.88 accuracy for the best model. We further investigate our results and perform a targeted bias analysis finding that reliable deployment requires temporally balanced labels and evaluation protocols that explicitly test for year-related confounding. We therefore frame our contribution not as a solved restoration-monitoring system, but as a realistic case study of what works, what fails, and what future studies should control for. Code and models are available at https://github.com/aleksispi/ml-nature-resto.
comment: Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Computer Vision for Ecology at ECCV 2026

AI.title_translation: 基于卫星影像时间序列监测牧场恢复：注意事项与机遇
AI.tldr: 本文通过深度学习和卫星影像时间序列探讨了草地恢复的监测方法，实现了0.88的准确率，并指出了数据偏差和年际混杂因素对模型可靠部署的影响。
AI.motivation: 大规模监测自然恢复是一个重要且困难的生态问题。由于天气、采集条件和处理伪影的影响，区分真正的恢复信号与无关的时间变化非常困难，因此需要研究是否能直接从卫星影像时间序列（SITS）中检测草地恢复状态。
AI.method: 将牧场恢复建模为二元深度学习分类问题，评估了两种常见的SITS深度学习架构在不同Sentinel-2图像组合（涵盖1,397个瑞典恢复牧场）上的表现，并采用了显式建模年内变异和逐牧场归一化方法。
AI.result: 通过显式建模年内变异和逐牧场归一化，模型的类别可分性显著增加，最佳模型的准确率达到了0.88。然而，偏差分析表明可靠部署需要时间平衡的标签和针对年际混杂因素的评估协议。
AI.conclusion: 直接从卫星影像时间序列中监测草地恢复状态是可行的（最高准确率达0.88），但由于天气、采集条件和年际混杂因素的影响，实际部署需要时间平衡的标签和严格的评估协议来避免偏差。
AI.translation: 大规模监测自然恢复是一个重要但困难的生态问题。用于分析卫星影像时间序列（SITS）的深度学习方法已被广泛用于地表监测。在半自然草地（本研究关注的生境类型）中，恢复成果是逐渐显现的，然而卫星观测受天气、采集条件和处理伪影的影响，这使得区分真正的恢复信号与不相关的临时变化变得困难。在这项工作中，我们据我们所知首次探讨了是否可以通过将牧场恢复表述为二元深度学习分类问题，直接从卫星影像时间序列中检测恢复状态。我们评估了两种常见的SITS深度学习架构在不同Sentinel-2图像组合上的表现，跨越了1,397个瑞典恢复牧场，发现显式建模年内变异和逐牧场归一化增加了可分性，最佳模型的准确率达到了0.88。我们进一步调查了结果并进行了针对性的偏差分析，发现可靠的部署需要时间平衡的标签以及明确测试与年份相关混杂因素的评估协议。因此，我们的贡献并不是一个完全解决的恢复监测系统，而是一个现实的案例研究，展示了什么有效、什么失败以及未来研究应该控制什么。代码和模型可在 https://github.com/aleksispi/ml-nature-resto 获取。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用卫星影像时间序列（SITS）和深度学习直接监测瑞典半自然草地恢复状态的可行性。研究发现，通过显式建模年内变异和逐牧场归一化，分类准确率可达0.88，但同时也指出了天气、处理伪影以及年际混杂因素带来的挑战，强调了严格评估协议和时间平衡标签的重要性。
AI.keywords: 卫星影像时间序列, 深度学习, 草地恢复, 遥感监测, 偏差分析
AI.comments: 该论文首次探讨了利用卫星影像时间序列（SITS）直接检测半自然草地恢复状态的可行性，深入分析了深度学习模型在生态恢复监测中的潜力和面临的混杂因素挑战，为未来生态遥感监测提供了重要的基准和防范偏差的指南。

title: DynaForcing: Overcoming Dynamic Collapse in Self-Forcing Distillation for Streaming Avatar Generation
comments: Accepted at ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
summary:
Audio-driven avatar generation requires realistic lip-sync, expressive motion, and real-time streaming. Recent work achieves the latter via self-forcing with Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), but this paradigm suffers from a critical failure that has not been systematically characterized: dynamic collapse, where the student model converges to a near-static optimum with high perceptual quality but severely suppressed temporal dynamics. We trace this to two causes: the reverse KL objective in DMD, which biases toward low-motion modes, and unanchored self-conditioning, which creates a feedback loop that amplifies collapse. This is especially harmful for avatars, where even subtle motion loss breaks lip-sync and expression.
  To address this, we propose DynaForcing, a training framework with three complementary strategies applied at different levels. Specifically, Hybrid Forcing anchors rollouts to ground-truth dynamics at the data level to break the feedback loop. Dynamics-Aware Reward Regularization introduces explicit motion rewards via the RL interpretation of DMD to counteract the reverse KL bias at the loss level. Reference Perturbation perturbs reference images to decouple identity from static details, forcing the model to rely on audio for motion at the conditioning level. We further introduce computation graph pruning and gradient replay, reducing the GPU footprint of self-forcing by over an order of magnitude. Experiments show that DynaForcing recovers dynamics to teacher-comparable levels (Dyn-Deg: 0.31 -> 0.73, Sync-C: 7.03 -> 7.68) while improving visual quality, resolving the quality-dynamics trade-off throughout training without early stopping.
comment: Accepted at ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)

AI.title_translation: DynaForcing：克服流媒体虚拟形象生成中自强制蒸馏的动态崩溃
AI.tldr: DynaForcing解决了音频驱动虚拟形象生成中自强制蒸馏的动态崩溃问题，通过多策略训练框架恢复了动态性并提高了视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动的虚拟形象生成需要实时流媒体、逼真的唇语同步和富有表现力的动作。现有通过分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）实现自强制的方法存在“动态崩溃”问题，即学生模型收敛到近乎静态的最优解，导致时间动态性严重受损，影响唇语同步和表情。本文旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了DynaForcing训练框架，包含三个互补策略：1. 混合强制（Hybrid Forcing）：在数据层面将生成过程锚定到真实动态，打破反馈循环。2. 动态感知奖励正则化（Dynamics-Aware Reward Regularization）：通过DMD的强化学习解释引入显式运动奖励，抵消逆向KL偏差。3. 参考扰动（Reference Perturbation）：扰动参考图像，将身份与静态细节解耦，迫使模型依赖音频生成动作。此外，还引入了计算图剪枝和梯度重放，显著减少了自强制的GPU占用。
AI.result: 实验表明，DynaForcing将动态性恢复到与教师模型相当的水平 (Dyn-Deg: 0.31 -> 0.73, Sync-C: 7.03 -> 7.68)，同时提高了视觉质量，解决了训练过程中质量-动态性之间的权衡，无需提前停止。
AI.conclusion: DynaForcing成功克服了自强制蒸馏中的动态崩溃问题，显著提升了音频驱动虚拟形象生成的动态性和视觉质量，并提高了训练效率。
AI.translation:
音频驱动的虚拟形象生成需要逼真的唇语同步、富有表现力的动作和实时流媒体。最近的工作通过分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）的自强制实现了后者，但这种范式存在一个尚未系统性描述的关键缺陷：动态崩溃，即学生模型收敛到一个具有高感知质量但时间动态性严重受抑制的近静态最优解。我们将此归因于两个原因：DMD中的逆向KL目标，它偏向于低运动模式；以及未锚定的自条件作用，它创建了一个放大崩溃的反馈循环。这对于虚拟形象尤其有害，因为即使是细微的运动损失也会破坏唇语同步和表情。
为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DynaForcing，一个在不同层面应用三种互补策略的训练框架。具体来说，混合强制（Hybrid Forcing）在数据层面将生成过程锚定到真实动态，以打破反馈循环。动态感知奖励正则化（Dynamics-Aware Reward Regularization）通过DMD的强化学习解释引入显式运动奖励，以抵消损失层面的逆向KL偏差。参考扰动（Reference Perturbation）扰动参考图像，将身份与静态细节解耦，迫使模型依赖音频进行条件性层面的运动。我们进一步引入了计算图剪枝和梯度重放，将自强制的GPU占用量减少了一个数量级以上。实验表明，DynaForcing将动态性恢复到与教师模型相当的水平（Dyn-Deg: 0.31 -> 0.73, Sync-C: 7.03 -> 7.68），同时提高了视觉质量，在整个训练过程中解决了质量-动态性权衡问题，无需提前停止。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DynaForcing框架，旨在解决音频驱动虚拟形象生成中自强制蒸馏的动态崩溃问题。该问题导致模型生成缺乏时间动态性。DynaForcing通过混合强制、动态感知奖励正则化和参考扰动这三种策略，在数据、损失和条件层面分别解决了动态崩溃的根本原因。此外，它还通过计算图剪枝和梯度重放显著优化了训练效率。实验证明，DynaForcing能有效恢复模型动态性至教师模型水平，同时提升视觉质量，解决了长期存在的质量与动态性之间的权衡。
AI.keywords: DynaForcing, 动态崩溃, 自强制蒸馏, 虚拟形象生成, 音频驱动
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过系统性地识别并解决了自强制蒸馏中的“动态崩溃”这一关键问题，为音频驱动虚拟形象生成领域带来了重要进展。其创新点在于从多个层面（数据、损失、条件）提出互补策略来对抗动态崩溃，并显著优化了训练资源消耗。这对于实现更真实、更具表现力的实时虚拟形象具有重要意义。

title: Accuracy and Robustness of Model Cascades Under Data Perturbations
summary: Prediction cascades significantly reduce energy consumption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) models while maintaining high predictive performance. The idea is that easy inputs are routed through a lightweight small model, and difficult uncertain cases are deferred to a larger model. While this design can improve computational efficiency on clean data, its effectiveness depends on the reliability of confidence-based routing. Input degradations, such as static corruptions and sequential perturbations, can shift model confidence and routing decisions. In this paper, we study confidence-based cascade frameworks for image classification and investigate how such degradations affect their confidence-based deferral behavior. We select a model cascade at the pareto-optimum of accuracy, routing quality, and energy consumption that achieves competitive predictive performance with an up to 10-fold decrease in CO$_2$ emissions. We study the behavior of that model cascade under input corruptions and analyze how the cascade's routing decisions change when the input distribution shifts. Our analysis identifies three failure modes. Static corruptions either (1) break the routing signal while the large model remains useful, or (2) degrade both models so deferral no longer recovers accuracy. Sequential perturbations reveal a third mode: predictions stabilize but deferral suppresses, yielding stable but unreliable predictions. These findings demonstrate that energy efficient model cascades require evaluation beyond clean accuracy, with explicit attention to routing reliability under distribution shift.

AI.title_translation: 模型级联在数据扰动下的准确性和鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 模型级联通过将简单输入路由到小型模型、复杂输入路由到大型模型来提高能效，但其有效性依赖于置信度路由的可靠性。输入扰动会改变置信度，影响路由决策。研究发现，静态扰动会破坏路由信号或同时损害两个模型，而顺序扰动会产生稳定但不可靠的预测。因此，能效模型级联需要在干净数据准确性之外，特别关注分布偏移下的路由可靠性。
AI.motivation: 提高AI模型能效，同时保持高预测性能，并研究输入扰动对模型级联置信度路由的影响。
AI.method: 选择一个在准确性、路由质量和能耗方面达到帕累托最优的模型级联，研究该级联在输入损坏下的行为，并分析输入分布偏移时级联的路由决策如何变化。
AI.result: 识别出三种失效模式：1. 静态损坏破坏路由信号，但大型模型仍可用；2. 静态损坏同时损害两个模型，导致无法通过延期恢复准确性；3. 顺序扰动导致预测稳定但延期受抑制，产生稳定但不可靠的预测。
AI.conclusion: 能效模型级联的评估需要超越干净数据的准确性，并特别关注在分布偏移下的路由可靠性。
AI.translation: 预测级联在显著降低人工智能（AI）模型能耗的同时，保持了高预测性能。其思想是将容易的输入通过一个轻量级的小型模型处理，而将困难的、不确定的情况推迟给一个更大的模型。虽然这种设计可以提高在干净数据上的计算效率，但其有效性取决于基于置信度的路由的可靠性。输入退化，如静态损坏和顺序扰动，会改变模型置信度和路由决策。在本文中，我们研究了用于图像分类的基于置信度的级联框架，并探讨了这种退化如何影响其基于置信度的推迟行为。我们选择了一个在准确性、路由质量和能耗的帕累托最优处达到平衡的模型级联，该级联实现了具有高达10倍二氧化碳排放量减少的竞争性预测性能。我们研究了该模型级联在输入损坏下的行为，并分析了当输入分布发生变化时，级联的路由决策如何变化。我们的分析确定了三种失效模式。静态损坏要么（1）破坏路由信号，而大型模型仍然有用，要么（2）同时损害两个模型，导致推迟不再能恢复准确性。顺序扰动揭示了第三种模式：预测稳定但推迟受到抑制，产生稳定但不可靠的预测。这些发现表明，能耗高效的模型级联需要超越干净准确性的评估，并特别关注在分布偏移下的路由可靠性。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了预测级联在图像分类中的准确性和鲁棒性，特别关注输入扰动对其置信度路由的影响。研究发现，静态和顺序扰动会以不同方式破坏级联的有效性，导致准确性下降或产生不可靠的预测。研究结果强调了在设计能效模型级联时，必须考虑输入分布偏移下的路由可靠性。
AI.keywords: 模型级联,置信度路由,输入扰动,鲁棒性,能效
AI.comments: 该研究对模型级联的鲁棒性进行了重要的分析，揭示了在实际应用中可能遇到的挑战。然而，文中并未详细说明用于评估的“静态损坏”和“顺序扰动”的具体类型和参数，这可能会限制结果的可复现性。此外，虽然提到了帕累托最优，但具体的最优点选择标准和过程可以更清晰地阐述。

title: Cross-View Correspondence Is a Measurement Intervention: Two-Sided Validation for Agent Evaluation and Credit Assignment
summary: Agent evaluations and trace-based learning often compare outputs across transformed views through a post-response correspondence treated as neutral preprocessing. We show that this correspondence is a measurement intervention: omitting it can manufacture sensitivity, an over-aggressive map can manufacture invariance, and multiple optimal correspondences can leave mechanism labels and signed learning credit unidentified. We develop a validity theory and audit with three components: two-sided validation of nuisance removal and response preservation, all-optima identification of downstream conclusions, and uncertainty propagation after validity is established. We characterize the linear feasibility boundary for response-preserving nuisance removal, compute sharp ranges over exact-optimum correspondence sets, and give a distribution-free certificate that retains a credit coordinate only when all exact optima agree on its nonzero sign. Across public code and SQL pipelines, two deterministic optimal tracebacks disagree on temporal localization for 55.9% of 1,586 nonzero trajectory pairs; two frozen 800-rollout tool-use audits, including a task-and-seed-disjoint replication, expose exact-optimum reversals of intended turn-level credit, although a clean public quick-start subset shows none. A pre-registered transport gate failed on natural responses; frozen corrected and held-out controls then show that a map calibrated only on benign examples erases every retained harmful response, while two-sided validation selects response-preserving alternatives. Cross-view correspondence must therefore be declared, validated, and propagated into uncertainty before agent evaluation or credit assignment supports a point conclusion.

AI.title_translation: 跨视角对应关系是一种测量干预：用于智能体评估和信用分配的双边验证
AI.tldr: 跨视角对应关系并非中立的预处理，而是一种测量干预，本文为此开发了双边验证与审计理论以确保智能体评估和信用分配的准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体评估和基于轨迹的学习常将跨视角输出的对应关系视为中立的预处理，本文旨在指出这种做法的问题并建立严格的有效性理论。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含三个组件的有效性理论与审计： nuisance 移除与响应保留的双边 validation、下游结论的全 optima 识别、以及建立有效性后的不确定性传播。
AI.result: 在公共代码和 SQL 管道中，确定性回溯在 55.9% 的轨迹对上存在时间定位分歧；在工具使用审计中暴露了精确最优的信用反转；双边验证能够成功筛选出响应保留的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 跨视角对应关系不能被视为中立的预处理，必须进行声明、验证并传播到不确定性中，才能支持智能体评估或信用分配的点结论。
AI.translation: 智能体评估和基于轨迹的学习通常通过被视为中立预处理的响应后对应关系来比较变换视角下的输出。我们表明，这种对应关系是一种测量干预：省略它可能会制造敏感性，过于激进的映射可能会制造不变性，而多个最优对应关系可能会使机制标签和有符号的学习信用无法识别。我们开发了一个包含三个组件的有效性理论与审计：nuisance 移除和响应保留的双边验证、下游结论的全最优识别，以及在确立有效性后的不确定性传播。我们刻画了响应保留的 nuisance 移除的线性可行性边界，计算了精确最优对应集上的尖锐范围，并给出了一个免分布证书，该证书仅在所有精确最优解同意其非零符号时才保留信用坐标。在公共代码和 SQL 管道中，两个确定的最优回溯对 1,586 个非零轨迹对中的 55.9% 在时间定位上存在分歧；两个冻结的 800 次 rollout 工具使用审计（包括任务和种子不相交的复制）暴露了预期轮次级信用的精确最优反转，尽管一个干净的公共快速入门子集没有显示出这一点。预注册的传输门在自然响应上失效；冻结的校正和留出对照随后表明，仅在良性示例上校准的映射会擦除每一个保留的有害响应，而双边验证选择响应保留的替代方案。因此，在智能体评估或信用分配支持点结论之前，必须声明、验证跨视角对应关系，并将其传播到不确定性中。
AI.summary: 本文指出跨视角对应关系实际上是一种测量干预，若处理不当会导致敏感度或不变性失真。为此，作者开发了一套包含双边验证、全最优识别和不确定性传播的有效性理论与审计框架，并通过实验证明了其在智能体评估和信用分配中的必要性。
AI.keywords: 智能体评估, 信用分配, 跨视角对应, 测量干预, 有效性理论
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将跨视角对应关系建模为一个测量干预，并提出了双边验证、全最优识别和不确定性传播的有效性理论，对智能体评估和信用分配具有重要意义。

title: CompCPZ: Preserving Multi-Modal Intent in Language-Guided Robot Manipulation
summary: A robot asked to "place the cup near the red plate or the blue plate" may reach the centroid between them and appear geometrically successful, while satisfying neither disjunct of the instruction. This silent semantic failure exposes a structural limitation of language-conditioned robot policies: representations that collapse a disjunctive instruction into a single connected set cannot preserve all feasible modes, and planners that commit to one action degrade under run-time mode uncertainty. We address this limitation with CompCPZ, a sound algebraic layer that language-conditioned learning systems wrap to recover multi-modal disjunctive representation, recursively composing per-primitive constrained polynomial zonotope enclosures along the language parse tree with distribution-free conformal coverage and sub-millisecond runtime. On a closed-loop ManiSkill3 tabletop-manipulation benchmark, CompCPZ outperforms convex set baselines, multi-peak decoders, and a zero-shot vision-language-action model (1,900/1,918 paired wins, p << 10^(-30)); the same compiler also transfers without retuning to planar real-robot trials on a Unitree Go2 quadruped under motion capture. These results suggest that compositional language grounding should be evaluated not only by reaching a decoded target, but by whether the represented feasibility set preserves the connected-component structure of the user's intent.

title: Beyond Suspicious Steps: Ontological Trust in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly operate across many steps, tools, and observa- tions. In this setting, the relevant oversight question is not only whether each action is locally valid, but whether the evolving trajectory still corresponds to the task the user authorized. Drift can accumulate quietly: an agent may call the right tool with plausible arguments at every step, while its prefix moves toward a broader role, an adjacent objective, or evidence the user never supplied. Existing monitors mostly check local compliance, deliver final-trace verdicts, or score generic risk; they do not directly estimate this prefix-level relation. We introduce ontological trust, a task-conditioned property of trajectory prefixes, and instantiate it as RGE, an online monitor that decomposes trust along Role, Goal, and Evidence. RGE uses LLMs only to derive structured task and step representations; trust-state updates, projec- tions, and intervention decisions are deterministic, so the output is a replayable and auditable trust trajectory rather than a single end-to-end judge verdict. We construct a cross-domain trajectory corpus from OSWorld, FinanceBench, and EICU-AC, covering benign executions, prefix-paired drift, and pseudo-consistency failures. On this corpus, RGE outperforms adapted rule-, judge-, and shield-style baselines on prefix-paired drift detection. With the two larger estimator models, it exceeds 93% Drift F1 on every benchmark while keeping benign coverage at or above 95.8%. Pseudo-consistency is harder: detection depends on whether task completion is externally visible, a structural limit we characterize empirically.

title: What Aggregate Scores Miss: Measuring Item-Level Regressions in Commercial LLM API Migrations
summary: Context: Software systems that depend on commercial large language model APIs must migrate to successor versions when vendors deprecate older models. Migration decisions typically rely on aggregate benchmark scores, which compress heterogeneous item-level behaviour into a single net figure. Objective: We measure what that compression conceals. Method: On three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence, we query 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad mathematics, instruction following) 50 times per item per model, classify each item as reliably improved, reliably regressed, practically equivalent, or inconclusive under false-discovery-rate control and a practical-significance threshold, and calibrate the results against a label-permutation null. Results: Across all nine migration-benchmark cells, reliable improvements and reliable regressions coexist. Edges with aggregate gains of up to 7.3 percentage points contain up to 8.3% reliably regressed items; edges with aggregate losses contain up to 10.7% reliably improved items. On the instruction-following benchmark, the gap between strict and loose scoring widens by 3.9 percentage points on the latest migration: a 3.9-point regression under strict scoring shrinks to 0.04 points under loose scoring. Conclusion: Migration decisions based on aggregate scores alone miss substantial bidirectional item-level change. The complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs are released.

title: MemCatalyst: Amplifying Data Auditing on Vision-Language Models via Data Poisoning
summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) achieve outstanding performance largely due to the amount of training data available on the internet. At the same time, data holders (e.g., artists) urgently need to determine whether their data has been used for model training without authorization, which concerns both intellectual property rights and personal privacy. Data auditing, particularly through membership inference (MI), has attracted attention as a direct tool. This work proposes MemCatalyst, a set of data poisoning tools, aiming to amplify the data auditing performance on VLMs. MemCatalyst employs two strategies: Poisoning Text (PT) and Poisoning Image (PI). MemCatalyst forces VLMs to over-learn specific inconsistencies between image features and textual semantics during training, thereby increasing their susceptibility to membership information auditing. Crucially, the transferability of poisoned samples across different VLM architectures is demonstrated to be effective in the black-box setting. Extensive evaluations using five state-of-the-art data audits on two prominent VLMs demonstrate that MemCatalyst markedly enhances MI AUC scores with a minimal budget of poisoned samples, while maintaining a negligible impact on model performance.

title: Vision-Language Models for Analog Gauge Reading: An Empirical Study of Specialization, Transfer and Reliability
comments: Submitted to Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Analog gauges remain common in industrial environments where manual inspection is costly or hazardous. The engineering application addressed here is direct numerical reading of single-target analog-gauge images, while the artificial-intelligence contribution is a systematic evaluation of specialization, transfer, robustness and reliability for a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) without an explicit pointer-segmentation and geometric-reading pipeline. The Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model is evaluated using zero-shot prompting, in-context learning (ICL) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning with Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) on a public synthetic dataset, a video-derived Pressure Gauge dataset and a proprietary industrial dataset. All fine-tuning experiments use a fixed 20-epoch protocol with the final epoch used for analysis; separate models with and without supplied gauge ranges remove prompt-setting confounds. The primary metric is range-normalized mean percentage error (MPE). The best fine-tuned MPE values are 2.39% on the synthetic dataset, with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval (CI) of 1.43-3.90%; 2.61% on the Pressure Gauge dataset, with a CI of 1.66-3.80%; and 4.43% on the proprietary industrial dataset, with a CI of 2.31-7.14%. Leave-one-dataset-out experiments reveal substantial transfer degradation on held-out synthetic and proprietary data, while robustness tests identify Gaussian blur as the strongest tested corruption. Reliability analysis shows that high-confidence errors remain possible, motivating abstention and independent validation in safety-critical use. These results support QLoRA-specialized VLMs for direct single-gauge reading but not yet a deployment-ready plant-monitoring pipeline.
comment: Submitted to Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence

AI.title_translation: 用于模拟仪表读数的视觉语言模型：专业化、迁移和可靠性的实证研究
AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型在模拟仪表读数任务上的专业化、迁移和可靠性，发现QLoRA微调的VLM在直接单仪表读数方面表现良好，但尚未达到可部署的水平。
AI.motivation: 在工业环境中，手动检查模拟仪表既昂贵又危险。本研究旨在解决直接从模拟仪表图像中读取数值的工程应用问题，并系统评估通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在这一任务上的专业化、迁移、鲁棒性和可靠性。
AI.method: 研究使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型，通过零样本提示、上下文学习（ICL）和使用量化低秩适应（QLoRA）的参数高效微调进行评估。实验在公共合成数据集、视频衍生的压力表数据集和专有工业数据集上进行，所有微调实验均采用固定的20个epoch协议，并使用范围归一化平均百分比误差（MPE）作为主要指标。
AI.result: 最佳微调MPE值在合成数据集上为2.39%（95% CI: 1.43-3.90%），在压力表数据集上为2.61%（95% CI: 1.66-3.80%），在专有工业数据集上为4.43%（95% CI: 2.31-7.14%）。留一数据集实验显示，在保留的合成和专有数据上存在显著的迁移退化。鲁棒性测试表明高斯模糊是最强的损坏。可靠性分析显示高置信度错误仍然可能发生。
AI.conclusion: QLoRA专业化的VLM支持直接的单仪表读数，但尚未达到可部署的工厂监控管道的水平，在安全关键应用中仍需人工干预和独立验证。
AI.translation: 模拟仪表在工业环境中仍然很常见，而人工检查既昂贵又危险。本文解决的工程应用是直接对单目标模拟仪表图像进行数值读取，而人工智能的贡献是对通用视觉语言模型（VLM）的专业化、迁移、鲁棒性和可靠性进行系统评估，而无需显式的指针分割和几何读取管道。使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型通过零样本提示、上下文学习（ICL）和使用量化低秩适应（QLoRA）的参数高效微调进行评估，评估对象是公共合成数据集、视频衍生的压力表数据集和专有工业数据集。所有微调实验均采用固定的20个epoch协议，并使用最后一个epoch进行分析；提供和不提供仪表范围的独立模型消除了提示设置混淆。主要指标是范围归一化平均百分比误差（MPE）。最佳微调MPE值在合成数据集上为2.39%，95%的自举置信区间（CI）为1.43-3.90%；在压力表数据集上为2.61%，CI为1.66-3.80%；在专有工业数据集上为4.43%，CI为2.31-7.14%。留一数据集实验表明，在保留的合成和专有数据上存在显著的迁移退化，而鲁棒性测试识别出高斯模糊是最强的测试损坏。可靠性分析表明，高置信度错误仍然可能发生，这促使在安全关键用途中采取回避和独立验证措施。这些结果支持QLoRA专业化的VLM用于直接单仪表读数，但尚未支持可部署的工厂监控管道。
AI.summary: 本研究对视觉语言模型（VLM）在模拟仪表读数任务中的专业化、迁移和可靠性进行了实证评估。通过零样本、上下文学习和QLoRA微调，在多个数据集上测试了Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型。结果显示，微调后的模型在读数精度上表现良好，但存在跨数据集迁移退化和鲁棒性问题，尤其是在高斯模糊下。研究强调了在安全关键应用中，尽管模型表现出色，仍可能出现高置信度错误，需要进一步的验证和人工干预，表明模型尚未完全达到部署要求。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 模拟仪表读数, QLoRA, 专业化, 迁移, 可靠性
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于系统性地评估了通用VLM在模拟仪表读数这一特定工业应用中的性能，尤其是在没有显式指针分割和几何读取管道的情况下。它展示了QLoRA微调在提升VLM专业化方面的潜力，同时也明确指出了模型在迁移能力、鲁棒性和可靠性方面的局限性，特别是在安全关键场景下高置信度错误的风险，这对于实际部署具有重要的指导意义。其局限性在于，尽管取得了良好的精度，但模型尚未达到完全部署就绪的水平。

title: Evaluation of AI-based Visual Crack Detection in Steel Bridges Using Probability of Detection
summary: Bridge structures are regularly inspected for structural damage such as cracks and corrosion in order to ensure public safety and reduce maintenance costs. Much research has been done on automating this process using computer vision methods, which are often evaluated and compared using metrics such as intersection over union, mean average precision, etc. However, predicting the actual effectiveness of an inspection method within the field of structural engineering from these metrics remains challenging. To enable the systematic use of these increasingly popular methods in engineering practice, evaluating the performance of these methods in a way that is compatible with standard engineering approaches is therefore an urgent necessity. We present a new statistical evaluation framework to allow the comparison of computer vision methods with conventional visual inspection for crack detection in steel bridges. The framework is based on probability of detection curves and can account for the influence of image resolution. We apply this evaluation method to the real-world ``Cracks in Steel Bridges'' dataset, which contains annotated images of cracks in bridge structures. The quantification of the probability of detection and its uncertainty enables a practical assessment of the effect of automated methods for damage detection in structural reliability analyses. In turn, this enables the wide-spread use of automated (AI-based) damage detection in safety critical applications. This evaluation method provides evidence that the proposed computer vision approach approach is robust for the crack detection task and can have a high added value as an addition to conventional visual inspection methods.

AI.title_translation: 基于检测概率的钢桥AI视觉裂缝检测评估
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于检测概率曲线的新统计评估框架，用于评估钢桥中基于AI的裂缝检测方法，使其与工程实践兼容，并证明了其稳健性。
AI.motivation: 桥梁结构定期检查裂缝和腐蚀对于公共安全和降低维护成本至关重要。尽管计算机视觉方法在自动化检测方面取得了进展，但现有评估指标（如IoU、mAP）难以准确预测其在结构工程领域的实际有效性。因此，迫切需要一种与标准工程方法兼容的评估方式，以促进这些日益流行的AI方法在工程实践中的系统应用。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新的统计评估框架，用于比较计算机视觉方法与传统视觉检查在钢桥裂缝检测中的性能。该框架基于检测概率（POD）曲线，并能考虑图像分辨率的影响。研究将此评估方法应用于真实的“钢桥裂缝”数据集。
AI.result: 该方法量化了检测概率及其不确定性，从而能够实际评估自动化方法在结构可靠性分析中进行损伤检测的效果。结果表明，所提出的计算机视觉方法对于裂缝检测任务是稳健的，并且作为传统视觉检查方法的补充，具有很高的附加价值。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于检测概率曲线的统计评估框架，为AI辅助钢桥裂缝检测提供了一种实用且稳健的评估方法。这使得自动化方法能够更好地融入安全关键应用和结构可靠性分析，并作为传统检查的有效补充。
AI.translation: 桥梁结构定期检查裂缝和腐蚀等结构损伤，以确保公共安全并降低维护成本。计算机视觉方法在自动化这一过程方面已进行了大量研究，这些方法通常使用交并比、平均精度等指标进行评估和比较。然而，从这些指标预测结构工程领域中检测方法的实际有效性仍然具有挑战性。为了使这些日益流行的方法能够在工程实践中系统地使用，以与标准工程方法兼容的方式评估这些方法的性能因此成为一项紧迫的需要。我们提出了一种新的统计评估框架，以允许将计算机视觉方法与传统的钢桥裂缝检测视觉检查进行比较。该框架基于检测概率曲线，并且可以考虑图像分辨率的影响。我们将这种评估方法应用于真实的“钢桥裂缝”数据集，该数据集包含桥梁结构裂缝的带注释图像。检测概率及其不确定性的量化使得能够实际评估自动化方法在结构可靠性分析中进行损伤检测的效果。反过来，这使得自动化（基于AI）损伤检测在安全关键应用中得到广泛使用。这种评估方法提供的证据表明，所提出的计算机视觉方法对于裂缝检测任务是稳健的，并且作为传统视觉检查方法的补充，可以具有很高的附加价值。
AI.summary: 本文针对AI在钢桥裂缝检测中实际应用评估的不足，提出了一种新的统计评估框架。该框架基于检测概率（POD）曲线并考虑图像分辨率，旨在使AI方法与标准工程实践兼容，并允许与传统视觉检查进行系统比较。通过在真实数据集上的应用，研究量化了检测概率及其不确定性，证明了AI方法在裂缝检测中的稳健性和高附加值，有助于其在结构可靠性分析和安全关键应用中的广泛使用。
AI.keywords: AI裂缝检测, 钢桥, 检测概率, 结构可靠性, 计算机视觉评估
AI.comments: 本论文通过提出一个与工程实践中既定方法（检测概率）相一致的评估框架，解决了AI辅助检测方法在结构工程领域应用中的关键空白。其创新之处在于超越了典型的计算机视觉指标，提供了一种更实用、更可靠的AI工具评估方式，这对于桥梁检测等安全关键应用至关重要。将AI评估与结构可靠性分析相结合的重点尤其有价值。

title: BullsEye: Directed Firmware Fuzzing
summary:
The widespread adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has expanded the digital attack surface, making firmware analysis critical for modern software security. A key security concern stems from the frequent reuse of third-party software components, a practice that often introduces known vulnerabilities into firmware images. Whether a given image actually exposes such a flaw is an open question, and public proof-of concept exploits make answering it urgent. Directed Greybox Fuzzing (DGF), a technique that enables targeted exploration of specific binary locations, offers a promising solution for detecting such vulnerabilities. However, DGF has reached firmware only at function granularity, too coarse to aim at the vulnerable block itself.
  This article presents BULLSEYE, the first DGF framework to schedule closed-source Linux-based firmware fuzzing by basic-block-level distance to user-specified targets. Our methodology combines static and dynamic analysis to enable DGF in the constrained firmware domain, focusing on vulnerabilities in reused third-party components. We introduce novel DGF heuristics that address limitations of traditional approaches. We compare BULLSEYE against four greybox-fuzzing baselines sharing its execution back-end, including reimplementations of AFLGO and WINDRANGER, and against GREENHOUSE, a state-of-the-art firmware re-hosting framework. On 40 vulnerability sites across 32 firmware images, BULLSEYE reproduces every target within budget, against 35 for the strongest of the four baselines, and reduces Time-to-Exposure by a geometric mean of 9.5x to 72.5x over them; against GREENHOUSE, on the 18 targets its pipeline supports, BULLSEYE is faster by a geometric mean of 9.8x.

title: Evaluating the Diversity of AI-Generated Content with Diversity Profiles
summary: Diversity is a fundamental criterion for evaluating generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems, yet its measurement remains inherently ambiguous. Existing approaches typically represent generated samples in an embedding space, compute pairwise distances or similarities, and aggregate them into a single scalar score. Such scalar summaries are convenient, but they often encode different inductive biases and may yield contradictory rankings of the same sample sets. In this paper, we argue that diversity evaluation for AI-generated content is intrinsically under-specified when reduced to a single number. We first review representative diversity metrics, and then diagnose their limitations from two complementary perspectives: an axiomatic analysis showing that no representative scalar metric satisfies all desirable properties simultaneously, and an empirical analysis showing that high-dimensional representation spaces can induce concentrated, modality-dependent distance distributions. To address these issues, we propose diversity profiles: curve-valued, condition-aware summaries that evaluate a parameterized diversity family across a range of thresholds, scales, exponents, or orders under a specified representation and distance or kernel function. Diversity profiles reveal whether a comparison is robust across resolutions or instead depends on an arbitrary parameter choice. We instantiate profiles for several representative metric families and demonstrate their practical use in generative AI evaluation. Overall, diversity profiles provide a more transparent and resolution-aware framework for comparing the diversity of AI-generated content.

title: The Influence of Agent Models on the Complexity of Bus Routing
summary: In bus routing, the task is to plan a bus route in a network with several agents, each of whom wants to travel from a starting point to a destination. A bus route should account for several factors, including agents' cost for reaching the bus stops, their travel time, or the energy consumption of the buses. We study the complexity of several variants of this problem, focusing on how the objective function and the models for agents' walking costs influence the problem complexity. After observing that even the simplest agent cost model leads to hardness on general networks, we consider networks with tree structure. Our main findings are as follows. First, allowing agent-specific cost models leads to hardness even on extremely limited trees such as stars. Second, consistent agent models (where agents differ only in their starting points and destinations) make the problem easier in some cases. Finally, allowing agents to choose between using the bus and walking directly can make the problem considerably harder. Most of our hardness results show not only classical NP-hardness but also parameterized intractability for the natural parameter $k$, the number of bus stops.

title: SpecTrum: Specification-Guided Differential Fuzzing for Ethereum Consensus Clients
comments: 12 pages. Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
summary:
Ethereum's consensus safety relies on independent consensus client implementations agreeing on every state transition. When they diverge due to implementation errors, the network can fork, finality can stall, and severe attacks are possible. To prevent such consensus divergences, Ethereum provides a Python reference implementation (consensus-spec), which acts as a specification, and a hand-crafted official test suite (spectests). However, as an executable implementation, Ethereum's specification defines validity implicitly through runtime behavior. As a result, it lacks a systematic way to ensure that all validity conditions are thoroughly evaluated.
  We present SpecTrum, a framework that addresses this problem in three stages. First, we introduce Consensus-SpecTec, a mechanized specification of the Ethereum consensus algorithm, which makes validity conditions explicit as if-premises. Second, we define premise coverage, a metric that measures which if-premises are evaluated to true and false across spectests. Third, we develop a specification-based test generator that extracts constraints on premises not evaluated to false by spectests and generates inputs to evaluate them. Applying SpecTrum to five major Ethereum consensus clients, we identify 27 cross-client divergence cases, 22 of which cannot be found without the premises inserted in our mechanization. All 27 cases reproduce across fork versions, and extending the mechanized specification to a new fork takes modest effort proportional to the specification difference.

title: Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with a Physics-Informed World Model for Cooperative Mixed Traffic Control
summary: This study investigates cooperative control of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) at partially observable highway bottlenecks in mixed traffic, aiming to mitigate congestion without relying on complete global traffic states or online trial-and-error. We propose a physics-informed world model-based offline multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that reconstructs a physically interpretable global traffic state from local CAV observation-action histories, with coupled macroscopic-microscopic traffic dynamics providing physics-based supervision. A probabilistic ensemble world model learns traffic-state transitions and system rewards, while model disagreement quantifies epistemic uncertainty. Multi-step imagined rollouts with pessimistic rewards and uncertainty-driven truncation are then used for offline policy learning. Experiments in a SUMO-based on-ramp bottleneck using approximately $1\times10^6$ offline transitions show that physics supervision improves state reconstruction and world-model prediction accuracy.

title: Neuro-symbolic learning over OWL 2 DL via consequence-based compilation to differentiable circuits
summary: OWL 2 DL ontologies, grounded in the description logic $\mathcal{SROIQ}$, express large knowledge bases in biomedicine and the Semantic Web. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) learners over description logics either embed the ontology in a continuous space, abandoning classical entailment, or restrict to the Horn fragment $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$, which has a single canonical model. We present Baobab, which compiles a $\mathcal{SROIQ}$ ontology with a finite ABox into a Sentential Decision Diagram (SDD): it saturates a propositional core under a consequence-based calculus and instantiates the remaining $\mathcal{SROIQ}$ features (nominals, number restrictions, and the role axioms) over the active domain. The SDD's evidence-conditioned weighted model count then trains a perception network to recognize real images under partial ABox supervision: on an ontology that exercises every distinctive $\mathcal{SROIQ}$ feature, a CNN learns to read MNIST digits coupled by a successor relation and recovers latent ontology concepts that an independent perception leaves at chance. When the supervision admits several ontology-consistent completions, an independent perception collapses onto one, a reasoning shortcut: we show that a mixture indexed by the query's justifications can represent the calibrated posterior no independent perception can, and that seeding it from the circuit's enumerated completions attains the Bayes-optimal posterior on a real-image MNIST task where single-WMC and learned mixtures (the BEARS-ensemble hypothesis class) do not: to our knowledge the first to characterize and mitigate reasoning shortcuts in a non-Horn description logic. Soundness of the compiler and the representation result are machine-checked in Lean 4. Code is available at https://github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/baobab.

title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
summary: Take three frontier mixture-of-experts models (Alibaba, OpenAI, NVIDIA; 3.6-4.0B active parameters each) and fine-tune them to reason in a low-resource language. On accuracy benchmarks almost nothing happens, and the benchmark itself is noise at this scale: changing only the random seed moves the score by 7.7 points, more than every data and recipe effect we measured. That null is our first result. The real changes live where accuracy cannot see. Base models never think in Greek: 0 of 1,000 reasoning traces, even when the question is Greek, so the model answers correctly while reasoning in a form its user cannot read, audit, or correct. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), every released checkpoint reasons in the language of the question on ~98% of items, one family at 3x fewer tokens, with judged grammaticality improving on all four models and general ability within a few points of each base: nothing was forgotten, and fluency was gained. We propose six behavioural dimensions that make such changes measurable, each gated to reject any metric that correlates with output length, and we report how our own instruments lied: six failures, each caught by a control. What SFT cannot do is fix its own defects: a quarter of answers skip the requested format, answers leak into the reasoning channel, and an explicit "think in English" is obeyed under half the time. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, pre-registered before training, fixes the first two outright (fallback 24% to 2.5%, leak 3.5% to 0.0%, both against a flat random-reward control) and moves the third (+9.1pp), while the Greek reasoning habit survives an accuracy-only gradient untouched. We release five checkpoints. The instruments, the controls and the pre-registration travel to any low-resource language; Greek is the case that let us measure them.

title: TINA+: Probing Residual Visual Knowledge in Unlearned Diffusion Models via Diffusion-Consistent Text-Free Inversion
summary: Although text-to-image diffusion models exhibit remarkable generative power, concept erasure techniques are essential for preventing harmful content. Existing adversarial probes evaluate these methods by testing whether erased concepts can still be recovered. However, existing erasure and probe methods remain largely text-centric, focusing on whether the text-to-image mapping is severed while overlooking whether the corresponding visual knowledge remains. To investigate this question from a visual perspective, we leverage diffusion inversion to probe whether a generative trajectory can reconstruct visual instances of an erased concept. Under a null-text condition, standard inversion avoids the textual pathway but amplifies approximation errors, hindering faithful trajectory recovery. To address this challenge, we introduce TINA+, a diffusion-consistent Text-free INversion Attack equipped with optimization-based inversion. We also find that unconstrained diffusion inversion may discover spurious trajectories, even allowing a randomly initialized diffusion model to reconstruct the target concept. Such trajectories may falsely indicate residual visual knowledge. TINA+ therefore introduces Diffusion-Consistent Trajectory Regularization to suppress this failure mode. By penalizing trajectories that fall far below the expected marginal energy evolution of diffusion, TINA+ suppresses spurious inversion paths while preserving its ability to recover erased concepts. Experiments across twelve erasure methods, four concept-erasure tasks, and different model architectures demonstrate that TINA+ reliably probes residual visual knowledge through diffusion-consistent visual trajectories. These results provide stronger evidence that current methods often obscure concepts by severing text-image links rather than eliminating the underlying visual knowledge.

title: The Curious Case of Exploding DecPOMDPs: Containing the Fire through Policy Counting
comments: Full version including appendix of a paper accepted at the 17th International Conference on Scalable Uncertainty Management (SUM2026) under the same name
summary: Decentralised partially observable Markov decision processes (DecPOMDPs) provide a general framework for modelling multi-agent decision making under uncertainty. However, DecPOMDPs are known to suffer from exponential complexity in the number of agents. One way to combat this intractability in agent numbers is to look at partitions of agents that exhibit a form of symmetry among agents, allowing for a compact encoding by counting. However, a challenge arises as the policy space explodes, even though the model complexity and evaluation cost reduce to a polynomial dependence. In this paper, we redirect our focus from counting agents to counting policies, which actually enables tractability in agent numbers for so called policy-counted DecPOMDPs. Further, we present policy-counted dynamic programming using the compact representation to solve policy-counted DecPOMDPs efficiently.
