title: Statistical Assessments of Representational Reforms: A Case Study from Los Angeles
summary:
Electoral reforms -- including changes to district boundaries, electoral rules, and the size of elected bodies -- are a recurrent feature of American state and municipal politics. The representational impact of such reforms is challenging to assess before they are implemented, and even well-intentioned civic reformers are often surprised by the unintended consequences of changes to the political system.
  We develop a statistical framework for the prospective evaluation of electoral reforms by integrating several modes of analysis: descriptive statistics of the voter file, probabilistic race and ethnicity imputation, ecological inference, and redistricting simulations via ensembles. Together, these tools provide a unified assessment of how proposed reforms affect whose voices are ultimately heard in government. We apply this framework to reforms currently being considered for the Los Angeles City Council, including increasing the number of single-member districts, adopting ranked-choice voting, and introducing multimember districts elected by proportional ranked choice voting. We find that expanding the Council alone is unlikely to substantially improve representation for underrepresented communities. In contrast, eliminating low-turnout primary elections and adopting multimember districts produce larger improvements in representational equity.
  Our analyses were shared with L.A.'s Charter Reform Commission via public testimony in late 2025. Although motivated by Los Angeles, the framework is broadly applicable to evaluating prospective electoral reforms across American jurisdictions.

title: Hardness of approximation for minimum-weight decoding of two-dimensional topological quantum codes
summary:
Efficient decoding is essential for the practical realization of fault-tolerant quantum computers. We study the computational complexity of minimum-weight decoding for topological quantum codes. For surface codes under the depolarizing channel, we consider Minimum-Weight decoding, which seeks a minimum-weight Pauli error consistent with both the $X$- and $Z$-syndromes. For color codes under independent $X$- and $Z$-error models, we consider Separate Minimum-Weight decoding.
  Assuming $P\neq NP$, we establish polynomial additive inapproximability gaps for these problems. Specifically, for the toric code and the $4.8.8$ color code on the torus, no polynomial-time algorithm can always produce a solution whose weight is within $Ω(N^{1/14})$ of the optimum, where $N$ is the number of qubits. For the planar surface code, we obtain an $Ω(N^{1/18})$ gap. Our inapproximability results use Håstad's hardness of approximation for MAX-3SAT.
  Our reduction develops a general, modular framework for embedding logical constraints into coupled primal--dual join problems on a lattice. A key ingredient is a localization argument that controls unintended interactions between different parts of the construction.

title: Stranded credentials: how a skill-signaling market absorbed generative AI
comments: 20 pages, 6 figures. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/GQW9B
summary: Generative AI can now perform many tasks that credentialing institutions count on to assess skill. During the AI era, do credentials retain their signaling value for subsequent performance? Mostly, yes. We audit the 2010-2026 archive of Kaggle, the largest data science competition platform, which ran two evaluation formats concurrently: upload-competitions, which directly score entrants' predictions computed on published data, and code-competitions, which score predictions by executing entrants' code on hidden data. Across 444,698 participations, competition medals predict subsequent leaderboard performance almost entirely in the first year after being earned, in both formats. Fresh medals retained most of their signaling value through the AI transition; credential stocks are only as informative as their replenishment. Although upload-competition medal stocks lost 82% of their informativeness, institutional stranding explains half to three quarters of the loss: upload-competitions had exited for reasons predating AI, and their frozen medal stock aged out under the pre-existing decay pattern. Old upload-competition medals look more valuable only in isolation, by proxying for the rest of the holder's record (e.g., experience). The measured changes are institutional rather than personal: an AI-like working style predicts performance similarly in both formats. The platform's official credential tiers, based on lifetime medal counts, discard 13-16% of the medals' information; an index weighting recent medals more heavily, built on pre-AI-era data alone, outperforms the official tiers in predicting AI-era performance. In conclusion, credentials are informative, perishable, institution-bound, and interdependent; sustaining their value under AI is a high-stakes, socio-economic problem of institutional design.
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/GQW9B

title: Entanglement assisted quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes
comments: cleveref.sty in arxiv.org TeXLive2025 works incorrectly and \Cref refers every Proposition, Remark etc. as Theorem. Choosing TeXLive2023 suppressed this issue, but the PDF could be rendered incorrectly when TeXLive 2023 is removed from arxiv.org
summary:
Quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes are quantum error-correcting codes capable of correcting $δ-1$ qudit erasures within one subset of qudits of cardinality at most $r+δ-1$. In this paper, we introduce the more general framework of entanglement-assisted quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes, assuming that the local recovery operation is assisted by receiver-held qudits that remain unaffected by erasures.
  We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for these codes to satisfy this property. For codes derived from Hermitian or Euclidean constructions, we establish connections between entanglement-assisted quantum and classical notions of $(r,δ)$-local recoverability, and derive a Singleton-like bound. Furthermore, we construct optimal pure entan\-gle\-ment-assisted quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes from several families of classical codes, including bivariate $J$-affine variety codes, BCH codes, and homothetic-BCH codes.

title: Gate-level Implementation and Resource Analysis of Lackadaisical Quantum Walk Search
summary: Lackadaisical quantum walks (LQW) extend discrete-time quantum walks (DTQW) by introducing weighted self-loops, enabling improved spatial-search performance through controlled localization of the walker. Although their theoretical properties and algorithmic advantages have been studied extensively, practical gate-level realizations suitable for execution on quantum hardware remain largely unexplored. This gap limits the assessment of lackadaisical quantum walk search under realistic architectural constraints, noise processes, and resource requirements. In this work, we present a gate-level implementation framework for lackadaisical quantum walk search. The proposed construction encodes the position and coin spaces into qubit registers, and realizes the walk dynamics through oracle, coin, and flip-flop shift operations. We validate the circuit by reproducing the expected search behavior for single and multiple marked vertices and by analyzing the effect of the self-loop weight on the success probability. We further evaluate the implementation under realistic noisy settings using superconducting hardware's noise models and apply noise-mitigation techniques to improve the measured search performance. Logical-resource analysis shows that, for grids ranging from $8\times8$ to $64\times64$, the algorithmic register increases from 9 to 15 qubits, while the transpiled gate count increases from $3.63\times10^{5}$ to $4.38\times10^{6}$ and the circuit depth from $2.13\times10^{5}$ to $2.56\times10^{6}$. Finally, fault-tolerant resource estimates based on a surface-code model using the Microsoft Quantum Resource Estimator demonstrate the substantial space-time trade-off associated with magic-state production.

title: Randomized quasi-Monte Carlo integration
summary: Quasi-Monte Carlo sampling is a numerical integration method that uses points with a space-filling property in $[0,1]^s$ designed to give better estimates than plain Monte Carlo methods do. For integrands of bounded variation in the sense of Hardy and Krause, errors of $O(n^{-1+ε})$ for any $ε>0$ are obtained from $n$ sample points. Randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) points are individually uniformly distributed but collectively space-filling and then independent replications provide variance estimates. For smooth enough integrands the randomization can give a root mean squared error of $O(n^{-3/2+ε})$. This article explains RQMC for a statistical readership recounting some history and presenting some current directions.

title: Policy Optimization and Statistical Inference for Online Contextual Matrix Games
summary: Online decision making often requires navigating a landscape shaped by both dynamic contexts and strategic interactions. In competitive pricing, for example, hotels must account for both dynamic contextual factors and rivals' strategic responses. Existing approaches address only part of this challenge: contextual bandits optimize single-agent decisions using observable features but ignore multi-player interactions, while online matrix games capture strategic behavior through Nash equilibrium but assume fixed payoffs, ignoring contextual information. How should agents act then when strategic payoffs evolve with contextual signals? We introduce \emph{online contextual matrix games} to integrate contextual information into multi-player online games. We further propose \emph{OnGameLearn}, an online learning algorithm that efficiently balances exploration and exploitation across both player actions and contexts. This approach comes with statistical guarantees: tail bounds for the estimated payoff matrix, the convergence of the estimated Nash equilibrium, the asymptotic normality of the parameter estimators, and the sublinear regret bound. We also develop the notion of \emph{policy value} in matrix games and develop a doubly robust, $\sqrt{T}$-consistent estimator for it. Across simulated studies and a real-world hotel pricing application, we find that OnGameLearn effectively navigates the intertwined challenges of strategic and contextual decision-making.

title: A Projected Semiexplicit Integrator for Dissipative Systems with Configuration-Dependent Kinetic Energy: Contact-Herglotz Formulation and Benchmarks
summary: Contact Hamiltonian dynamics gives dissipative mechanics an intrinsic action variable, but explicit contact splittings reach only kinetic energies whose terms are exactly integrable: frozen-coordinate diagonal metrics (the spherical pendulum, a torus particle) are included, while dense metrics with momentum cross terms, with the double pendulum as flagship, are not. We introduce a projected Pihajoki-contact integrator for this non-separable setting, combining phase-space duplication, symmetric projection onto the physical diagonal, and constant-friction damping half-steps, with the action factor carried by an exact Herglotz update. As in the projected extended-phase-space framework it builds on, the construction needs no binding parameter, returns the copies to the diagonal at every step, and confines the nonlinear solve to the $2n$ projection variables. For constant friction the step rescales $ω=dη$ by the exact factor $e^{-γτ}$ when the projection is solved exactly (a classical conformally symplectic identity, realized here for this class), while time-symmetry, consistency, and smoothness yield an $O(τ^3)$ one-step contact-form residual, a bound not specific to the contact form. On the damped double pendulum, spherical pendulum, and torus particle the method is second-order accurate, reproduces the contact decay law, and controls long-time energy and contact drift in coarse or stiff regimes where the Tao baseline and the unprojected average lose the solution. A head-to-head with exact-contactomorphism splittings delimits the niche: where a frozen-coordinate splitting exists it preserves the contact form exactly and wins at matched cost; for the dense double-pendulum metric the realizable alternative is first-order with a prohibitive constant and the projected method prevails. The contact-form estimate is local, one-step, and constant-friction.

title: One-at-a-Time Quantum Guessing: Multipartite Entanglement Beyond MoE Games
comments: 38 pages, 5 figures. Supplemental Code can be found at https://github.com/mas991/One-at-a-Time-Guessing-Games
summary: Multipartite entanglement remains a challenging and not fully understood aspect of quantum information. Monogamy-of-Entanglement (MoE) games have been highly effective for studying limitations on the usefulness of entanglement imposed by monogamy constraints. To better reveal the extent to which multipartite entanglement can be useful, we introduce a class of quantum guessing games, termed One-at-a-Time Guessing (OTG) games. In these games, quantum players individually guess the outcomes of random measurements performed by a referee on a pre-shared entangled state. Unlike MoE games, OTG games select players individually at random according to a specified probability distribution, thereby probing each player's correlation with the referee. We show that, despite monogamy constraints, players sharing certain entangled states can moderately outperform those relying only on classical uncertainty. This advantage arises even in simple OTG games involving only Pauli measurements on qubits, where optimal entanglement increases the winning probability by at least 4%. This contrasts with MoE games, where shared entanglement has been shown in several settings to provide only limited (if any) advantage over classical strategies. We further establish a majorization property: the value of an OTG game respects the majorization ordering of the player-selection probability distribution. We also analyze in detail a two-player OTG game in which the referee measures one of the three Pauli observables on a qubit, and show that it is optimally played using a specific parameterized family of three-qubit $W$-like states. These results suggest that OTG games provide a useful framework for investigating the usefulness of multipartite entanglement in multiparty quantum correlations.
comment: 38 pages, 5 figures. Supplemental Code can be found at https://github.com/mas991/One-at-a-Time-Guessing-Games

title: Expressivity In Multimodal Contrastive Learning
summary: Contrastive learning has become a cornerstone of modern representation learning, powering CLIP-style models that underpin text-to-image generation, vision-language models, and retrieval across a rapidly growing range of modalities. Despite this empirical success, the expressive power of these architectures remains poorly understood. To gain insight, we study expressivity by adopting a population-level, density-estimation viewpoint: each architecture comprises a parameterized set of densities whose parameters may be chosen to approximate the joint distribution of the modalities. This isolates a question of pure representational capacity: which joint distributions can a given contrastive family of parameterizations approximate to arbitrary accuracy? We show that expressivity is sharply architecture-dependent. For two modalities, the simple two-tower CLIP architecture is a universal approximator. A natural generalization of CLIP, widely used in practice when three or more modalities are present, is based on a loss found by summing over all pairwise similarities. This provably cannot represent arbitrary joint distributions, although we prove that it remains expressive enough to match all pairwise conditionals. Motivated by this gap, we propose Hadamard-CLIP, which adds a single learned weight vector on top of the existing encoders and restores universal approximation of the joint for any number of modalities while preserving CLIP's fast, precomputable-embedding retrieval.

title: Completing the Boundary Case of the Mahmoodian-Mirzakhani Conjecture and 117 New Computational 5-Cycle Decompositions of Complete Tripartite Graphs
comments: 15 pages; for associated data files, see https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21882725
summary:
Let $K_{r,s,t}$, with $r\le s\le t$, denote the complete tripartite graph whose partite sets have sizes $r,s,t$. Mahmoodian and Mirzakhani gave three necessary conditions for $K_{r,s,t}$ to admit a decomposition into 5-cycles and conjectured that these conditions are sufficient. One of the conditions is $t\le 4rs/(r+s)$. We prove the conjecture for every odd triple on the extremal boundary $t = 4rs/(r+s)$.
  The proof is constructive. After reducing an arbitrary odd boundary triple to $(r,s,t)=(hga,hgb,hab)$, $a+b=4g$, we give an explicit cyclic decomposition of $K_{ga,gb,ab}$ and use the Mahmoodian and Mirzakhani scaling theorem to supply the common factor $h$. Together with the previously known all-even result, this settles the conjecture for every triple satisfying the boundary condition with equality.
  We also report explicit computer-generated $C_5$-decompositions for 117 odd triples satisfying the necessary conditions, 116 of which are strict-interior cases. To the best of our knowledge, all 117 cases were previously unresolved: no decomposition for any of them had been reported, and none of the 117 triples is covered by earlier existence results, constructions, or their recursive consequences. Moreover, these 117 certificates together with the boundary construction settle every previously unresolved triple satisfying the necessary conditions with fewer than $4400$ edges. Each computation is supplied as a machine-readable cycle-list certificate and can be checked independently by a short Python verifier. We also give a complete human-readable edge-label-matrix certificate for $K_{9,19,23}$.

title: Maximum Tsallis Entropy Distributions for Robust and Efficient Sparse Learning from Correlated Data
comments: 38 pages; thesis manuscript (July 2024); also available at https://doi.org/10.82308/38780
summary: This paper addresses the limitations of Gaussian distribution assumptions in statistical sparse learning, particularly in modeling correlated and heterogeneous data. Conventional Gaussian models often lack robustness towards outliers and underlying distribution assumptions. To overcome these limitations, we propose the use of the $q$Gaussian distribution, derived from Tsallis entropy maximization, as a robust alternative. This is notably relevant in biostatistics, where the presence of correlated observations and heterogeneity, such as in genetic and longitudinal studies, is prevalent. Our contributions include modeling of correlated data through the re-derived multivariate probability density function from Tsallis entropy maximization, thereby addressing the limitations inherent in conventional Gaussian models. Furthermore, we introduce a novel framework that adapts numerical methods designed to find equilibria in flows to tackle composite optimization problems prevalent in statistical sparse learning. Applying this framework to the Hager-Zhang conjugate gradient algorithm \cite{Hager2005}, we develop a numerically stable and efficient algorithm for sparse statistical learning. The $q$Gaussian distribution, informed by the principle of maximizing Tsallis entropy, presents a viable and flexible alternative to Gaussian-based methods. This paper not only contributes to the theoretical understanding of statistical distributions and optimization techniques, but also paves the way for practical data analysis.

title: Minimax Optimal Estimator and Improved Error Rate for the MLE in Logistic Regression with Gaussian Design
summary: We study finite-sample parameter estimation in logistic regression with Gaussian design, where the goal is to estimate $\mathbfθ^*\in \mathbb{R}^d$ with $R=\|\mathbfθ^*\|_2\ge 1$ from i.i.d. samples $\{(\mathbf{x}_i,y_i)\}_{i=1}^n,$ $\mathbf{x}_i \sim N(0,\mathbf{I}_d)$, $y_i\mid \mathbf{x}_i \sim \mathrm{Bernoulli}((1+\exp(-\mathbf{x}_i^\top \mathbfθ^*))^{-1})$. In this paper, we provide the first minimax optimal estimator, and improve on the best known finite-sample error rate for the maximum likelihood estimator (MLE). These two accomplishments are due to a minimax optimal estimator for the parameter norm $R$. First, we establish the minimax lower bound $Ω(\sqrt{R^3/n})$ for norm estimation. We then improve the best known norm estimation error rate of the MLE, i.e., $O(\sqrt{R^3d/n})$ from Chardon, Lerasle and Mourtada (2024), to $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{R^3/n}+R^2d/n)$. The additional term, $R^2d/n$, appears to be the intrinsic bias of the MLE, as evidenced by the high-dimensional asymptotic theory of Zhao, Sur and Candes (2022) and numerical examples. We show that, however, this additional term is not information-theoretically necessary. To this end, we construct an efficient debiased norm estimator that achieves the error rate $O(\sqrt{R^3/n})$ and is therefore minimax optimal. Combining this with the optimal direction estimator given by the MLE, we establish the minimax optimal rate $Θ(\sqrt{Rd/n}+\sqrt{R^3/n})$ for estimating $\mathbfθ^*$, as well as the improved finite-sample error rate $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{Rd/n}+\sqrt{R^3/n}+R^2d/n)$ for the MLE. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed minimax optimal estimators outperform the MLE.

title: Enumerating forcing and strongly forcing (0,1)-matrices
summary: Let $Q$ be a nonzero $s\times t$ $(0,1)$-pattern, and let $m\ge s$ and $n\ge t$. An $m\times n$ matrix is strongly $Q$-forcing if every $1$-entry belongs to an $s\times t$ submatrix equal to $Q$. Let $F^{*}(m,n,Q)$ count these matrices. Put $H=m-s+1$ and $W=n-t+1$. We prove \[ F^{*}(m,n,Q)\ge 2^{HW}. \] Writing $r$ and $c$ for the numbers of nonzero rows and columns of $Q$, equality holds if and only if \[ (H=1\text{ or }r=1)\qquad\text{and}\qquad(W=1\text{ or }c=1). \] Thus the minimum over all nonzero $s\times t$ patterns is $2^{HW}$, attained exactly by singleton patterns when $H,W>1$, and every fixed nonzero pattern has square growth rate $1$. We also refine the count by weight. If $o(Q)$ is the number of $1$-entries of $Q$, then the number of strongly $Q$-forcing matrices at the minimum positive weight $o(Q)$ is $\binom{H+r-1}{r}\binom{W+c-1}{c}$; at every fixed density in $(0,1)$, the logarithmic growth rate is the binary entropy when $m$ and $n$ are comparable. For ordinary forcing, where every $s\times t$ submatrix contains the $1$-entries of $Q$ in their prescribed positions, let $F(m,n,Q)$ be the number of forcing matrices and let $\mathfrak m(m,n,Q)$ be their minimum weight. We prove \[ F(m,n,Q)=2^{mn-\mathfrak m(m,n,Q)} \quad\text{and}\quad 2^{\,mn-\mathfrak m(m,n,Q)+HW} \le F(m,n,Q)F^{*}(m,n,Q) \le 2^{mn}. \] The lower product bound has the same equality cases as the strong-forcing lower bound above, while the upper product bound is attained exactly by singleton patterns. In particular, the product is at least $2$, with equality exactly when $s=m$, $t=n$, and $Q$ is the all-ones pattern.

title: SPACE: Sample-cloud Predictive Adaptive Conformal Ellipsoids for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Modern probabilistic time-series forecasters often express uncertainty through forecast samples. While typically converted into nominal prediction regions using empirical quantiles, these model-implied sets lack formal coverage guarantees and frequently deviate from nominal targets under distribution shift. Existing multivariate conformal methods can calibrate these regions online, but they typically estimate geometry from historical residuals using fixed or accumulating look-back windows. This reliance on the past limits their ability to exploit the instantaneous dependence structure of current predictions and leaves them vulnerable to stale-regime contamination. To address this, we propose SPACE, a conformal wrapper for sample-generating multivariate forecasters. SPACE constructs ellipsoidal joint prediction regions by estimating time-local covariance geometry directly from the current forecast sample cloud, calibrating the region's radius via a dynamic backward window-selection scheme. Across diverse multivariate datasets, probabilistic forecasters, and conformal baselines, SPACE consistently brings realized joint and rolling coverage closer to the nominal target, achieving superior coverage-efficiency tradeoffs relative to competing wrappers.

title: Inductively Scalable, Single-Step Neural Surrogates for Wave-Scattering Inverse Problems
summary: Neural network surrogates are an emerging alternative to traditional electromagnetic wave simulators like finite-difference time-domain (FDTD); their goal is to replace rigorous physical simulations with pre-trained neural networks that solve wave-scattering forward and inverse problems orders of magnitude faster. However, nonrecurrent, single-step surrogates have scaled only to a few tens of simulation variables. Here, we show that this barrier can be overcome by dynamically generating salient training examples during training, rather than randomly sampling the large space of possible examples. We introduce an algorithm that runs in parallel with surrogate training, using gradient ascent to search refractive-index and source configurations for cases where the surrogate disagrees with a full-wave ground-truth simulator. We also use source and ground-truth normalization with an evolving replay dataset to stabilize and accelerate learning. Using this approach, we train a fast, single-step surrogate for two-dimensional wave scattering with up to 41,772 controllable variables, including dense, freely configurable grids of refractive indices and complex-valued sources. The resulting neural surrogate is robustly accurate across diverse structured and unstructured examples and generalizes inductively to larger domains, reaching over 3 million controllable variables without retraining, a $73.8\times$ increase. We demonstrate the surrogate on large-scale forward simulations and inverse design of freeform beam splitters and gradient-index (GRIN) lenses up to 98 wavelengths wide, showing comparable or better performance than FDTD-based designs, with speedups from $1.29\times$ to $26.5\times$. These results demonstrate a practical path toward fast, robustly accurate, inductively scalable neural simulators for photonic inverse design and other wave-scattering inverse problems.

title: A Counting Lemma for Somewhat Restricted 3-APs
summary:
For a prime $p\geq 3$, a somewhat restricted $3$-AP in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ is a triplet $(x,x+a,x+2a)$, where $x\in\mathbb{F}_p^n$ and $a\in \{0,1,2\}^n$. We prove a counting lemma for somewhat restricted $3$-APs in dense sets in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$. More precisely, we prove that for all $α>0$, there exists $β>0$, such that for sufficiently large $n$, if a set $A\subseteq \mathbb{F}_p^n$ has density at least $α$, then it contains at least $β$ fraction of all somewhat restricted $3$-APs.
  Our proof builds on recently developed machinery from [Bhangale, Khot, Minzer, 2026]. Our main new ingredient is an arithmetic regularity lemma for patterns such as somewhat restricted 3-APs. This result is in the spirit of arithmetic regularity lemmas from the theory of Gowers uniformity norms [Green, Tao, 2010] and may be of independent interest.

AI.title_translation: 关于某类受限3项等差数列的计数引理
AI.tldr: 本文为有限域上步长受限的3项等差数列建立了一个计数引理，证明了稠密子集中必定包含正比例的该类等差数列。

title: On the Pseudo-Mixing of Kac's Walk
summary: Motivated by a conjecture of Vaikuntanathan and Zamir, we study the pseudo-mixing of Kac's walk on $\mathrm{SO}(n)$: whether short trajectories are indistinguishable from Haar measure by low-complexity tests. We prove that the first $k$ columns mix in Wasserstein distance in $O(n(k+\log n)\log n)$ steps for fixed accuracy, resolving a conjecture of Oliveira. Combining this with a representation-theoretic variance bound, we show that if $T=ω(nk(k+\log n)\log n)$, then every degree-$k$ polynomial normalized to have unit Haar variance has expectation under the $T$-step law within $o(1)$ of its Haar expectation. As an application, we show that this pseudo-mixing estimate can be used to prove the effectiveness of a fast Johnson--Lindenstrauss transform with the usual target dimension.

AI.tldr: 研究Kac's游走在SO(n)上的伪混合性质，证明了其前k列在Wasserstein距离下混合的速度，并结合表示论方差界，展示了在一定步数下低度多项式与Haar测度的期望接近，应用于快速Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换。
AI.motivation: 论文研究Kac's游走在SO(n)上的伪混合问题，即短轨迹是否能通过低复杂度测试与Haar测度区分开来，其动机是Vaikuntanathan和Zamir的一个猜想。
AI.method: 研究方法包括证明前k列在Wasserstein距离下的混合速度，并结合表示论方差界来分析低度多项式在T步律下的期望与Haar期望的接近程度。

AI.conclusion: 伪混合估计可以用于证明快速Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换在通常目标维度下的有效性。

title: Leveraging generative hallucination and biophysics-informed modeling for unified biomolecular sequence-structure co-design
summary: Biomolecular design underpins applications from molecular recognition to therapeutics and synthetic biology, yet de novo interaction design remains challenging-especially for DNA/RNA, underexplored non-protein modalities with scarce, heterogeneous complex data and sharper geometric and chemical constraints. We introduce MCTH (Monte Carlo Tree Hallucination), an inference-only framework that casts all-atom sequence-structure co-design as uncertainty-aware planning over hallucinated states from pretrained folding and inverse-folding models, with optional biophysical control within the same decision loop. MCTH treats these models as frozen black-box operators and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to allocate a fixed inference budget across competing design trajectories, incorporating model confidence and uncertainty, as well as cross-expert consensus/disagreement when multiple predictors are available. Across protein-RNA, protein-DNA, protein-protein, and protein-ligand design, matched-budget experiments show that adaptive search improves over simpler sampling and cycling strategies, while held-out AlphaFold3 and Chai-1 evaluations demonstrate transfer beyond the search-time oracle. MCTH provides a shared planning layer across modalities while allowing task-specific folding, inverse-folding, and biophysical modules, requiring no fine-tuning or backpropagation through component models.

AI.title_translation: 利用生成式幻觉和生物物理学建模实现统一的生物分子序列-结构协同设计
AI.tldr: MCTH是一个利用预训练模型和蒙特卡洛树搜索进行生物分子序列-结构协同设计的框架，它在多种生物分子设计任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 生物分子设计在分子识别、治疗学和合成生物学中有广泛应用，但从头相互作用设计仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于DNA/RNA等非蛋白质模式，这些模式数据稀缺、异质且具有更严格的几何和化学约束。
AI.method: 本文引入了MCTH（Monte Carlo Tree Hallucination），一个仅推理框架，它将全原子序列-结构协同设计视为基于预训练折叠和逆折叠模型幻觉状态的不确定性感知规划，并可在决策循环中选择性地加入生物物理控制。MCTH将这些模型视为冻结的黑盒操作符，并使用蒙特卡洛树搜索在竞争设计轨迹中分配固定的推理预算，同时考虑模型置信度、不确定性以及多个预测器之间的专家共识/分歧。
AI.result: 在蛋白质-RNA、蛋白质-DNA、蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-配体设计中，匹配预算的实验表明，自适应搜索优于简单的采样和循环策略。AlphaFold3和Chai-1的留出评估也证明了超越搜索时预言机的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: MCTH为跨模式提供了一个共享的规划层，同时允许任务特定的折叠、逆折叠和生物物理模块，无需对组件模型进行微调或反向传播。

AI.summary: 本文提出了MCTH（Monte Carlo Tree Hallucination），一个创新的仅推理框架，用于统一的生物分子序列-结构协同设计。该框架利用预训练的折叠和逆折叠模型产生的“幻觉”状态，结合蒙特卡洛树搜索进行不确定性感知规划，并可整合生物物理控制。MCTH在蛋白质-RNA、蛋白质-DNA、蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-配体设计等多种模式中表现出优越性，无需对底层模型进行微调，为复杂的生物分子设计提供了一个灵活且高效的通用规划层。
AI.keywords: 生物分子设计, 序列-结构协同设计, 蒙特卡洛树搜索, 生成式幻觉, 生物物理学建模
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了MCTH框架，它通过将生成式幻觉与蒙特卡洛树搜索结合，实现了跨多种生物分子模式的序列-结构协同设计。其核心优势在于能够利用现有的预训练模型作为黑盒操作符，无需微调，同时通过不确定性感知规划和生物物理控制提高了设计的效率和质量。这对于数据稀缺且约束严格的非蛋白质生物分子设计尤其重要，为该领域带来了新的范式。

title: Multi-Sensor Edge Angle Detection for Performance Analysis in Ski Jumping
summary: In ski jumping, performance during the gliding phase depends on achieving an aerodynamic posture that maximizes the lift-to-drag ratio. In the V-style technique, the ski edge angle is a key determinant. Reducing the edge angle flattens the skis, increases their effective surface area, and improves aerodynamic lift, ultimately contributing to longer flight distances. Ski edge angles are biomechanically constrained by the limited range of ankle inversion. Current sensing solutions widely quantify these angles using multi-system approaches that combine sensor signals through geometric relations. Such configurations require instrumentation on both the boot and the ski, altering mass distribution, affecting balance during flight, and increasing system complexity. To overcome these limitations, this work presents a wearable sensing system that measures both boot inclination and ski edge angle without modifying the ski surface. Two ultrasonic Time of Flight (ToF) sensors and an in-shoe Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) are integrated into a single boot-mounted unit. Edge angles are estimated by combining ultrasonic distance measurements with IMU data through geometric reconstruction of the boot-ski configuration. Laboratory experiments demonstrate an angle resolution of 0.4500°, a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.2640°, and a coefficient of determination exceeding 99\% when compared with reference measurements, indicating strong linear agreement between the two modalities. The system achieves an end-to-end latency of 30.31 ms, enabling real-time feedback suitable for athlete training, while consuming 1.28 mW of power. With a total weight of only 18.6 g the proposed system enables unobtrusive measurement of ski edge angle and boot orientation.

AI.title_translation: 跳台滑雪中用于性能分析的多传感器刃角检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻巧、可穿戴的多传感器系统，用于实时、无创地测量跳台滑雪中的滑雪板刃角和靴子倾斜度，以克服现有系统的复杂性和对运动员平衡的影响。
AI.motivation: 在跳台滑雪中，滑行阶段的表现取决于空气动力学姿势，其中滑雪板刃角是V字技术中的关键决定因素。减小刃角可以增加升力并延长飞行距离。然而，现有传感解决方案需要在靴子和滑雪板上都安装设备，这会改变质量分布，影响飞行平衡并增加系统复杂性。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种可穿戴传感系统，无需修改滑雪板表面即可测量靴子倾斜度和滑雪板刃角。该系统将两个超声波飞行时间（ToF）传感器和一个鞋内惯性测量单元（IMU）集成到一个靴载单元中。通过几何重建靴子-滑雪板配置，结合超声波距离测量和IMU数据来估计刃角。
AI.result: 实验室实验表明，该系统具有0.4500°的角度分辨率，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.2640°，与参考测量值相比，决定系数超过99%，表明两种模式之间具有很强的线性一致性。系统实现了30.31毫秒的端到端延迟（支持实时反馈），功耗为1.28毫瓦，总重量仅为18.6克。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的轻量级、低功耗、可穿戴多传感器系统能够无创地测量跳台滑雪中的滑雪板刃角和靴子方向，并提供实时反馈，非常适合运动员训练和性能分析。
AI.translation: 在跳台滑雪中，滑行阶段的表现取决于实现最大升阻比的空气动力学姿势。在V字技术中，滑雪板刃角是关键决定因素。减小刃角会使滑雪板变平，增加其有效表面积，并提高空气动力学升力，最终有助于更长的飞行距离。滑雪板刃角受踝关节内翻范围有限的生物力学约束。当前的传感解决方案广泛使用多系统方法，通过几何关系结合传感器信号来量化这些角度。此类配置需要在靴子和滑雪板上都安装设备，从而改变质量分布，影响飞行期间的平衡，并增加系统复杂性。为了克服这些限制，这项工作提出了一种可穿戴传感系统，该系统无需修改滑雪板表面即可测量靴子倾斜度和滑雪板刃角。两个超声波飞行时间（ToF）传感器和一个鞋内惯性测量单元（IMU）集成到一个靴载单元中。通过几何重建靴子-滑雪板配置，结合超声波距离测量和IMU数据来估计刃角。实验室实验表明，角度分辨率为0.4500°，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.2640°，与参考测量值相比，决定系数超过99%，表明两种模式之间具有很强的线性一致性。该系统实现了30.31毫秒的端到端延迟，能够实现适合运动员训练的实时反馈，同时功耗为1.28毫瓦。总重量仅为18.6克，所提出的系统能够无创地测量滑雪板刃角和靴子方向。
AI.summary: 这篇论文介绍了一种用于跳台滑雪性能分析的可穿戴多传感器系统，旨在克服现有刃角检测方法（如改变质量分布和增加复杂性）的局限性。该系统将超声波ToF传感器和IMU集成到靴载单元中，通过几何重建实现对靴子倾斜度和滑雪板刃角的无创、实时测量。实验结果显示，该系统具有高精度（MAE 0.2640°，R² > 99%）、低延迟（30.31 ms）、低功耗（1.28 mW）和轻量化（18.6 g）的特点，非常适合运动员训练的实时反馈。
AI.keywords: 跳台滑雪, 刃角检测, 可穿戴传感, 超声波ToF, IMU
AI.comments: 这项工作提出了一种创新的、无创的、轻量级且低功耗的滑雪板刃角检测解决方案，显著改善了现有方法的不足。其将超声波ToF传感器与IMU数据融合进行几何重建的方法，提供了一种在不影响运动员装备和平衡的前提下进行高精度测量的有效途径。实时反馈能力对于跳台滑雪运动员的训练和技术改进具有重要意义。

title: Nonlocal Transition Kernel for Efficient Learning of Restricted Boltzmann Machines
summary: Learning restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) is computationally challenging because it requires expectations whose exact evaluation is generally intractable. The expectations are typically evaluated using a sampling approximation based on blocked Gibbs sampling (BGS), which is a local Markov chain Monte Carlo transition kernel. However, the locality of BGS can lead to poor sampling quality when the RBM has high energy barriers, thereby degrading learning performance. Deep tempering (DT), which performs parallel tempering over a sequence of learnable RBMs including the training RBM, alleviates this locality issue. However, DT algorithmically requires multiple steps to move through the RBM sequence to achieve a nonlocal transition. In this paper, we propose a transition kernel defined over the RBM sequence used in DT. The proposed kernel has a round-trip structure over the sequence, enabling nonlocal moves within a single transition while leaving the RBM sequence invariant. Numerical experiments show that the proposed kernel performs nonlocal transitions more frequently and achieves higher sampling quality with fewer transitions than BGS and DT. We further verify that learning based on the proposed kernel is more stable and mitigates the training failures observed with BGS- and DT-based learning.

AI.title_translation: 限制玻尔兹曼机高效学习的非局部转移核
AI.tldr: 提出一种新的非局部转移核，用于限制玻尔兹曼机学习，通过单次转移实现非局部移动，提高采样质量，使学习更稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有RBM学习方法（如BGS）因局部性导致采样质量差，深层退火（DT）虽缓解局部性但需要多步才能实现非局部转移，计算效率不高。
AI.method: 提出一种在DT使用的RBM序列上定义的转移核。该核具有“往返”结构，允许在单次转移中进行非局部移动，同时保持RBM序列不变。
AI.result: 相比BGS和DT，所提出的核更频繁地执行非局部转移，以更少的转移次数实现更高的采样质量。基于该核的学习更稳定，并减轻了BGS和DT学习中观察到的训练失败。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新的非局部转移核，通过单次转移实现非局部移动，有效提高了RBM学习的采样效率和稳定性，解决了现有方法的局部性问题和训练失败。
AI.translation: 学习限制玻尔兹曼机（RBM）在计算上具有挑战性，因为它需要精确评估通常难以处理的期望。这些期望通常使用基于块吉布斯采样（BGS）的采样近似来评估，这是一种局部马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗转移核。然而，当RBM具有高能量壁垒时，BGS的局部性可能导致采样质量差，从而降低学习性能。深度退火（DT）通过对包括训练RBM在内的一系列可学习RBM执行并行退火来缓解这种局部性问题。然而，DT算法上需要多个步骤才能通过RBM序列实现非局部转移。在本文中，我们提出了一种在DT中使用的RBM序列上定义的转移核。所提出的核在序列上具有往返结构，能够在单次转移内实现非局部移动，同时保持RBM序列不变。数值实验表明，所提出的核比BGS和DT更频繁地执行非局部转移，并以更少的转移次数获得更高的采样质量。我们进一步验证，基于所提出的核的学习更稳定，并减轻了BGS和DT学习中观察到的训练失败。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种新的非局部转移核，用于解决限制玻尔兹曼机（RBM）学习中现有方法（如BGS和DT）的局部性和效率问题。该核在深度退火（DT）使用的RBM序列上定义，采用往返结构，能够在单次转移中实现非局部移动，同时保持RBM序列不变。实验结果表明，与BGS和DT相比，该核能更频繁地进行非局部转移，以更少的转移次数获得更高的采样质量，并使RBM学习更稳定，有效避免了训练失败。
AI.keywords: 限制玻尔兹曼机, 非局部转移核, 块吉布斯采样, 深度退火, 马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于设计了一个具有往返结构的非局部转移核，在单次转移中实现了传统上需要多步才能完成的非局部探索，显著提升了限制玻尔兹曼机学习的效率和稳定性。它有效解决了BGS的局部性问题和DT的计算开销问题，对RBM及其相关模型的训练具有重要意义。

title: Optimal control of a swimming robot based on Purcell's microswimmer model
summary: Purcell's swimmer is a well-known planar model of a swimming microorganism, governed by low Reynolds number hydrodynamics, which is comprised of three rigid links connected by actuated rotary joints. This model has been analyzed as a robotic locomotion system governed by first-order nonlinear dynamics with a periodic input (gait) of the two joint angles. In this work, we present a robotic macro-scale realization of this three-link swimmer moving in a highly viscous fluid. We propose a simple variant of Purcell's theoretical model with non-slender links and a central rigid sphere which represents the added drag of the robot's central flotation block, and calibrate the model's parameters to fit experimental measurements. Next, we apply optimal control formulation based on Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (PMP) in order to find optimal gaits that maximize the displacement per cycle under bounds on the joint angles. Employing a differential geometric method that transforms the problem to area integral enclosed by the gait trajectory in the plane of joint angles, enables visual interpretation which explains topological changes in displacement-optimal gaits upon varying the bound on the joint angles. We then apply PMP formulation to the problem of maximizing Lighthill's energy efficiency in order to obtain a boundary value problem (BVP) whose solution gives efficiency-optimal gaits for Purcell's swimmer model, as well as its variant with a central sphere. Finally, we utilize numerical methods such as parameterizing the input gait as a truncated Fourier series, as well as GPOPS-II solver, to produce sufficient initial guess values for solving the BVPs and obtaining efficiency-optimal gaits.

AI.title_translation: 基于珀塞尔微型游泳器模型的游泳机器人的最优控制
AI.tldr: 本文实现了珀塞尔三连杆游泳器的宏观机器人模型，并通过最优控制方法（基于庞特里亚金最大值原理）寻找最大化位移和能量效率的最优步态，并利用数值方法求解。
AI.motivation: 实现珀塞尔三连杆游泳器在宏观尺度上的机器人模型，该模型在高粘度流体中运动。通过最优控制方法，寻找能够最大化位移和能量效率的游泳步态，以提高机器人的运动性能。同时，提出并校准珀塞尔模型的变体，使其更好地匹配实验测量结果。
AI.method: 1. 提出了珀塞尔理论模型的一个简化变体，该变体具有非细长连杆和代表机器人中心浮力块额外阻力的中心刚性球，并根据实验测量校准了模型参数。2. 应用基于庞特里亚金最大值原理（PMP）的最优控制公式，寻找在关节角度限制下最大化每个周期位移的最优步态。3. 采用微分几何方法将位移优化问题转化为关节角度平面中步态轨迹围成的面积积分，以解释位移最优步态的拓扑变化。4. 将PMP公式应用于最大化莱特希尔能量效率的问题，从而获得一个边界值问题（BVP）。5. 利用数值方法，如将输入步态参数化为截断傅里叶级数，并结合GPOPS-II求解器，为解决BVP和获取效率最优步态提供足够的初始猜测值。
AI.result: 1. 提出了珀塞尔理论模型的一个简化变体，并成功根据实验测量校准了其参数。2. 通过最优控制方法，在关节角度限制下找到了最大化每个周期位移的最优步态。3. 微分几何方法为位移最优步态的拓扑变化提供了直观的视觉解释。4. 成功推导了珀塞尔游泳器模型及其带有中心球的变体的效率最优步态的边界值问题。5. 数值方法成功应用于求解边界值问题，并获得了效率最优步态。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功实现了珀塞尔微型游泳器模型的宏观机器人版本，并通过结合最优控制理论（PMP）和数值方法，系统地找到了最大化位移和能量效率的最优步态。研究不仅提出了更符合实际的模型变体，还通过微分几何方法提供了对最优步态拓扑变化的深刻理解，为低雷诺数游泳机器人的设计和控制提供了重要的理论和实践指导。
AI.translation: 珀塞尔游泳器是一种著名的平面微型微生物游泳模型，受低雷诺数流体动力学控制，由三个通过驱动旋转关节连接的刚性连杆组成。该模型已被分析为一种机器人运动系统，受一阶非线性动力学和两个关节角度的周期性输入（步态）控制。在这项工作中，我们展示了这种三连杆游泳器在高粘度流体中运动的机器人宏观实现。我们提出了珀塞尔理论模型的一个简单变体，该变体具有非细长连杆和一个代表机器人中心浮力块额外阻力的中心刚性球，并校准了模型的参数以拟合实验测量结果。接下来，我们应用基于庞特里亚金最大值原理（PMP）的最优控制公式，以找到在关节角度限制下最大化每个周期位移的最优步态。采用一种微分几何方法，将问题转化为关节角度平面中步态轨迹围成的面积积分，从而实现视觉解释，解释了在改变关节角度限制时位移最优步态的拓扑变化。然后，我们将PMP公式应用于最大化莱特希尔能量效率的问题，以获得一个边界值问题（BVP），其解给出了珀塞尔游泳器模型及其带有中心球的变体的效率最优步态。最后，我们利用数值方法，例如将输入步态参数化为截断傅里叶级数，以及GPOPS-II求解器，为求解BVP和获得效率最优步态提供足够的初始猜测值。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于珀塞尔微型游泳器模型的宏观游泳机器人，该模型由三个刚性连杆组成，在高粘度流体中运动。作者提出并校准了一个包含非细长连杆和中心阻力球的珀塞尔模型变体，以匹配实验数据。随后，利用庞特里亚金最大值原理（PMP）和微分几何方法，确定了在关节角度限制下最大化位移的最优步态，并解释了其拓扑变化。此外，PMP也被用于推导最大化莱特希尔能量效率的边界值问题，并通过傅里叶级数参数化和GPOPS-II求解器等数值方法获得了效率最优步态。
AI.keywords: 珀塞尔游泳器, 最优控制, 庞特里亚金最大值原理, 游泳机器人, 低雷诺数, 步态优化
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将经典的珀塞尔微型游泳器模型扩展到宏观机器人实现，并结合先进的最优控制理论和数值方法，在游泳机器人步态优化方面取得了显著进展。其创新点在于提出了模型变体以更好地拟合实际，并利用微分几何方法对最优步态进行直观解释。将PMP应用于位移和能量效率的双重优化，为低雷诺数机器人设计提供了全面的优化策略。未来的工作可以探索在更复杂流体环境中的应用或多机器人协作。

title: Online Generalized Sparse Regression: How Does Overparametrization Help?
summary: Regularized sparse regression has been extensively studied in the offline setting, but online formulation remains relatively under-explored. This gap stems from four key challenges: (i) the infeasibility of dynamically updating the regularization parameter in every online round, (ii) managing storage and memory complexity, (iii) enabling real-time computation via closed-form updates rather than solving full optimization problems at each round, and (iv) achieving optimal statistical guarantees under realistic assumptions. In this paper, we propose an online generalized-sparsity-constrained regression framework, focusing on online cardinality-constrained linear regression and low-rank matrix sensing. Unlike online regularized regression, our constrained formulation eliminates the need for dynamic parameter tuning. We introduce an efficient online hard-thresholding algorithm that performs closed-form updates and requires storing only summary statistics, making it computationally, memory, and storage efficient. Despite the inherent nonconvexity and combinatorial nature of the formulation, our algorithm achieves global convergence at the optimal statistical rate under realistic assumptions, provided that the projection set is properly overparameterized. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives.

AI.title_translation: 在线广义稀疏回归：过参数化如何提供帮助？
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于过参数化的在线硬阈值算法，解决了在线稀疏回归中的四大挑战，实现了最优的统计收敛率和高效的计算性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的离线正则化稀疏回归在在线设置下研究相对不足，主要面临动态调整正则化参数困难、存储和内存复杂度高、难以实时计算以及在现实假设下难以获得最优统计保证等四个关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种高效的在线硬阈值算法，采用闭式更新并仅需存储汇总统计量，同时结合了适当过参数化的投影集。
AI.result: 尽管该公式具有内在的非凸性和组合性质，算法在现实假设下以最优统计速率实现了全局收敛，且数值实验表明其性能持续优于现有先进替代方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过提出一种高效的在线硬阈值算法以及利用适当的过参数化投影集，论文成功在在线广义稀疏回归中实现了最优的统计收敛速率和高效的计算性能。
AI.translation: 正则化稀疏回归在离线设置下已被广泛研究，但在线形式仍相对未被充分探索。这一差距源于四个关键挑战：(i) 在每一轮在线中动态更新正则化参数不可行，(ii) 管理存储和内存复杂度，(iii) 通过闭式更新实现实时计算，而不是在每一轮求解完整的优化问题，以及(iv) 在现实假设下获得最优的统计保证。在本文中，我们提出了一个在线广义稀疏约束回归框架，重点关注在线基数约束线性回归和低秩矩阵传感。与在线正则化回归不同，我们的约束形式消除了对动态参数调优的需求。我们引入了一种高效的在线硬阈值算法，该算法执行闭式更新并且仅需要存储汇总统计量，从而使其在计算、内存和存储方面非常高效。尽管该公式具有固定的非凸性和组合性质，但在适当过参数化投影集的条件下，我们的算法在现实假设下以最优统计速率实现了全局收敛。数值实验证明，我们的方法持续优于最先进的替代方法。
AI.summary: 论文针对在线广义稀疏回归提出了一个约束框架，通过引入过参数化的在线硬阈值算法，解决了传统在线正则化回归中的调参、计算及内存瓶颈，并在理论上证明了其全局收敛性和最优统计率。
AI.keywords: 在线稀疏回归, 过参数化, 在线硬阈值算法, 低秩矩阵传感, 全局收敛性
AI.comments: 该论文研究了在线广义稀疏回归问题，创新性地结合了约束范式与过参数化技术，成功解决了传统在线正则化回归调参难、计算复杂度高及统计保证不足的问题。对在线学习和稀疏优化领域具有重要贡献。

title: Agentic Porting, Construction and Initial Verification and Validation of Libraries within the Open Source Unified TRAnsient Multi-Phase Advanced Reactor simulation Kit (Outram Park) Part I: Thermal Hydraulics
summary: Agentic porting of multiple open-source libraries into Rust, with human in the loop, has been performed for construction of modules within the Open-source Unified TRAnsient Multi-Phase Advanced Reactor simulation Kit (Outram Park). With this new methodology, verification and validation with human expertise, rather than code generation has become the bottleneck in developing reliable simulation codes. In this work, we present the porting of OpenFOAM libraries into the Outram-Foam Rust libraries, their preliminary verification and validation (V\&V) efforts, and their subsequent use in the development of open-source two-phase homogeneous-equilibrium (HEM) choked-flow solvers for the Thermo-hydraulic AI Multi-Phase INtegrated Emulator System (TAMPINES) libraries within Outram Park such as tampines-steam-tables. Preliminary V\&V efforts of Outram-Foam show that the cavity and Sod shock tube cases agree reasonably well with literature values. Moreover, the preliminary development of tampines-steam-tables shows good agreement with Moody's HEM charts. Thereafter, the 1D HEM solver, developed agentically, is presented and preliminarily validated against the Edwards blowdown case. Productivity increases were observed with the use of Claude Code, but domain expertise supplied by human experts remains critically required to ensure the generated code can solve the problem effectively. Further work remains to be done in V\&V, but the agentic coding methodology in this paper demonstrates great potential to speed up production and development of open-source libraries such as Outram Park.

AI.title_translation: 开源统一瞬态多相高级反应堆模拟套件（Outram Park）库的代理式移植、构建及初步验证与确认 第一部分：热工水力学
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了将OpenFOAM库代理式移植到Rust中的Outram-Foam库，并在Outram Park框架内进行了初步验证与确认，展示了代理式编码方法在加速开源库开发方面的潜力。
AI.motivation: 为了加速开源统一瞬态多相高级反应堆模拟套件（Outram Park）中模块的开发，本文探索了一种代理式移植多个开源库到Rust中的方法，以期提高模拟代码的开发效率和可靠性。
AI.method: 采用代理式（Agentic）移植方法，将OpenFOAM库移植到Rust中的Outram-Foam库。在此过程中，人类专家参与到验证与确认（V&V）环节。初步的V&V包括对腔体和Sod激波管案例的测试，以及使用Claude Code开发1D HEM求解器并对其进行初步验证。
AI.result: Outram-Foam库对腔体和Sod激波管案例的初步V&V结果与文献值吻合良好。TAMPINES库中的tampines-steam-tables初步开发结果与Moody的HEM图表吻合良好。代理式开发的1D HEM求解器通过Edwards泄压案例的初步验证。使用Claude Code观察到生产力提升，但人类专家的领域知识仍是确保代码有效解决问题的关键。
AI.conclusion: 代理式编码方法在加速Outram Park等开源库的生产和开发方面展现出巨大潜力。尽管V&V方面仍需进一步工作，但该方法有效提高了开发效率，并将人类专业知识的V&V转变为开发可靠模拟代码的瓶颈。
AI.translation: 开源统一瞬态多相高级反应堆模拟套件（Outram Park）中的模块构建，已通过代理式将多个开源库移植到Rust中，并引入了人类参与循环。采用这种新方法，由人类专业知识进行的验证与确认，而非代码生成，已成为开发可靠模拟代码的瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们展示了将OpenFOAM库移植到Outram-Foam Rust库的过程，它们的初步验证与确认（V&V）工作，以及它们随后在开发Outram Park内热工水力AI多相集成仿真系统（TAMPINES）库（例如tampines-steam-tables）的开源两相均质平衡（HEM）阻塞流求解器中的应用。Outram-Foam的初步V&V工作表明，腔体和Sod激波管案例与文献值吻合良好。此外，tampines-steam-tables的初步开发显示与Moody的HEM图表吻合良好。此后，展示了代理式开发的1D HEM求解器，并针对Edwards泄压案例进行了初步验证。使用Claude Code观察到生产力提升，但人类专家提供的领域知识仍然是确保生成代码能够有效解决问题的关键。V&V方面仍需进一步工作，但本文中的代理式编码方法展示了加速Outram Park等开源库生产和开发的巨大潜力。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了将OpenFOAM库代理式移植到Rust中的Outram-Foam库，并将其应用于开源统一瞬态多相高级反应堆模拟套件（Outram Park）中的热工水力学模块开发。研究强调了人类专家在验证与确认过程中的关键作用，并展示了代理式编码方法在提高开发效率方面的潜力。初步验证结果显示，移植后的库和开发的求解器与现有文献及标准吻合良好，但仍需进一步的V&V工作。
AI.keywords: 代理式移植, Rust, Outram Park, 热工水力学, 验证与确认
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种结合代理式编码和人类专家验证的创新方法，用于加速复杂科学模拟库的开发，特别是在核反应堆模拟领域。其重要性在于，它提供了一个提高开发效率的潜在途径，并通过将V&V作为瓶颈，突出了人类领域知识在确保代码可靠性方面的不可替代性。未来，如何更好地平衡自动化与专家干预，以及进一步完善V&V流程，将是关键。

title: Conditional-path Monte Carlo for rare stochastic dynamics on networks: Details and derivations
summary: The simulation of rare macroscopic events in stochastic network dynamics, such as widespread epidemic outbreaks, cascading failures in communication networks, or the escape from metastable states in many-body systems, is severely hindered by methodological challenges like catastrophic rejection rates, weight degeneracy, genealogical correlations, and critical slowing down inherent to standard forward-time algorithms, splitting methods, and transition-path sampling. Conditional-path Monte Carlo (CPMC) overcomes these limitations by employing non-local Swendsen-Wang-like cluster updates that operate directly on full-system trajectories. Serving as the technical companion to [Sun, Moody, and Barthel, arXiv:2608.16171], this paper provides the rigorous mathematical foundations and algorithmic details underlying the CPMC framework. We formally define the joint path-graph probability weights and derive the transition and uniformization sum rules that guarantee detailed balance. Applying the framework to susceptible-infectious-susceptible (SIS) models, we systematically construct and optimize single-node and edge graph vertex sets specifically designed to prevent lock avalanches and maintain the structural mobility of the epidemic trunk. Furthermore, we detail a dynamic programming scheme to exactly implement complex boundary conditions - including patient-zero and macroscopic outbreak-size constraints - enabling the rejection-free generation of valid trajectories. Finally, we assess the computational complexity of the algorithm, describe parallelization strategies, and validate CPMC against exact solutions for dynamics on small networks.

AI.title_translation: 网络上稀有随机动力学的条件路径蒙特卡洛：细节与推导
AI.tldr: 本文提出了条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）算法的数学基础与实现细节，用于高效且无拒绝地模拟网络中的稀有随机动力学事件。
AI.motivation: 标准的前向时间算法、分裂方法和转移路径采样在模拟网络随机动力学中的稀有宏观事件时，面临灾难性的拒绝率、权重简并、家系相关性和临界减慢等严重方法学挑战，需要一种更稳健的计算框架。
AI.method: 开发了条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）框架，引入了非局域的类似Swendsen-Wang的团簇更新操作轨迹，推导了细致平衡的转换和一致化求和规则，并结合动态规划方案处理复杂边界条件。
AI.result: 形式化定义了联合路径-图概率权重，构建并优化了针对SIS模型的图顶点集以防止锁定雪崩，设计了精确实现复杂边界条件的动态规划方案，并通过小网络精确解验证了算法。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）框架的严格数学基础与算法实现细节，为高效模拟网络中的稀有随机动力学事件提供了强大工具。
AI.translation: 模拟随机网络动力学中的稀有宏观事件（如广泛的流行病爆发、通信网络中的级联失效、或多体系统中从亚稳态的逃逸）受到标准前向时间算法、分裂方法和转移路径采样固有的灾难性拒绝率、权重简并、家系相关性和临界减慢等方法学挑战的严重阻碍。条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）通过采用直接对全系统轨迹操作的非局域类Swendsen-Wang团簇更新克服了这些局限性。作为[Sun, Moody, and Barthel, arXiv:2608.16171]的技术伴随论文，本文提供了支撑CPMC框架的严格数学基础和算法细节。我们形式化定义了联合路径-图概率权重，并推导了保证细致平衡的转移和一致化求和规则。通过将该框架应用于易感-感染-易感（SIS）模型，我们系统地构建并优化了单节点和边图顶点集，这些顶点集专门设计用于防止锁定雪崩并保持流行病干线的结构移动性。此外，我们详细说明了用于精确实现复杂边界条件（包括零号病人和宏观爆发规模约束）的动态规划方案，从而实现了无拒绝的有效轨迹生成。最后，我们评估了算法的计算复杂度，描述了并行化策略，并针对小网络上的动力学精确解对CPMC进行了验证。
AI.summary: 本文详细介绍了条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）框架的严格数学基础与算法细节，该框架通过在完整系统轨迹上应用非局域团簇更新，有效解决了网络随机动力学中模拟稀有宏观事件的各类方法学挑战。
AI.keywords: Conditional-path Monte Carlo, stochastic network dynamics, rare events, Swendsen-Wang-like cluster updates, Markov Chain Monte Carlo
AI.comments: 本文作为伴随论文，深入探讨了条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）算法的数学基础与实现细节，通过巧妙的团簇更新和动态规划策略，有效克服了传统稀有事件模拟的瓶颈，具有很高的理论与实用价值。

title: Operator-based data embedding for data-driven control of continuous-time systems from noisy data
summary: We propose a data-driven method for designing state-feedback gains that achieve stabilization, $H_2$-control, and $H_\infty$-control for continuous-time systems. The state-input data are assumed to be corrupted by process noise, measurement noise, and input disturbances. We first characterize the set of all systems consistent with the noisy data using operator-based data embedding. This characterization yields necessary and sufficient conditions for data informativity under a certain class of noise. These conditions are formulated as linear matrix inequalities, and the feedback gains are constructed from their solutions. To enable direct controller design from noisy sampled data for continuous-time systems, we also obtain an upper bound on the reconstruction error of continuous-time signals.

AI.title_translation: 针对连续时间系统噪声数据的数据驱动控制的基于算子的数据嵌入
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种数据驱动方法，利用基于算子的数据嵌入技术，从噪声数据中设计连续时间系统的状态反馈增益，实现稳定化、H2和H∞控制，并通过线性矩阵不等式求解。
AI.motivation: 在状态-输入数据受过程噪声、测量噪声和输入扰动污染的情况下，为连续时间系统设计实现稳定化、H2控制和H∞控制的状态反馈增益。
AI.method:
1. 使用基于算子的数据嵌入来表征与噪声数据一致的所有系统集合。
2. 在特定类噪声下，得出数据信息性的必要和充分条件，并将其表述为线性矩阵不等式。
3. 从线性矩阵不等式的解中构建反馈增益。
4. 获得连续时间信号重建误差的上限，以实现从噪声采样数据直接设计控制器。
AI.result:
1. 使用基于算子的数据嵌入成功表征了与噪声数据一致的系统集合。
2. 得到了在特定类噪声下数据信息性的必要和充分条件，并以线性矩阵不等式形式给出。
3. 能够从线性矩阵不等式解中构建反馈增益。
4. 获得了连续时间信号重建误差的上限，支持从噪声采样数据直接进行控制器设计。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于算子数据嵌入的数据驱动方法，通过线性矩阵不等式求解，在存在噪声数据的连续时间系统中实现稳定化、H2和H∞控制，并考虑了连续时间信号的重建误差。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种数据驱动方法，用于设计连续时间系统的状态反馈增益，以实现稳定化、H2控制和H∞控制。假设状态-输入数据受到过程噪声、测量噪声和输入扰动的污染。我们首先使用基于算子数据嵌入来表征与噪声数据一致的所有系统集合。这种表征在特定类噪声下产生了数据信息性的必要和充分条件。这些条件被表述为线性矩阵不等式，并且反馈增益从它们的解中构建。为了能够从连续时间系统的噪声采样数据中直接进行控制器设计，我们还获得了连续时间信号重建误差的上限。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的数据驱动方法，用于从噪声数据中设计连续时间系统的状态反馈增益，以实现稳定化、H2和H∞控制。该方法利用基于算子的数据嵌入来表征与噪声数据一致的系统，并将数据信息性条件公式化为线性矩阵不等式。通过求解这些不等式来构建反馈增益，并进一步考虑了连续时间信号重建误差的上限，以支持直接控制器设计。
AI.keywords: 数据驱动控制, 连续时间系统, 噪声数据, 算子数据嵌入, 线性矩阵不等式
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将基于算子数据嵌入应用于从噪声数据中进行连续时间系统的控制器设计，并将其与线性矩阵不等式相结合。它解决了数据驱动控制中处理噪声数据和连续时间系统重建误差的关键挑战，对于实际应用具有重要意义。

title: DMT-Dens: Density-preserving manifold visualization for biological data
comments: 22 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables; includes supplementary material. Source code: https://github.com/Ruizhe-wang/DMT-Dens
summary: Motivation: Low-dimensional embeddings are widely used to explore cell-state heterogeneity in single-cell and other high-dimensional biological data. Although many methods preserve local neighborhoods, they may distort the apparent sampling density of processed observations, altering the visual contrast between dense and sparse regions and complicating the interpretation of rare, transitional, or continuous cell-state populations. Results: We present DMT-Dens, a parametric manifold-visualization method built on a latent-token Transformer encoder. The model integrates rank-based manifold alignment with hard-pair aggregation. To preserve density, it optimizes a loss based on the Pearson correlation between k-nearest-neighbor log-radius estimates in the processed input and two-dimensional embedding spaces. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong density preservation, particularly on biological datasets, while retaining competitive label separability. Availability: Source code, data-processing scripts, and resolved experiment configurations are available at https://github.com/Ruizhe-wang/DMT-Dens.
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables; includes supplementary material. Source code: https://github.com/Ruizhe-wang/DMT-Dens

AI.title_translation: DMT-Dens：针对生物数据的保持密度的流形可视化方法
AI.tldr: DMT-Dens 是一种新型的保持密度的单细胞数据降维与可视化方法，能够准确反映细胞状态的真实密度分布。
AI.motivation: 现有的低维嵌入方法虽然能保持局部邻域，但往往会扭曲处理后观测值的表观采样密度，改变密集区域和稀疏区域之间的视觉对比，从而使稀有、过渡或连续细胞状态群体的解释变得复杂。
AI.method: 提出 DMT-Dens 方法，这是一种基于潜在Token Transformer编码器的参数化流形可视化方法，整合了基于排名的流形对齐与硬对偶聚合，并优化了基于输入空间与二维嵌入空间中k近邻对数半径估计之间Pearson相关性的损失函数。
AI.result: 基准评估表明，DMT-Dens 具有很强的密度保持能力（尤其是在生物数据集上），同时保持了具有竞争力的标签可分性。
AI.conclusion: DMT-Dens 成功实现了一种保持密度的流形可视化方法，在生物学数据集上表现出优异的密度保持能力和良好的标签可分性。
AI.translation: 动机：低维嵌入被广泛用于探索单细胞和其他高-dimensional生物数据中的细胞状态异质性。尽管许多方法能够保持局部邻域，但它们可能会扭曲处理后观测值的表观采样密度，改变密集和稀疏区域之间的视觉对比，从而使稀有、过渡或连续细胞状态群体的解释变得复杂。结果：我们提出了 DMT-Dens，这是一种构建在潜在token Transformer编码器上的参数化流形可视化方法。该模型将基于排名的流形对齐与硬对偶聚合相结合。为了保持密度，它优化了基于处理后的输入空间与二维嵌入空间中 k 近邻对数半径估计之间的 Pearson 相关性的损失。基准评估证明了其强大的密度保持能力，特别是在生物数据集上，同时保留了具有竞争力的标签可分性。可用性：源代码、数据处理脚本和已解决的实验配置可在 https://github.com/Ruizhe-wang/DMT-Dens 获取。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了DMT-Dens，一种用于生物数据的保持密度的流形可视化方法。该方法基于潜在Token Transformer编码器，通过优化k近邻对数半径的Pearson相关性损失来保持密度，并在生物学数据集的基准测试中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 单细胞数据, 流形可视化, 密度保持, 潜在Token Transformer编码器, 低维嵌入
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种能够同时保持局部邻域和采样密度的低维嵌入方法，解决了传统降维算法扭曲细胞状态密度分布的问题，对于单细胞生物学数据的可视化和稀有细胞类群的识别具有重要意义。

title: Feature Priming in Online Linear Regression: Sparse-Regret Lower Bounds and a Tight Univariate Rate
summary: In high-dimensional online prediction, the best predictor may depend on only a few features, so regret should scale with sparsity rather than the ambient dimension. Feature priming pursues this goal by estimating feature weights from past data and refitting a minimum-norm predictor on the rescaled design. Warmuth and Amid asked at COLT 2023 whether any of three such rules admits a competitive online regret guarantee. Using the natural Moore--Penrose protocol based only on past data, we give a negative answer to the sparse-logarithmic form of this COLT open problem. Our analysis identifies a common obstruction: cheap nuisance interpolation causes the refit to underweight the truly predictive coordinate. An exact target-mass identity and a two-sign argument turn this effect into clipped prediction loss. Hadamard constructions force $Ω(\min\{T,\sqrt{d}\})$ regret for all three rules against a zero-loss one-sparse comparator, with extensions to fixed prime powers and selectors among the rules. Conversely, regret is controlled by data rank, and a Euclidean-normalized triangular construction matches this dependence for powered univariate priming, even under nonnegative second-stage ridge regularization; a paired ridge construction also covers all three powered rules. Exploratory diagnostics on frozen language-model activations exhibit the same relation among nuisance interpolation, target weight, and loss. The exact multivariate and Pearson frontiers remain open.

AI.title_translation: 在线线性回归中的特征预热：稀疏遗憾下界与紧致单变量速率
AI.tldr: 本文否定回答了COLT 2023关于特征预热稀疏遗憾保证的公开问题，证明了 $\Omega(\min\{T,\sqrt{d}\})$ 的下界，并建立了与数据秩相关的紧致单变量速率。
AI.motivation: 在高维在线线性回归中，希望遗憾界随稀疏度而非环境维度缩放。COLT 2023上Warmuth和Amid提出了特征预热的三种加权拟合规则是否具备竞争性在线遗憾保证的公开问题，本研究旨在探索并回答该问题。
AI.method: 基于仅依赖过去数据的自然摩尔-彭罗斯（Moore-Penrose）协议，利用精确目标质量恒等式和双符号论证，结合阿达马（Hadamard）构造以及欧几里得归一化三角构造与配对岭回归构造进行理论下界与紧致性分析，并在冻结语言模型激活上进行了探索性诊断验证。
AI.result: 对稀疏对数形式的公开问题给出了否定回答，证明所有三种规则针对零损失1-稀疏基准均面临 $\Omega(\min\{T,\sqrt{d}\})$ 的遗憾下界；反之，遗憾受数据秩控制，三角构造匹配了幂次单变量预热的秩依赖性（即使在非负第二阶段岭正则化下）。语言模型实验也验证了干扰插值、目标权重与损失之间的相同关系。
AI.conclusion: 特征预热无法普遍实现随稀疏度对数增长的在线遗憾界，其核心瓶颈在于干扰特征插值削弱了关键预测坐标的权重，但单变量情况下遗憾界与数据秩紧密相关。
AI.translation: 在高维在线预测中，最优预测器可能仅依赖于少数特征，因此遗憾（regret）应该随稀疏度而非环境维度缩放。特征预热通过从过去的数据中估计特征权重并在重缩放的设计上重新拟合最小范数预测器来追求这一目标。Warmuth和Amid在COLT 2023上提问，三种此类规则中是否有任何一种能够具备竞争性的在线遗憾保证。基于仅依赖过去数据的自然摩尔-彭罗斯（Moore--Penrose）协议，我们对该COLT公开问题的稀疏对数形式给出了否定回答。我们的分析指出了一个共同障碍：廉价的干扰插值会导致重新拟合时对真正具有预测性的坐标欠加权。精确的目标质量恒等式和双符号论证将这种效应转化为截断的预测损失。阿达马（Hadamard）构造迫使所有三种规则针对零损失的1-稀疏比较基准产生 $\Omega(\min\{T,\sqrt{d}\})$ 的遗憾，并可扩展至固定素数幂和规则之间的选择器。相反，遗憾受数据秩控制，欧几里得归一化的三角构造与幂次单变量预热的这种依赖性相匹配（即使在非负第二阶段岭正则化下）；配对岭回归构造同样覆盖了所有三种幂次规则。在冻结的语言模型激活上的探索性诊断也展现了干扰插值、目标权重与损失之间的相同关系。精确的多元和皮尔逊（Pearson）前沿仍是有待解决的开放问题。
AI.summary: 本文研究了高维在线线性回归中的特征预热机制，否定了COLT 2023提出的关于特征预热能否实现对数稀疏遗憾保证的公开问题。研究揭示了干扰插值导致真预测特征被低估的机制，通过阿达马构造给出了 $\Omega(\min\{T,\sqrt{d}\})$ 的遗憾下界，并给出了单变量情形下受数据秩控制的紧致遗憾界，同时在语言模型激活上验证了该现象。
AI.keywords: Feature Priming, Online Linear Regression, Sparse Regret, Lower Bounds, Moore-Penrose Protocol
AI.comments: 该论文针对COLT 2023提出的特征预热（Feature Priming）公开问题给出了重要的否定性结论，揭示了廉价干扰特征插值对真预测特征权重的削弱机制，并提供了紧致的单变量界，对高维在线学习和特征选择算法的理论发展具有重要指导意义。

title: Towards the Impossibility of Imperfectly Complete Key Agreement in the QROM
summary: We make progress towards the impossibility of imperfectly complete quantum-computation, classical-communication (QCCC) key agreement by constructing the first unconditional attacks on quantum key agreement in the following restricted settings. In the two-message setting, we assume that Alice makes only classical queries to the oracle in the first round and that her message to Bob is classical, but otherwise both parties may perform arbitrary quantum computation, make quantum queries, and send a quantum state in the second round. Our attack and analysis are based on the heavy-query learning techniques from Austrin et al. (CRYPTO 2022) and the reprogramming techniques of Katz and Sela (arXiv 2401.14319). In the round-independent setting, we show that the attack of Barak and Mahmoody (CRYPTO 2009; J. Cryptology 2017) can be extended to multiple rounds when Alice and Bob share classical communication and make only classical queries in all but the final round. In both settings, the attacker is computationally unbounded and makes $poly(λ)$ queries to recover the key whenever each honest query bound is at most $poly(λ)$ and the valid agreement probability is inverse-polynomial. As a consequence, we rule out imperfectly correct quantum public-key encryption for classical messages whose length is bounded by a polynomial in $λ$ in the QROM when key generation has classical oracle access, even if encryption, decryption, and the ciphertext are quantum. In particular, the one-bit case applies to the imperfectly correct PKE obtained from two-round OSP by Bartusek and Khurana (CRYPTO 2025) whenever the classical OSP sender makes only classical random-oracle queries.

AI.title_translation: QROM中不完全完整密钥协商不可能性研究
AI.tldr: 本文通过构建在受限设置下对量子密钥协商的首次无条件攻击，在QROM中不完全完整量子计算、经典通信（QCCC）密钥协商的不可能性方面取得了进展。
AI.motivation: 在QROM中，旨在推进不完全完整量子计算、经典通信（QCCC）密钥协商不可能性方面的研究。
AI.method: 在两消息设置中，攻击基于Austrin等人（CRYPTO 2022）的重查询学习技术和Katz与Sela（arXiv 2401.14319）的重编程技术。在轮无关设置中，将Barak和Mahmoody（CRYPTO 2009; J. Cryptology 2017）的攻击扩展到多轮场景。
AI.result: 攻击者在每个诚实查询界限最多为poly(λ)且有效协商概率为逆多项式时，通过poly(λ)次查询恢复密钥。因此，排除了在QROM中，当密钥生成具有经典谕示访问权限时，针对长度受λ多项式限制的经典消息的不完全正确量子公钥加密的可能性。

AI.translation: 我们通过在以下受限设置中构建对量子密钥协商的首次无条件攻击，在不完全完整量子计算、经典通信（QCCC）密钥协商的不可能性方面取得了进展。在两消息设置中，我们假设Alice在第一轮中只对谕示进行经典查询，并且她发送给Bob的消息是经典的，但在其他方面，双方都可以执行任意量子计算、进行量子查询，并在第二轮中发送量子态。我们的攻击和分析基于Austrin等人（CRYYPTO 2022）的重查询学习技术以及Katz和Sela（arXiv 2401.14319）的重编程技术。在轮无关设置中，我们表明Barak和Mahmoody（CRYPTO 2009; J. Cryptology 2017）的攻击可以扩展到多轮，当Alice和Bob共享经典通信并在除最后一轮之外的所有轮中只进行经典查询时。在这两种设置中，攻击者计算能力无限制，并且在每个诚实查询界限最多为poly(λ)且有效协商概率为逆多项式时，通过poly(λ)次查询恢复密钥。因此，我们排除了在QROM中，当密钥生成具有经典谕示访问权限时，针对长度受λ多项式限制的经典消息的不完全正确量子公钥加密的可能性，即使加密、解密和密文是量子的。特别是，当经典OSP发送者只进行经典随机谕示查询时，来自Bartusek和Khurana（CRYPTO 2025）的两轮OSP获得的不完全正确PKE适用于一位情况。
AI.summary: 本文在QROM中，通过在受限的两消息和轮无关设置下，构建了针对量子密钥协商的首次无条件攻击，从而推进了不完全完整QCCC密钥协商不可能性方面的研究。这些攻击利用了重查询学习和重编程技术，能在多项式时间内恢复密钥，进而排除了在QROM中，当密钥生成具有经典谕示访问权限时，针对经典消息的不完全正确量子公钥加密的可能性。
AI.keywords: 量子密钥协商, QROM, 无条件攻击, 不可能性, 公钥加密
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了在受限设置下对量子密钥协商的首次无条件攻击，这对于理解QROM中量子密钥协商的根本限制具有重要意义。这些结果不仅推进了理论研究，也对不完全正确量子公钥加密的设计和安全性评估产生了直接影响。

title: Unclonable encryption from BB84 states: a simultaneous Goldreich-Levin reduction
summary:
Goldreich-Levin reductions are ubiquitous in cryptography: they convert an algorithm capable of guessing $\langle r, m \rangle$ (mod $2$) for a hidden string $m$ and a random challenge $r$, to one that is capable of extracting the entirety of $m$. Here, we describe a "simultaneous" Goldreich-Levin reduction for two entangled parties who are capable of guessing $\langle r, m \rangle$ given uniformly random identical challenges $r$. This allows to upgrade any unclonable encryption scheme satisfying "search" security to one satisfying the gold standard of unclonable "indistinguishability". As a corollary, we show that the simplest candidate unclonable encryption scheme from BB84 states satisfies unclonable indistinguishability.
  This result was discovered by GPT-5.6 Ultra after a few interactions. Our prompts included recent results on unclonable encryption by Ananth and Sahai, and Ragavan.

AI.title_translation: 不可克隆的BB84态加密：一种同步Goldreich-Levin归约
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种同步Goldreich-Levin归约方法，可将仅满足“搜索”安全性的不可克隆加密方案升级为满足不可克隆“不可区分性”标准的方案，并证明了基于BB84态的最简单不可克隆加密方案满足不可克隆不可区分性。

Goldreich-Levin归约在密码学中无处不在：它们将能够猜测隐藏字符串m和随机挑战r的<r, m>（mod 2）的算法，转换为能够提取m的全部内容的算法。在这里，我们描述了一种“同步”Goldreich-Levin归约，适用于两个纠缠方，他们能够从均匀随机的相同挑战r中猜测<r, m>。这允许将任何满足“搜索”安全性的不可克隆加密方案升级为满足不可克隆“不可区分性”黄金标准的方案。作为推论，我们证明了来自BB84态的最简单的不可克隆加密方案满足不可克隆不可区分性。
