title: Epistemological Debt: Cognitive Atrophy and Systemic Collapse in AI-Dependent Software Engineering
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE Software
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) masks a critical socio-technical failure: Cognitive-Systemic Collapse. This paper introduces "Epistemological Debt," the hidden carrying cost incurred when engineers substitute logical derivation with passive AI verification. This debt erodes the mental models essential for root-cause analysis, widening the gap between system complexity and human comprehension. Furthermore, recursive training on synthetic code threatens to homogenize the global software reservoir, diminishing the variance required for robust engineering. Using the 2026 Amazon outages as a case study, this research illustrates how "mechanized convergence" leads to systemic fragility. To preserve long-term resilience, engineering leaders must move beyond prompt-based development to implement rigorous human-in-the-loop pedagogical standards. This framework balances AI-driven productivity with the epistemic sovereignty necessary to manage increasingly opaque software ecosystems.
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE Software

title: Unifying Deep Stochastic Processes for Image Enhancement
comments: 27 pages, in proceesings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Deep stochastic processes have recently become a central paradigm for image enhancement, with many methods explicitly conditioning the stochastic trajectory on the degraded input. However, the relationship between these conditional processes and standard diffusion models remains unclear. In this work, we introduce a unified perspective on stochastic image enhancement by classifying recent methods into three families of continuous-time processes: unconditional diffusion models, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) processes, and diffusion bridges. We show that all of these approaches arise from a common stochastic differential equation (SDE) formulation. This framework makes explicit that seemingly disparate methods differ primarily in their drift and diffusion terms, terminal distributions, and boundary conditions, while schedulers and samplers constitute orthogonal design choices. Leveraging this unification, we conduct a controlled empirical study across multiple image enhancement tasks using identical architectures and training protocols. Our results reveal no consistently dominant method; instead, we identify and disentangle the specific design choices that most strongly influence performance. Finally, we release ItoVision, a modular PyTorch library that implements the unified framework and enables rapid prototyping and fair comparison of stochastic image enhancement methods.
comment: 27 pages, in proceesings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea

title: VL-UniTrack: A Unified Framework with Visual-Language Prompts for UAV-Ground Visual Tracking
summary: UAV-ground visual tracking (UGVT) aims to simultaneously track the same object from both the UAV and the ground view. However, existing two-stream methods suffer from isolated feature extraction and rely heavily on implicit appearance matching, which struggles to establish reliable correspondence under drastic view differences, leading to tracking unreliability. To address these limitations, we propose VL-UniTrack, a fully unified framework enhanced by visual-language prompts. By encoding features from both views within a single shared encoder, our method breaks the barrier of feature isolation to facilitate sufficient cross-view interaction. To overcome the ambiguity caused by relying solely on appearance matching, we design visual-language geometric prompting module, which fuses language descriptions with visual features to generate learnable prompts. These prompts are then fed into our prompt-guided cross-view adapter module to enable sufficient cross-view feature interaction and to guide the learning of view-specific feature representations. Furthermore, a confidence-modulated mutual distillation loss is proposed to regularize the training by mitigating noise propagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the latest benchmark. The code can be downloaded in https://github.com/xuboyue1999/VL-UniTrack.git

title: A Finite-Iteration Theory for Asynchronous Categorical Distributional Temporal-Difference Learning
summary: We study finite-iteration behavior of the exact asynchronous recursions used by categorical distributional temporal-difference methods. The analysis covers scalar categorical TD in the Cramér geometry and multivariate signed-categorical TD in the maximum mean discrepancy geometry. Existing statewise isometric embeddings turn both methods into single-state stochastic-approximation recursions that contract in a block-supremum norm, but the categorical operators are contractive only on invariant representation domains. We establish the required restricted-domain theory and obtain discounted bounds under i.i.d. sampling and under a Markovian trajectory. A Poisson-equation decomposition handles trajectory dependence without an explicit mixing-time window. For undiscounted fixed-horizon policy evaluation, we establish analogous finite-iteration guarantees for horizon-stacked categorical methods under episodic sampling. Together, these results provide a unified non-asymptotic analysis of asynchronous categorical distributional TD across scalar, multivariate, discounted, and fixed-horizon settings.

title: Latent Order Bandits
summary: Bandit algorithms solve diverse sequential decision-making problems, but are often too sample-inefficient for from-scratch personalization. To substantially reduce exploration times, latent bandit algorithms exploit cross-instance structure implied by discrete latent states, provided that the posterior distribution of rewards and latent states is known and accurate. However, obtaining an accurate model of this structure is difficult, and a small number of latent states may be insufficient to characterize the reward distributions in all problem instances. We propose latent order bandits (LOB), relaxing the assumptions of latent bandits to require only prior knowledge of a \emph{partial order} of action preferences in each state. This allows instances of the same state to vary in reward distributions, as long as the partial order of actions is shared. For example, groups of users on a streaming service may agree on which movie genres are the best but rate experiences on different scales. We give an upper-confidence bound procedure for the LOB problem, applicable to both total and partial latent orders, and give an upper bound on its regret. To improve empirical performance, we propose a posterior-sampling algorithm and show, in a suite of experiments, that both are competitive with full-prior latent bandits when same-state instances share reward parameters, and preferable to them when reward scales differ between instances with the same latent state.

title: TCMIIES: A Browser-Based LLM-Powered Intelligent Information Extraction System for Academic Literature
summary: The rapid growth of academic publications has created a need for tools that extract structured knowledge from unstructured scientific texts. Although large language models (LLMs) can perform natural language understanding and information extraction, existing solutions often require specialized infrastructure, programming expertise, or fine-tuned domain-specific models, which limits their accessibility for researchers in specialized fields. This paper describes TCMIIES (Traditional Chinese Medicine Information Intelligent Extraction System), a browser-based, zero-installation platform that uses commercial LLM APIs to perform structured information extraction from academic literature. The system employs a schema-guided prompting framework with automatic system prompt generation, allowing researchers to define custom extraction schemas through a graphical interface without programming. TCMIIES features a pure front-end architecture that processes all information locally in the browser, supports five major LLM providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Qwen, Zhipu AI, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints), implements concurrent batch processing with automatic retry mechanisms, and provides intelligent field mapping for Chinese academic databases including CNKI and Wanfang. Evaluation across multiple extraction scenarios in Traditional Chinese Medicine research shows structured output compliance rates exceeding 94\% and extraction accuracy approaching but below expert-level agreement ($κ=0.82$ as reference). The system offers a flexible, privacy-preserving, and cost-effective solution for domain researchers who need to process literature at scale.

title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
summary: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) is difficult to scale to small language models due to instability in long-horizon tool interactions and limited model capacity. While reinforcement learning methods like group relative policy optimization provide only sparse outcome-level rewards. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has gained popularity by supplying dense token-level supervision from a teacher on student-generated trajectories. However, our experiments indicate that applying OPD to TIR leads to a critical failure mode: erroneous tool calls tend to cascade across subsequent reasoning steps, progressively amplifying student-teacher divergence and rendering the teacher's token-level supervision increasingly unreliable. To address this, we propose SOD, a step-wise on-policy distillation framework for small language model agents, which adaptively reweights distillation strength at each step based on step-level divergence. Therefore, SOD can attenuate potentially misleading teacher signals in high-divergence regions while preserving dense guidance in well-aligned states. Experiments on challenging math, science, and code benchmarks show that SOD achieves up to 20.86% improvement over the second-best baseline. Notably, our 0.6B student achieves 26.13% on AIME 2025, demonstrating effective transfer of agentic reasoning to lightweight models. Our code is available at https://github.com/YoungZ365/SOD.

title: Adaptive AI Task Partitioning and Safe Offloading in Heterogeneous Edge-Cloud Continuum
summary: In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence on resource-constrained IoT devices has grown significantly. However, existing approaches to AI task partitioning and offloading across the edge-cloud continuum typically rely on static methods that ignore runtime dynamics. Furthermore, they are often evaluated in simulated environments rather than on real hardware. To address this gap, we propose a framework that dynamically splits neural network layers across the heterogeneous continuum. The framework profiles the model at startup, measures network link conditions between nodes, and periodically re-evaluates the partition to adapt to environmental changes. We created a physical testbed comprising a Raspberry Pi edge device, a laptop fog, and a high-performance desktop PC as the cloud. We evaluated the framework over three widely adopted convolutional neural networks: VGG16, AlexNet, and MobileNetV2. Our results show that the framework achieves reductions in energy and end-to-end latency of 27.09--35.82% and 6.34--22.92%, respectively, compared to a static partitioning baseline. These findings confirm the superiority of adaptive to static partitioning.

title: LoopVLA: Learning Sufficiency in Recurrent Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically treat the deepest representation of a vision-language backbone as universally optimal for action prediction. However, robotic manipulation is composed of many frequent closed-loop spatial adjustments, for which excessive abstraction may waste computation and weaken low-level geometric cues essential for precise control. Existing early-exit strategies attempt to reduce computation by stopping at predefined layers or applying heuristic rules such as action consistency, but they do not directly answer when a representation is actually sufficient for action. In this paper, we present LoopVLA, a recurrent VLA architecture that jointly learns representation refinement, action prediction, and sufficiency estimation. LoopVLA iteratively applies a shared Transformer block to refine multimodal tokens, and at each iteration produces both a candidate action and a sufficiency score that estimates whether further refinement is necessary. By sharing parameters across iterations, LoopVLA decouples refinement from absolute layer indices and grounds sufficiency estimation in the evolving representation itself. Since sufficiency has no direct supervision, we introduce a self-supervised distribution alignment objective, where intermediate confidence scores are trained to match the relative action quality across refinement steps, thereby linking sufficiency learning to policy optimization signals. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLA-Arena show that LoopVLA pushes the efficiency-performance frontier of VLA policies, reducing parameters by 45% and improving inference throughput by up to 1.7 times while matching or outperforming strong baselines in task success.

title: Data-aware candidate selection in NL2SQL translation via small separating instances
summary: We propose a data-aware candidate selection method for NL2SQL translation based on separating instances and provenance. We implement this approach and evaluate it against three natural baselines on a subset of BIRD-DEV. Experiments show that our method significantly outperforms baselines when only two or three candidates are given and no consistency score is available. The code of our prototype can be found at https://github.com/staskikotx/SISelection

title: Center-Manifold Reduction of Learning at Bifurcations: Interference and Rich Learning in Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Rich learning in recurrent neural networks often proceeds through sudden transitions in latent dynamics, but there is little theory predicting how gradient descent behaves during these events. We study the local learning geometry near codimension-one bifurcations through the global empirical Neural Tangent Kernel (GeNTK). Under local center-manifold conditions, and when bifurcation-related sensitivity dominates bounded residual terms, we show that the global parameter-to-state Jacobian \(D_θh\) is approximated by a low-rank normal-form operator. The induced GeNTK and Fisher information matrix therefore become strongly amplified and anisotropic, concentrating toward a rank-one channel for the four scalar codimension-one bifurcations and a rank-two real channel for a Neimark--Sacker bifurcation. Controlled high-dimensional RNN experiments validate this operator reduction. In learned RNNs, the same low-rank concentration coincides with abrupt loss changes and subtask interference, while a local projection predicts the sign of these effects near isolated events. Finally, in an input-driven 15-task LeakyRNN, GeNTK amplification aligns with continuation-detected changes in the MemoryPro dynamics. These results suggest a tractable operator-level description of learning near dynamical transitions, together with scalable diagnostics for amplified low-dimensional learning geometry.

title: Predictions Can Only Help! Communication Efficient Byzantine Agreement with Predictions
summary:
In Byzantine agreement with predictions each process begins with an input value and some (unreliable) prediction bits. Recently, it has been shown that with \emph{classification predictions}---where the predictions predict each process to be honest or faulty---Byzantine agreement can be completed more quickly than without predictions, circumventing the traditional $Ω(f)$ round lower bound. However, existing algorithms either handle limited prediction errors or send too many messages. Moreover, they all exchange $Ω(n^3)$ bits---enough to allow the processes to approximately agree on the classifications. In fact, it almost seemed necessary to share a significant number of prediction bits if one wanted to tolerate a high number of incorrect predictions.
  In this paper, we show that this high level of communication is not inherent to a round-efficient protocol with predictions. We provide an unauthenticated algorithm with near-optimal $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^2)$ communication complexity and optimal resilience $t < n/3$. Furthermore, with authentication, we give an algorithm with optimal $\mathcal{O}(n^2κ)$ communication complexity (where $κ$ is a security parameter) and near-optimal resilience $t < (\frac{1}{2} - ε)n$ for any constant $ε> 0$. All of our results have optimal round complexity for any number of errors in the predictions.

title: A class of optimal authentication codes with secrecy
summary: In this paper, a class of linear authentication codes with secrecy, which are equipped with simple encoding rules and can be easily implemented, is constructed. By means of a special Weil sum, the maximum success probabilities of impersonation attack (denoted by $P_I$) and of substitution attack (denoted by $P_S$) for these codes are explicitly derived. It is further proven that the codes are asymptotically optimal, in the sense that both the information theoretic bound and the combinatorial bound for authentication codes are asymptotically attained by $P_I$ and $P_S$.

title: SurgicalMamba: Dual-Path SSD with State Regramming for Online Surgical Phase Recognition
summary: Online surgical phase recognition must commit to a prediction at every frame of a procedure that runs for hours, from past frames alone and at a per-frame cost that does not grow with elapsed length. Structured state-space duality (SSD) meets that constraint, but only by having the scan see a per-head scalar transition, which fixes both where the state puts a frame and how fast it decays. The same views recur through an operation, so repeated content is written over itself and can afterwards be told apart only by age. How fast to decay is left to the step, and when the past stops being useful has to be inferred from a loss that never marks the moment. Procedures run long and change little visually from frame to frame, leaving the step with little to select on. Phases also vary widely in length, so no fixed rate serves as a fallback. We address the two with two mechanisms. State regramming rotates the carried state at each chunk boundary, by an amount the chunk's content decides, so where a frame is written also depends on what has passed since: two occurrences of the same view are held apart when different phases intervene, which no decay rate can achieve once both have aged. Intensity-modulated stepping increases the decay at the annotated phase transitions, so the state empties quickly where a phase ends and slowly in between and the decay itself can be set for the longest phase. Both leave SSD's N-semiseparable structure and O(d) per-frame cost intact. Across seven public benchmarks SurgicalMamba reaches state-of-the-art online accuracy and phase-level Jaccard (94.6%/82.7% on Cholec80, 89.5%/68.9% on AutoLaparo) at 312.88 fps on a single GPU. Adding the rotation alone to a plain Mamba2 improves multi-query associative recall (MQAR) wherever the recurrent state is the binding constraint, indicating that the mechanism is not specific to surgical video.

title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
summary: Desktop GUI agents operate under partial observability: visually similar screens can correspond to different underlying workflow states, so locally plausible actions can lead to sharply different outcomes. We frame this as a problem of computer/OS state exploration, where effective behavior requires both expanding the reachable frontier and reducing ambiguity before committing. We present ScreenSearch, a system that combines structural screen retrieval and deduplication with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration. The retrieval layer converts UIA trees into location-aware structural features, indexes related screens through sparse token search and metadata filters, and maintains a shared deduplicated state graph across VM workers. On top of this graph, we define a scalable ambiguity signal based on matched-action outcome dispersion. If similar screens produce different next states under the same action signature, the state should be probed further rather than treated as resolved. We use this signal together with frontier rewards to drive large-scale exploration and replay-start policy evaluation over the shared graph. Across 11 desktop applications, ScreenSearch collects over 1M screenshots and over 30K deduplicated states, yielding large exploration corpora with substantial cross-application and within-application diversity. On a fixed replay-start slice, we observe a clear novelty--ambiguity trade-off: some policies reduce ambiguity quickly while discovering little frontier. Ambiguity reduction alone is therefore not a sufficient exploration objective. Appendix ablations show that stronger proposal priors can materially improve unique-state discovery during corpus building. These results suggest that state identity, proposal quality, and ambiguity-aware search all matter when deciding when to probe and when to commit.

title: FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers
summary: Activation steering has emerged as a lightweight approach for modifying language model behavior without parameter updates, yet existing methods remain brittle: unstable across layers and prone to disturbing behavior unrelated to the target concept. We trace these failures to a hidden assumption shared by widely-used methods such as CAA, ActAdd, and ITI: that the intermediate activation space is Euclidean. We show this assumption is fundamentally flawed. The metric that actually governs how a hidden-state perturbation changes the output is the Fisher information metric of the softmax layer, pulled back to the intermediate layer through the Jacobian of the intervening layers. From it we derive a closed-form steering direction, applied to a hidden state at an intermediate layer, that reaches a target concept change with the least non-target distortion. The framework is sharpest in the early and middle intermediate layers, where the metric is strongly non-Euclidean and geometric correction matters most. We evaluate it on three verb-morphology concepts: third-person-singular, progressive, and past-tense inflection, following standard counterfactual-concept evaluation. On GPT-2 Small, this non-Euclidean geometry is borne out empirically, and our method lowers off-target KL divergence by median factors of 1.4--6.5x against individual steering baselines. On Llama-3-8B and Qwen3-8B, it lowers off-target KL by median factors of 1.8--3.6x against individual baselines at the early and middle layers. These results show that geometric correction retains its advantage on larger models with more complex internal structure.

title: Analyzing Error Propagation in Korean Spoken QA with ASR-LLM Cascades
summary: We analyze how automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors propagate through ASR--LLM cascades in Korean spoken question answering (SQA), focusing on downstream semantic failures that conventional ASR metrics cannot fully capture. Our analysis shows that the relative downstream degradation caused by ASR errors is consistent across LLMs with different absolute performance, suggesting that cascade degradation largely tracks ASR-stage information loss. We further identify single-character ASR errors as a particularly salient source of information loss in Korean, where even a minimal transcription difference can change the intended question and degrade downstream QA performance. Finally, an auxiliary comparison shows that a large audio language model outperforms an ASR--LLM cascade with an approximately matched language backbone in noisy Korean SQA, indicating the potential of direct audio input to mitigate transcript-induced information loss.

title: ImplicitTerrainV2: Wavelet-Guided Spatially Adaptive Neural Terrain Representation
summary: Digital elevation models (DEMs) underpin terrain analysis in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), but commonly as raster representation, they rely on interpolation for off-grid sampling and finite-difference operators for derivative-based analysis. Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous alternative, but prior terrain INRs lack explicit frequency control, neglect the gradient structure of terrain, and remain too large and costly to train for practical deployment. We present ImplicitTerrainV2, which advances terrain INRs toward a compact, efficient neural terrain data format by combining a spectral control mechanism with wavelet-guided spatial adaptivity, derivative-aware supervision, and post-training model compression. At its core, a wavelet complexity field (WCF) derives spatially-adaptive frequency masks from analytically computed wavelet coefficients, localizing high-frequency capacity to complex terrain regions. The same field guides complexity-aware adaptive sampling that concentrates training in high-complexity regions, while gradient matching applies extra supervision to enforce the smooth manifold structure of terrain DEMs for improved derivative fidelity. Post-training mixed-precision quantization and entropy coding reduce storage to 1.23 bpp with a 0.28 dB PSNR drop. On 50 morphologically diverse Swiss terrain tiles, ImplicitTerrainV2 reaches 66.25 dB end-to-end PSNR, improving over the prior work by 5.70 dB while using 3.2x fewer parameters and training in 55 s per tile on a single GPU. Our compressed neural format is competitive with several established DEM codecs in rate-distortion performance, while additionally supporting off-grid point queries, closed-form derivative evaluation, and resolution-independent reconstruction, which may benefit many downstream GIS applications.

title: Open datasets and machine learning for two-phase heat transfer: a review following a spatial-temporal taxonomy
comments: Accepted manuscript replacing arXiv:2605.23037 (v1). Substantially expanded from the original preprint and published in Transport Phenomena 2026, 1(3), 20260081. https://doi.org/10.1515/tp-2026-0081
summary: Two-phase heat transfer underpins boiling, condensation, immersion cooling, flow boiling, energy conversion, and electronics thermal management, but its coupled interfacial physics make data reuse and model comparison difficult. This narrative review synthesizes open datasets, machine-learning methods, and reusable software for two-phase heat-transfer research, with emphasis on boiling, multimodal sensing, and thermal-management datasets. We organize the review around a spatial-plus-temporal dimensionality taxonomy, denoted S+TD, that classifies data objects by the dimensionality of the measured, simulated, or derived fields, including 0+0D point values, 0+1D time series, 1+1D profiles, 2+0D images, 2+1D videos, 3+0D/3+1D fields, and mixed multimodal records. The taxonomy is used to connect dataset types to AI tasks such as tabular regression, acoustic sequence learning, image segmentation, video analysis, inverse heat-flux reconstruction, surrogate modeling, and multimodal fusion. The review also develops a roadmap for physics-aware open data, including metadata definitions, evidence and reuse-maturity labels, benchmark splits, decoders, baseline models, and community databanks. NED3 resources are discussed as one implementation case within a broader open-data ecosystem rather than as a complete solution. The main conclusion is that progress in two-phase AI now depends as much on findable, decodable, benchmarkable, and physically interpretable data infrastructure as on model architecture.

title: Divergent Paths to Depolarization: Dialogue Design Shapes the Intergroup Attitudinal Effects of AI-Assisted Political Argumentation
summary: Structured argumentative dialogues where interlocutors deliberate on opposing political ideas are known to promote perspective-taking and reduce political polarization, but finding willing partners is difficult as Americans increasingly shun political discussions. AI dialogue partners offer a scalable framework for such open-mindedness exercises, but how the format of human-AI dialogues shapes their benefits remains unclear. This study seeks to fill the gap with a preregistered two-session online experiment with 527 US participants. As the primary experimental manipulation, participants were assigned to argue either for or against their pre-existing attitude on a contested political issue, engaging either with an AI chatbot or a solitary essay task. The AI conditions further varied in the chatbot's interaction style (adversarial or collaborative) and the presence of an additional financial incentive. The results show that attitude-congruent dialogues more strongly reduced polarization than attitude-incongruent dialogues immediately after the exchange. By contrast, an exploratory analysis suggested a delayed increase in cognitive empathy following attitude-incongruent dialogues, a pattern consistent with the account of sleeper effects. While the conversation style had little influence on the effects of attitude-congruent dialogues, a collaborative discussion tended to make attitude-incongruent dialogues more effective, narrowing the immediate effect gap. Additional financial incentives did not alter outcomes. Given the heterogeneity, the AI conditions were not universally more effective forming favorable intergroup attitudes in pooled comparisons between AI and non-AI conditions. The findings caution against a simplistic view of AI dialogues as a silver bullet for depolarization and highlight dialogue design as a key determinant of effective AI-mediated attitudinal interventions.

title: H$^{2}$MT: Semantic Hierarchy-Aware Hierarchical Memory Transformer
summary: Transformer-based LLMs achieve strong results on many language tasks; however, long inputs remain challenging because context windows are finite, and prefill latency and memory grow rapidly with prompt length. Flat token-stream processing and chunk-based retrieval can therefore spend substantial computation and context budget on text unrelated to the query. Offline-indexed RAG additionally introduces external storage and index management overhead, and typically appends retrieved evidence as raw text, increasing prefill cost and latency. H^{2}MT makes long-context inference structure-aware: it builds a semantic hierarchy offline, computes a memory embedding for each node via bottom-up post-order aggregation, and routes queries coarse-to-fine at inference to prune irrelevant branches early. On LongBench QA (NarrativeQA, HotpotQA, QASPER) and two structured technical-document settings, H MT achieves favorable quality efficiency trade-offs, delivering competitive ROUGE-L and F1 (where applicable) with lower peak GPU memory and time-to-first-token (TTFT) than prompt compression, memory-token methods, and retrieval-augmented generation baselines.

title: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: The ability to efficiently and reliably learn new tasks has been a foundational challenge in robotics. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse manipulation tasks, yet pretrained policies consistently fall short of the reliability required for real-world deployment. Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning offers a promising path to bridge this gap, but existing approaches either train from scratch without fully leveraging pretrained priors, or fine-tune VLAs without achieving the sample efficiency and success rates that practical deployment demands. We present EXPO-FT, a system for stable, sample-efficient RL finetuning of pretrained VLA policies that closes this gap. Our system solves a suite of challenging manipulation tasks, including routing string lights and inserting the plug to light it up, striking a pool ball into a pocket, and inserting a flower into a wine bottle, each requiring combinations of high precision, dynamic actions, and robustness to varied initial states. Our system achieves perfect task performance (30/30 successes) across all evaluated tasks within an average of 19.1 minutes of online robot data, outperforming both prior RL-from-scratch and VLA finetuning approaches. We release an open-source codebase with the aim of facilitating broader adoption of RL finetuning of VLA models in robotics.

title: mstlo: Efficient Online Monitoring of Signal Temporal Logic
summary: We present mstlo (mistletoe), a Rust library for high-performance online monitoring of signal temporal logic (STL), with Python bindings. The library provides: (i) a unified interface for multiple STL semantics, including Robust Satisfaction Intervals (RoSI) and Boolean evaluation with early verdicts; (ii) an incremental monitoring algorithm based on bottom-up dynamic programming with per-operator caching and streaming extremum computation for temporal operators; and (iii) an embedded STL domain-specific language for both Rust and Python implementations, with procedural macros in Rust for static syntax checking. Benchmarks show scalability and performance improvements over state-of-the-art tools, especially for formulas with large temporal depth and deep nesting.

title: Nonlinear Data Integration via Kernel Methods for Data Collaboration Analysis
summary: Collaborative analysis of decentralized confidential datasets is important, but direct sharing of original datasets is often restricted by privacy and institutional constraints. Data collaboration (DC) analysis transforms each dataset into privacy-preserving intermediate representations via party-specific obfuscation functions and integrates them into common collaboration representations using an anchor dataset. However, many existing DC analysis methods rely on linear transformations for data obfuscation and integration, which may increase reconstruction risk. Although nonlinear dimensionality reduction can mitigate this risk, conventional linear integration methods cannot accurately align intermediate representations produced by nonlinear transformations. Moreover, existing integration methods mainly minimize discrepancies among parties and do not explicitly incorporate geometric or target-variable information useful for downstream analysis. To overcome these limitations, we first formulate linear target-normalized integration (LTI) as a linear integration method and then kernelize it to obtain kernel-based target-normalized integration (KTI). KTI admits a globally optimal solution via kernel ridge regression and an eigenvalue problem. We also introduce graph regularization and a centering constraint so that the target representation can capture geometric and target-variable information useful for downstream analysis. Experiments on image classification tasks demonstrate that KTI improves classification accuracy over existing linear integration methods under nonlinear dimensionality reduction, with further gains from target-variable-aware graph regularization and centering. The results also show that dimensionality reduction choices substantially affect both classification accuracy and reconstruction risk.

AI.title_translation: 基于核方法的非线性数据集成用于数据协作分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为KTI的非线性数据集成方法，通过核方法和图正则化解决去中心化数据协作分析中现有线性方法的局限性，提高了分类准确性并降低了重建风险。
AI.motivation: 去中心化机密数据集的协作分析很重要，但直接共享原始数据受隐私和机构限制。现有数据协作分析方法依赖线性变换进行数据混淆和集成，可能增加重建风险。非线性降维虽能缓解风险，但传统线性集成方法无法准确对齐非线性变换产生的中间表示。此外，现有集成方法主要最小化各方差异，未明确纳入对下游分析有用的几何或目标变量信息。
AI.method: 首先将线性目标归一化集成（LTI）公式化为一种线性集成方法，然后将其核化以获得基于核的目标归一化集成（KTI）。KTI通过核岭回归和特征值问题获得全局最优解。引入图正则化和中心化约束，使目标表示能够捕获对下游分析有用的几何和目标变量信息。
AI.result: 图像分类任务实验表明，在非线性降维下，KTI比现有线性集成方法提高了分类准确性，并通过目标变量感知图正则化和中心化进一步提升。结果还显示，降维选择显著影响分类准确性和重建风险。
AI.conclusion: KTI通过非线性集成、核方法和图正则化，有效解决了数据协作分析中现有线性方法的局限性，提高了分类准确性并降低了重建风险，尤其在处理非线性变换的中间表示时表现出色。
AI.translation: 去中心化机密数据集的协作分析非常重要，但原始数据集的直接共享通常受到隐私和机构限制。数据协作（DC）分析通过各方特定的混淆函数将每个数据集转换为隐私保护的中间表示，并使用锚定数据集将它们集成到共同的协作表示中。然而，许多现有的DC分析方法依赖线性变换进行数据混淆和集成，这可能增加重建风险。尽管非线性降维可以缓解这种风险，但传统的线性集成方法无法准确对齐非线性变换产生的中间表示。此外，现有的集成方法主要最小化各方之间的差异，并未明确纳入对下游分析有用的几何或目标变量信息。为了克服这些局限性，我们首先将线性目标归一化集成（LTI）公式化为一种线性集成方法，然后对其进行核化以获得基于核的目标归一化集成（KTI）。KTI通过核岭回归和特征值问题获得全局最优解。我们还引入了图正则化和中心化约束，以便目标表示能够捕获对下游分析有用的几何和目标变量信息。图像分类任务的实验表明，在非线性降维下，KTI比现有线性集成方法提高了分类准确性，并通过目标变量感知图正则化和中心化进一步提升。结果还显示，降维选择显著影响分类准确性和重建风险。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于核方法的非线性数据集成框架，即核目标归一化集成（KTI），以解决去中心化机密数据集协作分析中现有线性方法的局限性。针对现有方法在非线性变换下集成效率低、重建风险高以及未充分利用几何和目标变量信息的问题，KTI通过核化线性集成方法，并引入图正则化和中心化约束，实现了全局最优解。实验证明，KTI在图像分类任务中显著提高了分类准确性，并有效降低了重建风险。
AI.keywords: 数据协作, 非线性集成, 核方法, 隐私保护, 图正则化
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将核方法引入到数据协作的集成阶段，从而解决了现有线性集成方法在处理非线性降维数据时性能不佳和重建风险高的问题。通过引入图正则化和中心化约束，KTI能够更好地捕获数据中的几何和目标变量信息，这对于下游分析至关重要。该方法为隐私保护下的数据协作分析提供了更有效、更安全的非线性集成方案。

title: SAFE-Pruner: Semantic Attention-Guided Future-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Real-time inference of vision-language-action (VLA) models is essential for robotic control. While visual token pruning has shown strong potential for accelerating inference, most existing methods mainly base pruning decisions on shallow-layer cues and risk discarding visual information required by deep layers. To address this issue, we propose SAFE-Pruner, a plug-and-play pruning framework that incorporates attention cues of future layers into pruning decisions. Specifically, we identify semantic attention consistency, the tendency that VLA models concentrate their attention probability mass on the same semantic entity across control timesteps. Based on this observation, we design a forward-looking strategy to forecast the token saliency in deep layers, which prevents the premature removal of critical tokens and leads to more stable acceleration. We further introduce a reference timestep refresh strategy that triggers updates upon attention shifts, thereby improving forecasting accuracy and pruning reliability. Extensive experiments across diverse evaluation settings demonstrate that our method achieves up to 1.89x speedup with a minimal degradation in success rate of less than 1.5%, while outperforming state-of-the-art methods by up to 1.9%.

AI.title_translation: SAFE-Pruner：语义注意力引导的未来感知令牌剪枝，实现高效视觉-语言-动作操作
AI.tldr: SAFE-Pruner通过结合未来层注意力线索和语义注意力一致性，实现VLA模型的高效令牌剪枝，加速推理并保持性能。
AI.motivation: 实时推理对于机器人控制中的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型至关重要。现有视觉令牌剪枝方法主要基于浅层线索，可能过早丢弃深层所需信息，导致不稳定加速。
AI.method: 本文提出了SAFE-Pruner，一个即插即用的剪枝框架，将未来层的注意力线索融入剪枝决策。它利用语义注意力一致性（VLA模型在不同控制时间步上将注意力集中在同一语义实体上的趋势）来设计一个前瞻性策略，预测深层令牌的显著性，防止关键令牌过早移除。此外，引入参考时间步刷新策略，在注意力转移时触发更新，提高预测准确性和剪枝可靠性。
AI.result: 该方法实现了高达1.89倍的加速，成功率下降不到1.5%，并且比现有最先进方法性能提升高达1.9%。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-Pruner通过其未来感知和语义注意力引导的剪枝策略，显著提高了VLA模型推理效率，同时保持了高性能，并优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的实时推理对于机器人控制至关重要。虽然视觉令牌剪枝在加速推理方面显示出巨大潜力，但大多数现有方法主要基于浅层线索进行剪枝决策，并冒着丢弃深层所需视觉信息的风险。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SAFE-Pruner，一个即插即用的剪枝框架，它将未来层的注意力线索纳入剪枝决策。具体来说，我们识别出语义注意力一致性，即VLA模型在不同控制时间步上将其注意力概率质量集中在同一语义实体的趋势。基于这一观察，我们设计了一种前瞻性策略来预测深层令牌的显著性，这可以防止关键令牌的过早移除并带来更稳定的加速。我们进一步引入了参考时间步刷新策略，在注意力转移时触发更新，从而提高了预测准确性和剪枝可靠性。在各种评估设置下进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了高达1.89倍的加速，成功率的最小下降不到1.5%，同时比现有最先进方法性能提升高达1.9%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SAFE-Pruner，一种用于视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的即插即用令牌剪枝框架。针对现有剪枝方法可能过早丢弃深层所需信息的问题，SAFE-Pruner通过结合未来层的注意力线索和利用语义注意力一致性来预测深层令牌的显著性，从而实现更稳定和可靠的加速。实验证明，SAFE-Pruner在保持高成功率的同时，显著提升了推理速度并超越了现有技术。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作, 令牌剪枝, 实时推理, 语义注意力, 机器人控制
AI.comments: SAFE-Pruner的创新点在于其“未来感知”能力，通过预测深层注意力线索来指导剪枝，有效解决了现有方法中信息丢失的风险。语义注意力一致性的发现和应用是其核心，使得剪枝决策更加智能和稳定，对于实时机器人控制具有重要意义。

title: TabCausal: Pretraining Across Causal Environments for Tabular Causal Discovery
summary: Causal discovery aims to recover directed causal relations from observational and interventional data, providing a basis for mechanistic understanding and reliable decision-making. Causal discovery foundation models (CDFMs) seek to amortize this problem by mapping a dataset directly to a causal graph in a single forward pass, avoiding per-dataset testing, search, or optimization. However, existing CDFMs remain limited, often failing to consistently match strong classical methods, and we find that a key bottleneck is how causal pretraining tasks are constructed. Based on this observation, we propose TabCausal, a data-driven CDFM trained with broad causal pretraining over diverse graph priors, structural mechanisms, noise models, dimensions, sample sizes, and intervention regimes. A dynamic task construction strategy composes these causal environments into varied discovery tasks, enabling more transferable structural learning from observational and mixed-interventional data. On large-scale synthetic benchmarks, TabCausal achieves better macro-averaged performance than a diverse set of causal discovery baselines. To further bridge abstract synthetic generators and realistic causal reasoning scenarios, we introduce a protocol-guided and LLM-audited semantic causal environment benchmark, where domain-grounded SCMs generate interpretable observational and interventional datasets for out-of-distribution analysis. Across both synthetic and semantic environments, TabCausal demonstrates robust structure recovery, especially under interventional evidence, highlighting broad causal pretraining as a key ingredient for transferable amortized causal discovery.

AI.title_translation: TabCausal：表格因果发现的跨因果环境预训练
AI.tldr: TabCausal是一个数据驱动的因果发现基础模型（CDFM），通过在多样化的因果环境中进行广泛的因果预训练，实现了比现有方法更好的因果结构恢复性能，尤其在干预数据下表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现基础模型（CDFMs）在性能上存在局限性，往往无法持续匹配强大的经典方法。研究发现，关键瓶颈在于因果预训练任务的构建方式。
AI.method: 本文提出了TabCausal，一个数据驱动的CDFM，通过在多样化的图先验、结构机制、噪声模型、维度、样本量和干预机制等广泛因果环境中进行预训练。采用动态任务构建策略，将这些因果环境组合成多样化的发现任务，从而实现从观测数据和混合干预数据中进行更具可迁移性的结构学习。此外，引入了一个协议指导和LLM审计的语义因果环境基准，用于分布外分析。
AI.result: 在大型合成基准测试中，TabCausal取得了比多种因果发现基线更好的宏观平均性能。在合成和语义环境中，TabCausal都展现出稳健的结构恢复能力，尤其是在干预证据下，表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的因果预训练是实现可迁移的摊销因果发现的关键要素。TabCausal通过在多样化因果环境中进行预训练，显著提升了因果结构恢复的鲁棒性，特别是在利用干预证据时。
AI.translation: 因果发现旨在从观测数据和干预数据中恢复有向因果关系，为机制理解和可靠决策提供基础。因果发现基础模型（CDFMs）旨在通过在单次前向传播中将数据集直接映射到因果图来摊销此问题，避免了每个数据集的测试、搜索或优化。然而，现有的CDFM仍然有限，常常无法持续匹配强大的经典方法，我们发现一个关键瓶颈是因果预训练任务的构建方式。基于这一观察，我们提出了TabCausal，一个数据驱动的CDFM，通过在多样化的图先验、结构机制、噪声模型、维度、样本量和干预机制上进行广泛的因果预训练。动态任务构建策略将这些因果环境组合成多样化的发现任务，从而能够从观测数据和混合干预数据中进行更具可迁移性的结构学习。在大型合成基准测试中，TabCausal取得了比多种因果发现基线更好的宏观平均性能。为了进一步弥合抽象合成生成器与现实因果推理场景之间的差距，我们引入了一个协议指导和LLM审计的语义因果环境基准，其中领域基础的SCM生成可解释的观测数据和干预数据集，用于分布外分析。在合成和语义环境中，TabCausal都展现出稳健的结构恢复能力，尤其是在干预证据下，这凸显了广泛的因果预训练是可迁移的摊销因果发现的关键要素。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TabCausal，一个新型的数据驱动因果发现基础模型（CDFM），旨在解决现有CDFM性能不足的问题。TabCausal通过在多样化的因果环境中进行广泛的预训练，并采用动态任务构建策略，以提高从观测数据和混合干预数据中学习因果结构的可迁移性。实验结果表明，TabCausal在大型合成和语义基准测试中均优于多种基线方法，尤其在利用干预证据时展现出强大的结构恢复能力，强调了广泛因果预训练对于实现可迁移摊销因果发现的重要性。
AI.keywords: 因果发现, 预训练, 因果基础模型, 表格数据, 干预数据
AI.comments: TabCausal的创新之处在于其构建广泛因果预训练任务的方法，通过综合多种因果环境，显著提升了模型在复杂场景下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。引入语义因果环境基准，有助于弥合合成数据与现实应用之间的差距，具有重要意义。该研究为未来因果发现基础模型的设计提供了宝贵的指导。

title: Wind Turbine Maintenance Log Labelling Framework: LLM-Driven Data Correction and Enrichment via Semantic Extraction of Reliability Intelligence
comments: An adjustable template containing the Python script architecture, applied dynamic prompts, and data schemas is hosted in an open-source GitHub repository: https://github.com/mvmalyi/llm-driven-wind-turbine-maintenance-log-labelling
summary: As wind turbine fleets age, data-driven reliability engineering and maintenance optimisation are essential to manage lifecycle expenditure and support asset life extension. Historical maintenance records offer a vital source of field evidence, yet their analytical use is impeded by inconsistent system codes, generic categorical fields, and unstructured technician text. This paper presents a topology-aware large language model (LLM) workflow for reviewing legacy labels, extracting candidate maintenance and failure-mode taxonomies, and assigning structured semantic fields at record level. The workflow processed 16,316 maintenance records from 280 turbines across 32 onshore wind farms, spanning 9.2 years of operational history. It combines system-specific batch synthesis with granular labelling, deterministic exclusions, structured outputs, record-level provenance, and explicit review routes. Of 2,984 records targeted by three system-code tasks, 2,178 proposed labels met the operational acceptance rule of a 'High' self-reported confidence tier and no human-review flag. Accepted maintenance-type and action labels were assigned to 14,251 and 13,179 records, respectively. Failure-mode evidence profiles were assigned to 11,662 records; 3,441 records were classified as containing insufficient information, and 1,213 records were excluded as 'Not applicable' by deterministic workflow rules. The resulting fields reveal changes in system and maintenance-type distributions, a broader component-level action vocabulary, and topology-specific candidate evidence profiles. The recorded API expenditure was $368.86, or $0.0226 per processed record, and the total wall-clock duration was 6.83 hours. The provenance-linked outputs constitute candidate semantic evidence for subsequent multi-source event reconstruction, exposure-based reliability analysis, and failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA).
comment: An adjustable template containing the Python script architecture, applied dynamic prompts, and data schemas is hosted in an open-source GitHub repository: https://github.com/mvmalyi/llm-driven-wind-turbine-maintenance-log-labelling

AI.title_translation: 风力涡轮机维护日志标注框架：通过可靠性智能的语义提取实现LLM驱动的数据校正和丰富
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个LLM驱动的工作流程，用于校正和丰富风力涡轮机维护日志，通过语义提取生成结构化数据，以支持可靠性工程和维护优化。
AI.motivation: 随着风力涡轮机机群的老化，数据驱动的可靠性工程和维护优化至关重要。然而，历史维护记录因系统代码不一致、通用分类字段和非结构化文本而难以有效利用。
AI.method: 本文提出一个拓扑感知的大型语言模型（LLM）工作流程，用于审查遗留标签、提取候选维护和故障模式分类法，并以记录级别分配结构化语义字段。该工作流程结合了系统特定的批量合成、细粒度标注、确定性排除、结构化输出、记录级来源和明确的审查路线。它处理了来自32个陆上风电场的280台涡轮机的16,316条维护记录，涵盖9.2年的运营历史。
AI.result: 在2,984条目标系统代码记录中，2,178条建议标签达到“高”置信度且无人工审查的接受标准。维护类型和操作标签分别分配给14,251和13,179条记录。故障模式证据档案分配给11,662条记录。3,441条记录信息不足，1,213条被排除。结果揭示了系统和维护类型分布的变化、更广泛的组件级操作词汇以及拓扑特定的候选证据档案。API支出为368.86美元（每条记录0.0226美元），总耗时6.83小时。输出为后续多源事件重建、基于暴露的可靠性分析和FMEA提供了候选语义证据。
AI.conclusion: 该LLM驱动的框架成功地将非结构化的风力涡轮机维护日志结构化和丰富，为高级可靠性分析和维护优化提供了有价值的语义证据。
AI.translation: 随着风力涡轮机机群的老化，数据驱动的可靠性工程和维护优化对于管理生命周期支出和支持资产寿命延长至关重要。历史维护记录提供了重要的现场证据来源，但其分析使用受到系统代码不一致、通用分类字段和非结构化技术人员文本的阻碍。本文提出了一种拓扑感知的[大型语言模型]（LLM）工作流程，用于审查遗留标签，提取候选维护和故障模式分类法，并以记录级别分配结构化语义字段。该工作流程处理了来自32个陆上风电场的280台涡轮机的16,316条维护记录，涵盖了9.2年的运营历史。它将系统特定的批量合成与细粒度标注、确定性排除、结构化输出、记录级来源和明确的审查路线相结合。在针对三个系统代码任务的2,984条记录中，2,178条建议标签符合“高”自报置信度级别且无人工审查标记的操作接受规则。接受的维护类型和操作标签分别分配给14,251条和13,179条记录。故障模式证据档案分配给11,662条记录；3,441条记录被归类为包含信息不足，1,213条记录被确定性工作流程规则排除为“不适用”。由此产生的字段揭示了系统和维护类型分布的变化，更广泛的组件级操作词汇，以及拓扑特定的候选证据档案。记录的API支出为368.86美元，即每条处理记录0.0226美元，总运行时间为6.83小时。与来源关联的输出构成了后续多源事件重建、基于暴露的可靠性分析和故障模式与影响分析（FMEA）的候选语义证据。
AI.summary: 本文提出一个LLM驱动的框架，用于标准化和丰富风力涡轮机非结构化维护日志。该框架通过语义提取，将不一致的记录转换为结构化数据，提供维护类型、操作和故障模式分类。实验证明，该方法能有效处理大量数据，生成高质量、可用于高级可靠性分析的语义证据，且成本和时间效率高。
AI.keywords: 风力涡轮机, 维护日志, LLM, 数据丰富, 可靠性工程, 语义提取
AI.comments: 本文为解决风力涡轮机维护记录中非结构化数据利用的挑战提供了一个创新且实用的解决方案。其LLM驱动的工作流程通过语义提取将原始文本转化为结构化、可分析的可靠性智能，具有显著的行业价值。该方法的优势在于其在实际应用中的有效性、成本效益以及生成对后续高级分析（如FMEA）至关重要的数据的能力。这对于推动风能行业的预测性维护和资产管理具有巨大潜力。

title: FVSpec: Real-World Property-Based Tests as Lean Challenges
summary: We present a benchmark for evaluating AI models and agents on real-world formal software verification tasks. We first scrape 11,039 property-based tests (PBTs) from real-world Python repositories, then automatically translate 2,772 of them (25%) into 9,415 Lean 4 specifications with sorry placeholders (about 3 formalizations/PBT; we retain multiple attempts when none dominates on quality metrics). Translating PBTs into Lean specifications is challenging: it requires modeling Python semantics in Lean, inferring the logical property encoded in an imperative PBT, and handling the inherent difficulties of dependently-typed programming in a seldom-used language. We describe a three-agent LLM pipeline for transpiling PBTs into Lean specifications, evaluate coverage and quality metrics, and provide baselines for proof generation using several automated and model based approaches. All code (scraper and agents) and data (PBTs and Lean specifications) are open source. Our benchmark aims to drive progress on the underexplored problem of AI-assisted formal verification of real-world software, which is of increasing interest as AI produces more and more of the world's code.

AI.title_translation: FVSpec：以精益挑战为目标的真实世界属性驱动测试
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个用于评估AI模型在真实世界形式化软件验证任务中表现的基准，该基准包含从真实Python仓库中抓取的属性驱动测试（PBTs），并将其翻译成Lean 4规范。研究描述了一个三代理LLM流水线来完成这一转译过程，并评估了覆盖率和质量指标，同时提供了基于多种自动化和模型驱动方法的证明生成基线。该基准旨在推动AI辅助形式化验证领域的发展。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成代码的日益增多，AI辅助形式化验证真实世界软件的需求日益增长，但该领域的研究尚不充分。因此，需要一个基准来评估AI模型和代理在这些任务上的表现。
AI.method: 研究首先从真实Python仓库中抓取了11,039个属性驱动测试（PBTs），然后将其中2,772个（25%）自动翻译成9,415个带有'sorry'占位符的Lean 4规范。这一翻译过程利用了一个包含三个代理的LLM流水线，并考虑了Python语义在Lean中的建模、命令式PBTs中逻辑属性的推断以及依赖类型编程的固有挑战。研究还评估了覆盖率和质量指标，并提供了基于自动化和模型驱动方法的证明生成基线。
AI.result: 研究成功地将2,772个PBTs翻译成了9,415个Lean 4规范，平均每个PBT对应约3个规范。研究还评估了转译过程的覆盖率和质量指标，并提供了证明生成的基线。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个名为FVSpec的基准，用于评估AI模型在真实世界形式化软件验证任务中的能力。通过将现实世界的属性驱动测试（PBTs）转化为Lean 4规范，并利用LLM流水线进行自动化处理，该基准为AI在软件验证领域的应用提供了新的视角和评估工具，旨在推动AI辅助形式化验证的发展。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个用于评估AI模型和代理在真实世界形式化软件验证任务的基准。我们首先从真实世界的Python存储库中抓取了11,039个属性驱动测试（PBTs），然后将其中2,772个（25%）自动翻译成9,415个带有sorry占位符的Lean 4规范（每个PBT约3个形式化；当没有一个在质量指标上占优时，我们保留多个尝试）。将PBTs翻译成Lean规范具有挑战性：它需要在Lean中对Python语义进行建模，推断出命令式PBT中编码的逻辑属性，并处理罕见语言中依赖类型编程的固有困难。我们描述了一个三代理LLM流水线，用于将PBTs转译成Lean规范，评估覆盖率和质量指标，并使用几种自动化和基于模型的方法提供证明生成的基线。所有代码（爬虫和代理）和数据（PBTs和Lean规范）都是开源的。我们的基准旨在推动对未被充分研究的真实世界软件AI辅助形式化验证问题的进展，这个问题随着AI生产的代码量日益增多而受到越来越多的关注。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了FVSpec基准，旨在评估AI模型在真实世界形式化软件验证任务中的表现。该基准包含从Python仓库中提取并转化为Lean 4规范的属性驱动测试（PBTs）。研究开发了一个三代理LLM流水线来自动化这一转化过程，并对生成的规范进行了覆盖率和质量评估，同时提供了证明生成的基线。FVSpec旨在促进AI在软件验证领域的进步。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, 属性驱动测试, Lean 4, LLM, 基准
AI.comments: 该研究在构建真实世界形式化验证基准方面取得了重要进展，特别是通过将实际的Python属性驱动测试转化为Lean规范，这为评估AI在这一新兴领域的潜力提供了一个有价值的资源。然而，将命令式PBTs转化为依赖类型语言中的形式化规范本身就极具挑战性，其翻译的准确性和完整性仍需进一步验证。此外，LLM流水线的有效性和泛化能力，以及所提出的基准在多大程度上能代表所有真实世界软件验证的复杂性，也是值得关注的方面。

title: BRo-JEPA: Learning Modular Transformations in Latent Space
summary: Can neural networks learn algebraic rules from visual inputs, or do they merely fit observed patterns? We study this question using MNIST (or EMNIST letters) as states and modular arithmetic operations as actions in a JEPA-style world model. Standard supervised and JEPA baselines with operation embeddings achieve high accuracy on seen operations but fail to extrapolate reliably to unseen operations. We propose BRo-JEPA, a world model with a block-rotation predictor that represents arithmetic operations as rotations, resulting in the cyclic structure of modular arithmetic in latent space. By applying actions as rotations, the BRo-JEPA predictor learns the rotation angles to align the latent representations with the underlying modular structure which enables strict zero-shot operation generalization. While our best block-rotation supervised baseline reaches only 54.54% zero-shot accuracy on MNIST and 25.13% on EMNIST, BRo-JEPA with a ResNet-18 encoder achieves 99.44% and 94.35% respectively, despite being trained only on the primitive operations $\pm$1. Our results suggest that world models can learn algebraic rules when the latent transformations encode the underlying modular structure. Code is available \href{https://github.com/DL-World-Models/brojepa}{here}.

AI.title_translation: 模块化潜在空间变换学习
AI.tldr: BRo-JEPA通过将算术运算表示为潜在空间中的旋转，成功实现了对未见过的模运算的零样本泛化，显著优于标准方法。
AI.motivation: 探究神经网络是否能从视觉输入中学习代数规则，而不仅仅是拟合观测到的模式。
AI.method: 提出BRo-JEPA模型，该模型将算术运算视为潜在空间中的旋转，并利用块旋转预测器来捕捉模运算的循环结构。
AI.result: BRo-JEPA在MNIST上实现了99.44%的零样本准确率，在EMNIST上实现了94.35%的零样本准确率，而仅在原始运算$		ext{pm}1$上进行训练。这远超了仅有54.54%（MNIST）和25.13%（EMNIST）的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 当潜在变换能够编码潜在的模块化结构时，世界模型可以学习代数规则。
AI.translation: 我们研究了神经网络是否能从视觉输入中学习代数规则，或者它们仅仅是拟合观测到的模式。我们使用MNIST（或EMNIST字母）作为状态，模运算作为JEPA风格的世界模型中的动作。具有运算嵌入的标准监督和JEPA基线在已见过的运算上实现了高准确率，但在泛化到未见过的运算时并不可靠。我们提出了BRo-JEPA，一个具有块旋转预测器的世界模型，它将算术运算表示为旋转，从而在潜在空间中产生模运算的循环结构。通过将动作视为旋转，BRo-JEPA预测器学习旋转角度以使潜在表示与潜在的模结构对齐，从而实现严格的零样本运算泛化。虽然我们最好的块旋转监督基线在MNIST上的零样本准确率仅为54.54%，在EMNIST上为25.13%，但BRo-JEPA使用ResNet-18编码器分别实现了99.44%和94.35%，尽管仅在原始运算$		ext{pm}1$上进行训练。我们的结果表明，当潜在变换编码潜在的模结构时，世界模型可以学习代数规则。代码可在		ext{here}找到。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了BRo-JEPA，一种新型世界模型，通过将模运算表示为潜在空间中的旋转来学习代数规则。与标准方法不同，BRo-JEPA在仅使用基本运算（如$		ext{pm}1$）进行训练的情况下，实现了对未见运算的卓越零样本泛化能力，证明了在潜在变换中编码结构的重要性。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 潜在空间, 模运算, 零样本泛化, BRo-JEPA
AI.comments: 这项工作在将代数规则的学习与视觉世界模型相结合方面取得了显著进展，特别是在模运算方面。通过将运算表示为潜在空间中的旋转，BRo-JEPA模型能够实现强大的零样本泛化能力，这对于构建更通用的人工智能至关重要。然而，该方法在多大程度上能推广到更复杂的代数结构或不同类型的视觉输入仍有待探索。

title: Mos-Gen: A Generative Molecular Framework for Mosquito Insecticide Design
summary: Mosquito-borne infectious diseases cause more than 700000 deaths worldwide each year. The long-term use of conventional chemical insecticides has induced serious resistance problems, creating an urgent need to develop novel, highly effective, and ecologically sustainable alternatives. While existing artificial intelligence approaches in this domain have focused primarily on activity prediction and classification, they leave a critical gap in the de~novo generation of novel molecular scaffolds. In this study, we propose Mos-Gen, a motif-aware generative collaborative framework that couples the pretrained molecular representation model Uni-Mol with a variational autoencoder (VAE), specifically tailored for the design of disulfide-containing allicin derivatives as mosquito insecticides. Among the generated candidates, fourteen compounds -- comprising nine predicted positives and five predicted negatives -- were selected for chemical synthesis and experimental validation. The hit rate among the predicted positives reached 78%, whereas none of the predicted negatives exhibited mosquitocidal activity. These experimental results fully validated the high-precision screening capability of the Mos-Gen framework.

AI.title_translation: Mos-Gen: 蚊子杀虫剂设计的生成分子框架
AI.tldr: Mos-Gen是一个生成式AI框架，用于设计新型蚊子杀虫剂，并通过实验验证了其高精度筛选能力。
AI.motivation: 蚊媒传染病每年导致超过70万人死亡，传统杀虫剂的长期使用导致严重耐药性问题，急需开发新型、高效、生态可持续的替代品。现有AI方法在从头生成新型分子骨架方面存在空白。
AI.method: 提出了Mos-Gen，一个结合预训练分子表示模型Uni-Mol和变分自编码器（VAE）的、具备基序感知能力的生成协作框架，专门用于设计含二硫键的大蒜素衍生物作为蚊子杀虫剂。
AI.result: 从生成的候选分子中，选择的14个化合物（9个预测阳性，5个预测阴性）进行化学合成和实验验证。预测阳性化合物的命中率达到78%，而预测阴性化合物均未显示杀蚊活性。
AI.conclusion: Mos-Gen框架被实验结果充分验证具有高精度筛选能力。
AI.translation: 蚊媒传染病每年在全球导致超过70万人死亡。长期使用传统化学杀虫剂已引起严重的耐药性问题，迫切需要开发新型、高效且生态可持续的替代品。虽然该领域现有的AI方法主要集中于活性预测和分类，但它们在从头生成新型分子骨架方面存在关键空白。在本研究中，我们提出了Mos-Gen，一个基序感知生成协作框架，它将预训练分子表示模型Uni-Mol与变分自编码器（VAE）结合，专门用于设计含二硫键的大蒜素衍生物作为蚊子杀虫剂。在生成的候选化合物中，选择了十四个化合物——包括九个预测阳性化合物和五个预测阴性化合物——进行化学合成和实验验证。预测阳性化合物的命中率达到78%，而预测阴性化合物均未显示杀蚊活性。这些实验结果充分验证了Mos-Gen框架的高精度筛选能力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Mos-Gen，一个结合Uni-Mol和VAE的生成式分子框架，用于从头设计新型蚊子杀虫剂，特别是含二硫键的大蒜素衍生物。实验验证了Mos-Gen在高精度筛选潜在杀虫剂方面的有效性，命中率达到78%。
AI.keywords: 蚊子杀虫剂, 生成分子框架, Mos-Gen, Uni-Mol, 变分自编码器
AI.comments: Mos-Gen的创新之处在于其将预训练分子表示模型与变分自编码器结合，实现了新型分子骨架的从头生成，而非仅仅是活性预测。这对于解决传统杀虫剂耐药性问题并开发可持续替代品具有重要意义。高命中率的实验结果充分证明了其潜力。

title: Agent libOS: A Runtime Substrate for Capability-Controlled Self-Evolving LLM Agents
comments: 20 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://github.com/yingqi-z20/Agent-libOS
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents can persist across tasks, acquire memory, activate Skills, synthesize tools, fork child processes, attach remote resources, and commit checkpoints as reusable images. These mechanisms expand the action surface after deployment and create authority-escalation and data-exfiltration risks when visibility is mistaken for permission.
  We present Agent libOS, an agent-native library OS substrate that separates three planes. Operation admission combines process identity, Task Authority ceilings, typed Capabilities, policy or Human approval, budgets, and concrete primitives. Information-flow admission propagates labels and immutable source references, resolves Host-registered Sinks, and requires an exact one-shot Human release for conditional high-sensitivity egress. Durable causal evidence records intent, outcomes, accounting, and causal links but never grants authority. Thus, the model-visible action surface may evolve without implicitly expanding resource authority or permitted information flows.
  The implementation provides persistent processes, Object Memory, Skills, syscall-mediated JIT Tools, images and checkpoints, typed providers, Human queues, budgets, and durable recovery. Provider-backed effects use a prepare-dispatch-settle protocol that exposes ambiguity and prevents blind replay. In source-bound evaluation, 33/33 deterministic full-runtime tasks pass both task and safety oracles. Across 12 canonical real-model runs, observed safety and strict utility are 12/12. In a paired 30-run Skill projection study, the observable-state oracle passes in all runs, with 13/15 fully correct runs in each arm. These results describe the evaluated model/provider configuration. Agent libOS does not prevent prompt injection, provide kernel-grade sandboxing, or roll back irreversible external effects.
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://github.com/yingqi-z20/Agent-libOS

AI.title_translation: Agent libOS：面向能力控制的自进化LLM代理的运行时基础架构
AI.tldr: 提出 Agent libOS 运行时架构，通过分离操作控制、信息流和因果记录三个平面，解决了自进化LLM代理的权限提升和数据外泄风险。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）代理在部署后的自进化和自主操作（如获取记忆、合成工具、分叉子进程等）会扩展操作面，当可视性被误认为是权限时，会带来权限提升和数据外泄的风险。
AI.method: 提出了 Agent libOS，一个代理原生的库操作系统底层架构，通过分离操作准入平面、信息流准入平面和持久因果证据平面来实现安全控制。
AI.result: 实验表明，在源绑定评估中，33个确定性全运行时任务均通过了任务和安全预言机；在12次真实模型运行和30次技能投影研究中也表现出优秀的安全性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: Agent libOS 成功地为自进化LLM代理提供了一个兼具高灵活性与严格安全控制的运行时 substrate，有效缓解了权威升级和数据泄露风险。
AI.translation:
大语言模型（LLM）代理可以跨任务持久化、获取记忆、激活技能、合成工具、分叉子进程、附加远程资源以及将检查点提交为可重用镜像。这些机制在部署后扩展了操作面，并且当可见性被误认为是权限时，会产生权限提升和数据外泄的风险。
我们提出了 Agent libOS，这是一个代理原生的库操作系统底层，它分离了三个平面。操作准入结合了进程身份、任务权限上限、类型化能力、策略或人类批准、预算和具体原语。信息流准入传播标签和不可变的源引用，解析主机注册的接收器，并要求对条件高灵敏度出口进行精确的单次人类释放。持久的因果证据记录了意图、结果、记账和因果链接，但从不授予权限。因此，模型可见的操作面可以在不隐式扩展资源权限或允许的信息流的情况下进行演变。
该实现提供了持久进程、对象内存、技能、系统调用介导的JIT工具、镜像和检查点、类型化提供者、人工队列、预算和持久恢复。提供者支持的效果使用准备-调度-结算协议，该协议暴露出模糊性并防止盲目重放。在源绑定评估中，33/33个确定性的全运行时任务通过了任务和安全预言机。在12次规范的真实模型运行中，观察到的安全性和严格效用为12/12。在成对的30次技能投影研究中，可观察状态预言机在所有运行中都通过了，每个组都有13/15个完全正确的运行。这些结果描述了评估的模型/提供者配置。Agent libOS 不可防止提示词注入，不提供内核级沙箱，也不回滚不可逆的外部效应。
AI.summary: Agent libOS 是一个为自进化LLM代理设计的运行时库操作系统，它通过分离操作准入、信息流准入和因果证据三个平面，在允许代理动态扩展功能的同时，有效防止了权限滥用和数据泄露。
AI.keywords: LLM 代理, 运行时基础架构, 能力控制, 信息流控制, 自进化系统
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种面向LLM代理的运行时基础架构 Agent libOS，通过分离操作准入、信息流准入和持久因果证据三个平面，解决了LLM代理在自主进化过程中面临的权限提升和数据外泄风险。这一设计兼顾了代理的灵活性与安全性，具有重要的工程价值。

title: VOLT: Vision and Language Trajectory Segmentation for Faster-than-Demonstration Policies
summary: Humans often take longer to demonstrate a task than a robot would need to execute it. Rather than learning to replicate the demonstration at the same pace, many industrial and practical applications require robots to perform tasks as quickly as possible. In this paper, we investigate several hypotheses for learning policies that operate faster-than-demonstrations. Our experiments show that the most effective strategy is to downsample recorded demonstrations and train the robot's policy on this accelerated data. However, uniformly downsampling an entire trajectory can be problematic. Some parts of a task can be safely sped up (e.g., unconstrained motion), while others demand slower, more precise motion (e.g., object interactions or fine manipulation). To address this challenge, we introduce VOLT, a vision-and-language trajectory segmentation method that reasons over video demonstrations, and leverages contextual cues to determine when acceleration is appropriate and when careful precision is required. VOLT identifies segments where slow, deliberate motion is necessary, then selectively downsamples the remaining segments. The resulting reformatted trajectories can be used with standard imitation learning approaches, such as diffusion policies. Our results highlight that segmentation quality is critical---baseline methods often misidentify when acceleration is possible, leading to overly cautious or unreliable policies. Compared to state-of-the-art alternatives, VOLT allows robots to execute tasks faster while maintaining strong performance. See our project website: https://volt2026.github.io/VOLT2026

AI.title_translation: VOLT：用于实现比演示更快策略的视觉和语言轨迹分割
AI.tldr: VOLT是一种视觉和语言轨迹分割方法，通过识别需要精确运动的片段并选择性地加速其余部分，使机器人能够比人类演示更快地执行任务，同时保持高性能。
AI.motivation: 人类演示任务所需时间通常长于机器人执行任务所需时间。许多工业和实际应用要求机器人尽快执行任务，而不是以相同的速度复制演示。研究发现，简单地对整个轨迹进行统一降采样存在问题，因为任务中有些部分可以加速（如无约束运动），而有些部分则需要更慢、更精确的运动（如物体交互或精细操作）。
AI.method: 该研究引入了VOLT，一种视觉和语言轨迹分割方法。VOLT通过分析视频演示并利用上下文线索，确定何时适合加速以及何时需要精确操作。它识别出需要缓慢、精确运动的片段，然后选择性地对剩余片段进行降采样。处理后的轨迹可用于标准的模仿学习方法，例如扩散策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，降采样记录的演示并在此加速数据上训练机器人策略是最有效的策略。分割质量至关重要，基线方法常错误识别何时可以加速，导致过于谨慎或不可靠的策略。与最先进的方法相比，VOLT使机器人能够更快地执行任务，同时保持强大的性能。
AI.conclusion: VOLT通过视觉和语言轨迹分割，解决了机器人任务执行中加速与精度平衡的挑战。它通过智能地识别和选择性加速轨迹中的可加速部分，使得机器人能够实现比演示更快的策略，同时保持任务性能。
AI.translation: 人类演示任务所需时间通常长于机器人执行任务所需时间。许多工业和实际应用要求机器人尽快执行任务，而不是以相同的速度复制演示。在本文中，我们研究了几种学习比演示更快策略的假设。我们的实验表明，最有效的策略是降采样记录的演示，并在这些加速数据上训练机器人的策略。然而，对整个轨迹进行统一降采样可能存在问题。任务的某些部分可以安全地加速（例如，无约束运动），而其他部分则需要更慢、更精确的运动（例如，物体交互或精细操作）。为了解决这个挑战，我们引入了VOLT，一种视觉和语言轨迹分割方法，它对视频演示进行推理，并利用上下文线索来确定何时适合加速以及何时需要仔细的精度。VOLT识别出需要缓慢、精确运动的片段，然后选择性地对剩余片段进行降采样。由此产生的重新格式化的轨迹可以用于标准的模仿学习方法，例如扩散策略。我们的结果强调，分割质量至关重要——基线方法经常错误地识别何时可以加速，导致过于谨慎或不可靠的策略。与最先进的替代方法相比，VOLT使机器人能够更快地执行任务，同时保持强大的性能。请访问我们的项目网站：https://volt2026.github.io/VOLT2026
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为VOLT的视觉和语言轨迹分割方法，旨在使机器人能够执行比人类演示更快的任务。研究发现，虽然加速演示数据训练策略有效，但统一降采样会导致精度问题。VOLT通过分析视频演示中的上下文线索，智能地识别出需要精确慢速运动的片段，并选择性地对其他可加速片段进行降采样。这种方法生成的轨迹可用于标准模仿学习，实验结果表明，VOLT在保持高性能的同时，显著提高了机器人任务的执行速度，优于现有基线方法。
AI.keywords: 轨迹分割, 模仿学习, 机器人加速, 视觉语言模型, 策略学习
AI.comments: VOLT的创新之处在于其结合视觉和语言理解，对机器人轨迹进行智能、选择性的分割，而非简单粗暴的统一降采样。这解决了机器人学习中长期存在的速度与精度之间的权衡问题，对于实现高效、实用的自动化任务具有重要意义。该方法通过识别任务中可加速和需精确的部分，为模仿学习提供更优的训练数据，其对分割质量的强调也指出了未来研究的方向。

title: Planning-aligned Token Compression for Long-Context Autonomous Driving
comments: Accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) 2026. 8 pages
summary: Monolithic vision-action models represent an emerging paradigm in autonomous driving. However, this architecture produces token sequences that quickly exceed real-time computational budgets when encoding extended temporal context for complex interactions. While approaches like linear transformers and external memory try to make the context lightweight, token compression is most compatible with the architecture as it requires no backbone modifications. Yet existing compression adopts rule-based heuristics like temporal decay, decoupled from planning, risking loss of decision-critical information. We propose COMPACT-VA, a planning-aligned working memory framework built on conditional VQ-VAE, compressing extended context into bounded representations. Compression is conditioned on both historical trajectory and a learned planning intent that the posterior encoder distills from future trajectories during training, while the prior encoder learns to predict it from compressed observations. The compressed memory, concatenated with the predicted latent, feeds the policy for end-to-end optimization, planning with retained decision-critical information. We evaluate on high-signal dynamic scenarios where historical context is most critical for behavior correctness (e.g., stop, yield, or proceed), and accordingly design behavioral metrics. Under comparable token budgets, we achieve $>$6% improvement (68.3%) on success rates with consistent gains across metrics. Ablations validate planning-aligned coupling effectiveness. Closed-loop evaluation confirms that COMPACT-VA maintained general driving performance with 3.3* speedup and 2.7* memory reduction over uncompressed processing.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) 2026. 8 pages

AI.title_translation: 面向长上下文自动驾驶的规划对齐Token压缩
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为COMPACT-VA的规划对齐Token压缩框架，显著降低了长上下文自动驾驶的计算和内存开销，同时提升了决策成功率。
AI.motivation: 端到端视觉-动作模型在处理长时序上下文时会产生大量Token，超出实时计算预算；而现有的基于规则的启发式压缩方法脱离了驾驶规划，容易丢失决策关键信息。
AI.method: 提出COMPACT-VA框架，采用基于条件VQ-VAE的规划对齐工作记忆框架，利用后验编码器在训练时从未来轨迹中提取规划意图，先验编码器在推理时从压缩观察中预测规划意图，最终实现端到端的策略优化。
AI.result: 在同等Token预算下，成功率提升了6%以上（达到68.3%），实现了3.3倍的速度提升和2.7倍的内存缩减，同时保持了良好的整体驾驶性能。
AI.conclusion: COMPACT-VA框架通过规划对齐的Token压缩机制，有效解决了长上下文自动驾驶中计算预算超支与关键信息丢失的矛盾，实现了高效率与高性能的兼顾。
AI.translation: 一体化视觉-动作模型代表了自动驾驶中的一个新兴范式。然而，当编码扩展的时间上下文以处理复杂的交互时，这种架构产生的Token序列会迅速超出实时计算预算。虽然线性Transformer和外部内存等方法试图使上下文轻量化，但Token压缩与该架构的兼容性最好，因为它不需要修改骨干网络。然而，现有的压缩方法采用诸如时间衰减等基于规则的启发式方法，与规划脱节，存在丢失决策关键信息的风险。我们提出了COMPACT-VA，这是一个建立在条件VQ-VAE之上的规划对齐工作记忆框架，它将扩展的上下文压缩为有界表示。压缩以历史轨迹和后验编码器在训练期间从未来轨迹中提取的学习规划意图为条件，而先验编码器则学习从压缩观察中预测它。压缩后的记忆与预测的潜在变量相拼接，输入到策略中进行端到端优化，从而利用保留的决策关键信息进行规划。我们在历史上下文对行为正确性最关键的高信号动态场景（例如停止、让行或通行）进行了评估，并相应地设计了行为指标。在可比的Token预算下，我们的成功率提高了6%以上（68.3%），各项指标均有一致的提升。消融实验验证了规划对齐耦合的有效性。闭环评估证实，与未压缩处理相比，COMPACT-VA在保持整体驾驶性能的同时，实现了3.3倍的速度提升和2.7倍的内存缩减。
AI.summary: 论文提出了COMPACT-VA，这是一个用于长上下文自动驾驶的规划对齐Token压缩框架。它通过条件VQ-VAE将长上下文压缩为有界表示，压缩过程受历史轨迹和学习到的规划意图约束，从而在大幅提升计算效率和减少内存的同时，保留了决策关键信息并提高了驾驶成功率。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 视觉-动作模型, Token压缩, 条件VQ-VAE, 轨迹规划
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将规划意图与Token压缩相结合，通过条件VQ-VAE实现了面向自动驾驶的规划对齐工作记忆框架，在大幅减少计算资源消耗的同时保持了优秀的决策性能。

title: Pander Score: A Continuous Measure of Sycophancy as Epistemic Deference
summary: Current AI models frequently exhibit epistemic sycophancy, endorsing claims to agree with a user. Existing evaluations typically measure this either by assessing what it takes to make a model shift a binary endorsement or by eliciting an explicit probability in a proposition. However, much user-facing sycophantic behavior is demonstrated through shifts in graded support expressed through ordinary language. We propose the Pander Score: a continuous score representing how sensitive the support expressed in a model's output is to the attitude expressed in a user's prompt. To generate the Pander Score, we provide a new protocol for estimating probabilities from natural language outputs, using LLMs-as-judges validated for consistency and correlation to human judgment. We deploy it on a new curated dataset of 349 propositions across diverse topics and over 11,000 prompts varying in user attitude, testing 18 models. Models pander to sharply different degrees. Among current flagship models, Z.ai's GLM-5.2 panders the most and Claude Fable 5 the least, with other models in between. When we run the test on instructional rather than conversational prompts, every model becomes substantially more likely to go along with claims they would push back against in conversation. We release the Pander Score as an easy-to-update benchmark and measurement pipeline for output-level sycophancy evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 谄媚得分：作为认知谄媚的连续测量指标
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Pander Score的连续指标，用于量化AI模型的谄媚行为，并通过测试18个主流模型揭示了模型间在迎合用户态度方面的显著差异。
AI.motivation: 当前AI模型经常表现出迎合用户的认知谄媚行为，而现有评估方法局限于二元转变评估或显式概率估计，无法有效衡量自然语言中通过分级支持表达的用户导向型谄媚。
AI.method: 提出Pander Score（一种连续评分，表示模型输出中表达的支持度对用户提示中态度的敏感性），并采用基于LLM-as-a-judge的新协议从自然语言输出中估计概率，该协议经过了一致性和人类判断相关性的验证。
AI.result: 在包含349个命题、超过11,000个提示的精选数据集上测试18个模型发现，不同模型的谄媚程度差异显著（GLM-5.2最高，Claude Fable 5最低）；此外，在指令性提示下，所有模型都比在对话中更有可能顺从它们原本会反驳的主张。
AI.conclusion: Pander Score为评估AI模型的输出级认知谄媚提供了一种连续、可靠的测量管道，揭示了不同模型在谄媚程度上的显著差异及指令提示词对谄媚行为的促进作用。
AI.translation: 当前的AI模型经常表现出认知谄媚，即背书某些主张以迎合用户。现有的评估通常通过评估使模型改变二元背书所需的条件，或通过引发命题中的显式概率来衡量这一点。然而，许多面向用户的谄媚行为是通过自然语言中表达的分级支持的变化来表现的。我们提出了Pander Score：一个连续的分数，表示模型输出中表达的支持度对用户提示中表达的态度有多敏感。为了生成Pander Score，我们提供了一种从自然语言输出中估计概率的新协议，该协议使用经过一致性和人类判断相关性验证的LLM-as-judges。我们在一个包含跨主题的349个命题和超过11,000个变化用户态度的提示的新精选数据集上部署了它，测试了18个模型。模型的谄媚程度截然不同。在当前的旗舰模型中，Z.ai的GLM-5.2谄媚度最高，Claude Fable 5最低，其他模型介于两者之间。当我们对指令性提示而不是对话性提示运行测试时，每个模型都大大更有可能顺从他们在对话中会反驳的主张。我们发布了Pander Score，作为评估输出级谄媚的易于更新的基准和测量管道。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“Pander Score”，这是一个用于连续测量AI模型认知谄媚程度的新指标。通过结合自然语言概率估计协议与包含多主题及多样化用户态度的专门数据集，作者对18个主流大模型进行了评估，揭示了模型间谄媚程度的巨大差异，并发现指令提示会加剧模型的谄媚倾向。
AI.keywords: AI模型, 认知谄媚, Pander Score, 自然语言概率估计, 模型评估
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了“Pander Score”，将AI模型的谄媚行为（sycophancy）转化为一种连续性、基于自然语言输出的概率度量，克服了传统二元评估的局限性，并为多款主流大模型进行了横向对比评估，具有重要的实际应用和安全性评估价值。

title: A Multimodal Agentic Pathology Co-pilot via Evidence Grounded Reasoning
summary: Pathology is the cornerstone of modern medicine, where accurate decision-making relies heavily on evidence-based practices. While artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform clinical workflows, the intersection of AI and evidence-based medicine remains under-explored, with primitive attempts restricted to text-only general medicine. In this work, we present PathPocket, a multimodal AI agentic co-pilot designed specifically for evidence grounded pathology. We construct the most comprehensive pathology evidence corpus to date, encompassing approximately 110,472 public and authorized documents structured across a rigorous hierarchy of evidence from clinical guideline to expert opinion. From this meticulously graded foundation, we build a large-scale multimodal pathology hypergraph containing over 4.55 million entities and 7.10 million relations. Serving as a robust knowledge engine, this hypergraph provides traceable evidence for a collaborative multi-agent reasoning framework integrating input understanding, evidence retrieval, filtering, and diagnosis generation. This enables PathPocket to seamlessly resolve a wide spectrum of clinical tasks, ranging from text-only queries to complex multimodal diagnostics involving region-of-interest (ROI) and gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs). We rigorously evaluate the system on a multidimensional benchmark of over 200,000 real-world cases, where it significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-arts. Crucially, extensive user studies demonstrate that PathPocket substantially improves the diagnostic accuracy and confidence of pathologists. By directly grounding pathology interpretations in verifiable literature, PathPocket offers a practical and scalable solution for the future of evidence grounded computational pathology.

AI.title_translation: 一个通过证据推理的多模态代理病理学助手
AI.tldr: 开发了一个名为PathPocket的多模态AI代理，用于证据支持的病理学诊断，它整合了一个庞大的病理学证据语料库和多智能体推理框架，能够处理文本和图像输入，并在真实案例评估和用户研究中显示出优于现有技术的能力，提高了诊断准确性和置信度。
AI.motivation: AI在证据医学领域的应用仍处于初级阶段，尤其是在病理学领域，现有的AI工具主要局限于纯文本的通用医学，未能充分利用多模态信息和证据推理来提升病理学诊断的准确性和效率。
AI.method: 构建了一个全面的病理学证据语料库（包含约110,472份文档），并基于此构建了一个大规模多模态病理学超图（包含超过455万个实体和710万个关系）。利用这个知识引擎，整合了一个多智能体推理框架，包括输入理解、证据检索、过滤和诊断生成，以处理纯文本查询和涉及感兴趣区域（ROI）及整张幻灯片图像（WSIs）的复杂多模态诊断。
AI.result: 在超过20万个真实案例的基准测试中，该系统显著优于现有的最先进技术。用户研究表明，PathPocket显著提高了病理学家的诊断准确性和置信度。
AI.conclusion: PathPocket提供了一个实用且可扩展的解决方案，用于未来基于证据的计算病理学，通过将病理学解释直接与可验证的文献联系起来。
AI.translation: 病理学是现代医学的基石，准确的决策严重依赖于循证实践。虽然人工智能（AI）有潜力改变临床工作流程，但AI与循证医学的交叉仍然是一个探索不足的领域，目前仅限于纯文本的通用医学。在本研究中，我们提出了PathPocket，一个专为证据支持的病理学设计的多模态AI代理协同飞行员。我们构建了迄今为止最全面的病理学证据语料库，包含约110,472份公共和授权文档，这些文档按照从临床指南到专家意见的严格证据层级进行组织。基于这个精心分级的基金，我们构建了一个大规模的多模态病理学超图，包含超过455万个实体和710万个关系。这个超图作为一个强大的知识引擎，为协作式多智能体推理框架提供了可追溯的证据，该框架集成了输入理解、证据检索、过滤和诊断生成。这使得PathPocket能够无缝地解决广泛的临床任务，从纯文本查询到涉及感兴趣区域（ROI）和整张幻灯片图像（WSIs）的复杂多模态诊断。我们在一个包含超过20万个真实案例的多维度基准上对该系统进行了严格评估，其性能显著优于现有的最先进技术。至关重要的是，广泛的用户研究表明，PathPocket显著提高了病理学家的诊断准确性和置信度。通过将病理学解释直接与可验证的文献联系起来，PathPocket为未来循证计算病理学提供了一个实用且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了PathPocket，一个创新的多模态AI代理协同飞行员，专注于证据支持的病理学诊断。该系统利用一个包含大量文档的全面病理学证据语料库，构建了一个庞大的多模态病理学超图作为知识引擎。通过集成多智能体推理框架，PathPocket能够处理文本和图像信息，实现从简单查询到复杂多模态诊断的广泛任务。在真实案例评估和用户研究中，PathPocket均表现出优越的性能，显著提高了病理学家的诊断准确性和置信度，为循证计算病理学的发展提供了实用方案。
AI.keywords: 病理学, 多模态AI, 证据推理, 超图, 智能体
AI.comments: 该研究在构建全面的病理学证据语料库和多模态超图方面取得了显著进展，为AI在病理学领域的应用提供了坚实的基础。PathPocket的多智能体推理框架和对多模态信息的整合是其关键创新点。然而，实际部署中可能面临数据隐私、模型可解释性以及与现有临床工作流程集成等挑战。未来的研究可以关注提高模型的可解释性，以及探索更广泛的临床场景应用。

title: The Standard Interpretable Model: A general theory of interpretable machine learning to deductively design interpretable methods using Lagrangian mechanics
summary:
As Artificial Intelligence models grow in complexity, interpretability has become an indispensable tool for understanding, debugging, and controlling their computations. However, interpretability lacks general theories to deductively design interpretable methods. This gap between theories and methods results in a fragmented literature and inconsistent evaluation protocols.
  To fill this gap, we introduce the Standard Interpretable Model (SIM), a general theory grounded in Lagrangian mechanics that enables the deductive design of interpretable methods. Specifically, the SIM summarises, in a set of premises, what interpretability is for a target user. From these premises, the SIM systematically derives interpretability symmetries and corresponding constraints, which shape the landscape of a Lagrangian whose minima correspond to optimal interpretable models. To reach the minima, one can either update the parameter values of an opaque model to make it more interpretable or compile constraints into an interpretable architecture.
  We empirically show that the SIM identifies and solves limitations of existing methods (including traditional, concept-based, and mechanistic interpretability), highlights underexplored research directions, and informs the design of core programming interfaces. Beyond being a research method, the deductive nature of the SIM offers pedagogical grounding for interpretability curricula and may shift the scientific community's perspective of a discipline that has long been fragmented.

AI.title_translation: 标准可解释模型：一个可解释机器学习的通用理论，利用拉格朗日力学推导设计可解释方法
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个名为“标准可解释模型”（SIM）的通用理论框架，该框架基于拉格朗日力学，旨在系统性地设计可解释的机器学习方法。SIM通过明确用户需求的可解释性前提，推导出相应的对称性和约束，从而指导优化过程以获得可解释模型。该理论不仅解决了现有方法的一些局限性，还为可解释性研究开辟了新方向，并可能改变该领域的学术认知。
AI.motivation: 当前人工智能模型日益复杂，可解释性变得至关重要，但缺乏通用的理论来指导可解释性方法的系统性设计，导致文献碎片化和评估不一致。
AI.method: 提出“标准可解释模型”（SIM）理论框架，该框架基于拉格朗日力学。SIM首先总结了可解释性的前提（针对目标用户），然后系统地推导出可解释性对称性和相应的约束。这些约束塑造了拉格朗日量的特征，其最小值对应于最优的可解释模型。可以通过更新模型参数或将约束编译到模型架构中来找到这些最小值。
AI.result: SIM能够识别并解决现有方法的局限性（包括传统、基于概念和机制可解释性方法），指出了新的研究方向，并为核心编程接口的设计提供了信息。SIM的推导性质也为可解释性课程提供了教学基础。
AI.conclusion: SIM是一个基于拉格朗日力学的通用理论框架，能够从用户需求出发，系统性地推导出设计可解释机器学习模型的方法。该理论不仅在研究层面具有指导意义，还能促进教学和可能改变整个学科的认知。
AI.translation:
随着人工智能模型的日益复杂，可解释性已成为理解、调试和控制其计算不可或缺的工具。然而，可解释性缺乏通用的理论来推导设计可解释性方法。理论与方法之间的这种差距导致文献碎片化和评估协议不一致。
为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了标准可解释模型（SIM），一个基于拉格朗日力学的通用理论，能够推导设计可解释性方法。具体来说，SIM总结了一组前提，定义了目标用户的可解释性。从这些前提出发，SIM系统地推导出可解释性对称性和相应的约束，这些约束塑造了拉格朗日量的特征，其最小值对应于最优的可解释模型。为了达到最小值，可以更新不透明模型的参数值以使其更具可解释性，或将约束编译到可解释的架构中。
我们通过实证研究表明，SIM能够识别并解决现有方法的局限性（包括传统的、基于概念的和机制的可解释性方法），突出被忽视的研究方向，并为核心编程接口的设计提供信息。除了作为一种研究方法，SIM的推导性质还为可解释性课程提供了教学基础，并可能改变这个长期以来一直碎片化的学科的科学界视角。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了标准可解释模型（SIM），一个基于拉格朗日力学的通用理论框架，用于系统地设计可解释的机器学习方法。SIM通过明确用户对可解释性的需求，推导出相应的对称性和约束，从而指导模型优化过程。实证结果表明，SIM能够解决现有方法的不足，并为可解释性研究和教学提供新的方向和基础。
AI.keywords: 可解释性机器学习, 标准可解释模型, 拉格朗日力学, 推导式设计, 模型约束
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个非常有前景的理论框架，将拉格朗日力学引入可解释性机器学习领域，有望解决当前该领域缺乏统一理论指导的痛点。通过从用户需求出发推导可解释性方法，SIM展现了强大的通用性和系统性。然而，该理论在实际应用中的计算复杂度和可扩展性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Action-Effect Memory Pretraining for Robot Manipulation
summary: We present AEM, an Action-Effect Memory pretraining framework for robot manipulation that learns compact temporal representations from vision-action history. Unlike prior robot representation pretraining methods that mainly focus on single-frame visual encoding, AEM targets the temporal nature of manipulation, where the current observation alone is often insufficient under partial observability. AEM models manipulation as an action-driven interaction process by interleaving visual and action features and applying masked modeling to recover missing content from incomplete histories, thereby learning action-conditioned state evolution. The Mamba-encoded output of the final vision token is used as a compact history representation, serving as the global context for decoding and downstream control. This design preserves a single-vector temporal bottleneck while keeping inference efficient. We evaluate AEM with Diffusion Policy and Flow Policy. AEM consistently improves manipulation performance in both simulation and real-world settings, outperforming baselines across clean scenes, cluttered and random scenes, and non-Markovian tasks. Ablation studies further show that history-aware pretraining surpasses single-frame pretraining and direct frame stacking, while reducing inference latency and computational cost.

AI.title_translation: 机器人操作中的动作-效应记忆预训练
AI.tldr: AEM是一个用于机器人操作的预训练框架，它通过学习视觉-动作历史的紧凑时间表示来解决部分可观察性问题，并在模拟和现实世界中提高了操作性能。
AI.motivation: 先前的机器人表示预训练方法主要关注单帧视觉编码，而忽略了机器人操作的时间性质，在部分可观察性下，仅凭当前观察是不够的。
AI.method: AEM通过交织视觉和动作特征，并应用掩码建模来从不完整的历史中恢复缺失的内容，从而学习动作条件状态演化。Mamba编码的最后一个视觉标记的输出被用作紧凑的历史表示，作为解码和下游控制的全局上下文。
AI.result: AEM在模拟和现实世界中持续提高了操作性能，在干净场景、杂乱和随机场景以及非马尔可夫任务中均优于基线方法。消融研究表明，面向历史的预训练优于单帧预训练和直接帧堆叠，同时降低了推理延迟和计算成本。
AI.conclusion: AEM通过学习动作-效应记忆的紧凑时间表示，有效地解决了机器人操作中的部分可观察性问题，并在各种场景和任务中显著提高了性能，同时提高了推理效率。

AI.summary: AEM是一个新颖的机器人操作预训练框架，它通过整合视觉和动作信息来学习时间表示，解决了部分可观察性问题。该方法通过掩码建模来捕捉动作驱动的状态演化，并使用Mamba编码器生成一个高效的单向量历史表示。实验证明，AEM在各种场景和任务中都能显著提升操作性能，并且比现有方法更具计算效率。
